Title: Digital Engineer Analytics 1
Description:
Community Transit is seeking a skilled and collaborative Digitial Analytics Enginee r to design and manage the digital analytics infrastructure that supports Community Transit’s websites, mobile applications, social media, marketing campaigns, and other digital services. In this role, y ou will configure and maintain tools such as Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, develop structured tagging strategies, and ensure digital data is accurate, consistent, and ready for analysis.

You will work closely with website developers, marketers, product teams and agency leaders to define business and tracking requirements. You will also analyze complex data, develop interactive reports, and transform findings into compelling narratives and recommendations that influence business strategy and improve the customer experience.

This position is well suited for someone who enjoys combining technical analytics work, business partnership, data storytelling, and strategic problem-solving.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is curious, analytical, and comfortable working at the intersection of technology, data, marketing, and business strategy. You enjoy building reliable digital measurement systems, investigating complex questions, and helping others understand what the data means.

Why Join Community Transit?

At Community Transit, your work will help shape how customers interact with public transportation services across digital channels. You will have the opportunity to build the agency’s digital analytics capabilities, influence strategic decisions, and help teams better understand customer needs and business performance.

You will join a collaborative environment where data is used to improve services, support innovation, and advance the agency’s mission.

Essential Duties

Data Engineering


Design, implement, and maintain data processing workflows within the data warehouse.
Develop and optimize data models that support reporting and business requirements.
Develop and maintain data collection, integration, or ingestion process for agency and digital data sources as assigned.
Support implementation and maintenance of data tracking, tagging, or event collection frameworks for approved digital platforms when applicable.
Establish monitoring, testing, and validation practices, including automated quality checks and controls.
Optimize data processing, storage, and reporting performance.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues affecting assigned data products and solutions.


Enterprise Reporting & Stakeholder Collaboration


Partner with business stakeholders to design and deliver reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions.
Develop and publish data visualization and reporting products tailored to stakeholder needs, including operational, customer, and digital performance reporting where assigned.
Analyze data and communicate findings, trends, and recommendations.
Explore complex datasets to identify patterns and actionable business insights.
Apply analytical, statistical, and programming techniques to support decision-making.


Data Governance


Follow established governance standards and data stewardship practices.
Implement data quality controls and validation procedures.
Support the integrity, consistency, and documentation of agency and digital data assets, including business definitions, metadata, and data lineage where applicable.
Ensure solution is aligned with organizational architecture, security, and compliance standards.
Monitor and maintain reporting and analytical products to ensure continued business value.
Document code, processes, data lineage, business rules, and reporting logic.
Support data access management in accordance with established policies and procedures.


Influence


Enable, support, and encourage the use of data in decision-making.
Integrate with teams across the enterprise to understand subject matter and improve data maturity and culture change.
Provide technical guidance on assigned analytical solutions and promote consistent data practices across operational and digital business domains
Perform other duties of a similar nature or level.


Requirements

Minimum Qualifications


Demonstrated proficiency in implementing, configuring, and administering Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM), including digital tagging, event tracking, and data validation.
Three years of experience managing and querying data in a relational database environment (Snowflake, SQL Server, Oracle etc.).
Three years of experience in data analysis using advanced tools (R, Python etc.).
Two years of experience in developing business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable reporting and analytics platforms.
Two years of experience modeling data in Star Schema.
Experience working with structured, semi-structured or digital data sources.
Bachelor’s degree in statistics, computer science, mathematics, engineering, or a similar field.


An equivalent combination of education and experience to successfully perform the job duties is also accepted.

Knowledge Requirements


Strong knowledge of assigned department’s work program and data sources.
Sufficient knowledge of two other department’s work programs and data sources to provide review and backup assistance as needed.
Basic understanding of DevOps processes.
Working knowledge of organization data collection methods and, where applicable, digital analytics concepts such as event-based measurement, tagging, and customer interaction data.


Skill Requirements


Fostering an inclusive workplace by upholding Community Transit’s core values in support of the organization’s vision and mission. Inspiring team commitment, pride, and trust while promoting cooperation and motivating members to achieve shared goals. Demonstrating courtesy, sensitivity, and respect in all interactions.
Ability to frame business questions into data analysis problems and develop solutions.
Ability to integrate and analyze data from multiple agency-wide systems and digital platforms.
Ability to communicate analytical findings through reports, dashboards, visualizations, and presentations to technical and non-technical audiences.
Proficient in intermediate data manipulation (data validation, window or custom functions, pivot/unpivot) and analysis using Excel, SQL, Dax, and Python/R.
Strong skills in Power BI report creation and Microsoft Fabric infrastructure (data lakes, workspaces, permissions, pipelines, etc.).
Ability to support implementation, validation, and maintenance of data collection and measurement solutions for enterprise applications and digital platforms, as assigned.
Data cleaning, validation, and review techniques.
Intermediate statistical skills for more complex data analysis (regression, clustering, hypothesis testing).
Strong problem-solving skills and critical thinking abilities.
Ability to work with limited supervision.
Ability to write technical documentation for standard processes.
Ability to communicate complex technical information to various audiences through reports and presentations.
Willingness to stay updated with the latest developments in the field of data analysis and engineering, and to continue learning and improving skills.
Strong organization and prioritization skills for handling multiple tasks and projects.
Team player: encouraging, communicative, supporting, contributing, and enthusiastic.


Certain knowledge and skill requirements may be learned or further developed after employment begins.

Working Conditions

Hybrid telework may be available. Availability is at management discretion and may not be available for this position based on the nature of the work. Work is performed in an office environment and requires the use of office equipment and technology. You will be required to move throughout and between different office buildings and may need to complete tasks in noisy environments. You may also be required to lift and carry materials up to 10 pounds occasionally. Some travel required less than 10% of the time.

Application and Selection Process


Only on-line applications accepted.
Applicants for this job may be considered for other openings up to six months after the date this position is filled.
Applicants who meet the minimum requirements may be scheduled for an interview as well as a variety of tests to demonstrate knowledge, and skills for the position. The evaluation process may include interviews, background check, reference checks and various performance tests.


Employee Benefits


Employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, basic life and disability insurance.
Employees participate in the Public Employees Retirement System (PERS) and have the option to enroll in the agency’s deferred compensation plan.
In addition to WA Paid Sick Leave, employees in this position, accrue of 24 days of Paid Time off (192 hours) in their first year and ten (10) paid holidays throughout the calendar year.
Full list of all benefits and details can be found here .

Title: Data Systems Integrator
Description:
Job Number: R0246369

Data Systems Integrator

The Opportunity:

You know that true progress is made at the intersection of business and tech, and as an IT business analyst, you're highly skilled in both. Here, you’ll have the chance to work with an agile team as they develop digital products to support your clients’ most pressing missions. We’re looking for someone like you to propel business analytics and processes forward, as well as delve into technology trends to deliver user‑friendly client experiences.

As an IT business analyst, you’ll develop leading‑edge systems and digital workflows. Partnering with your team of architects, developers, testers, business analysts, and data specialists, you’ll identify business needs, gather user requirements, and develop user stories. You’ll understand the overall direction and nuanced user needs clearly, and you’ll lead your team as they fulfill these needs by creating deployable features. Together, you’ll deliver high‑business‑value products to users across the enterprise.

Work with us to make an impact by supporting national‑level operational readiness and data‑driven decision‑making.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


3+ years of experience in data analysis, data workflow sustainment, or business process automation
Experience maintaining and troubleshooting Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate workflows
Experience administering Microsoft 365 and Excel or Power Query data processes
Experience developing automated dashboards, reports, and performance metrics
Knowledge of SharePoint Online site structures and content management, data integrity, validation, and audit practices for structured operational datasets
Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical workflows;
Ability to document processes, configuration standards, and user guidance and collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to resolve system issues
Secret clearance
HS diploma or GED
Ability to obtain DoD 8140 or 8570 IAT‑II Certification such as Security+ Certification within 6 months of hire date



Nice If You Have:


Experience supporting operational or regulated technical environments
Experience transitioning workflows developed by advisory organizations
Knowledge of Power BI dashboard development
Knowledge of controlled information handling standards including UNNPI and CUI



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required. 

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

As the Business Intelligence Analyst, you turn enterprise and site data into trusted reporting, metric consistency, and actionable insight that improves operational visibility, financial confidence, and decision-making. You design and support dashboards, semantic models, and recurring reporting, partnering closely with business process owners, ERP stakeholders, and the enterprise data organization to create reliable, governed, and scalable BI solutions. Your work strengthens reporting clarity, reduces manual effort, and supports enterprise-wide performance and integration efforts.

Responsibilities


Designs, builds, and maintains business intelligence dashboards, scorecards, data visualizations, and recurring reports.
Translates business requirements into reporting specifications, data models, governed metrics, calculations, and visual layouts.
Develops and optimizes Power BI reports, semantic models, dataflows, measures, transformations, and templates aligned to enterprise standards.
Manages Power BI workspace practices, publishing, gateways, security models, refresh schedules, lineage, and performance optimization.
Partners with ERP and business systems owners to understand data structures, transactional flows, reporting gaps, and process dependencies.
Supports reporting across ERP-enabled processes and assists with data validation, reconciliation, cleanup, and standardization.
Analyzes data to identify trends, exceptions, risks, and performance gaps, and communicates insights to technical and non-technical audiences.
Builds and maintains BI datasets, reporting layers, semantic models, and certified data products while documenting sources, lineage, calculations, and known limitations.
Partners with functional owners to standardize reporting definitions, ensure process alignment, and support workshops, requirements sessions, and user acceptance testing.
Supports executive reporting, portfolio visibility, value tracking, and benefits realization with concise, accurate, decision-oriented outputs.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in business analytics, information systems, data analytics, computer science, finance, operations, engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
Three or more years of hands-on experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) reporting, or business systems analysis.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, data models, scorecards, or analytics solutions for business users.
Strong Excel capability and working proficiency with Structured Query Language (SQL), relational data concepts, joins, aggregation, validation, and troubleshooting.
Demonstrated experience building dashboards and semantic models using several of the following: Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Data Analysis Expressions (DAX), Power Query, dataflows, gateways, workspace permissions, row-level security, refresh monitoring, deployment pipelines, or performance optimization.
Hands-on experience with an enterprise BI platform; recent Microsoft Power BI experience strongly preferred.
Ability to gather requirements, analyze business processes, document reporting needs, and translate them into BI solutions.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to identify trends, gaps, exceptions, and root causes.
Experience partnering with stakeholders across functions such as operations, finance, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, engineering, programs, or human resources (HR).
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data, metrics, assumptions, and insights clearly.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple reporting requests and priorities in a fast-paced environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Microsoft Power BI including dashboard development, semantic models, Power Query, DAX, dataflows, workspace management, gateways, permissions, refresh schedules, or performance optimization.
Experience with Epicor ERP or similar platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, or NetSuite.
Experience reporting on manufacturing, quality, supply chain, finance, inventory, production, program, or operational performance.
Experience with Epicor business activity queries (BAQs), dashboards, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Data Management Tool (DMT), REST APIs, SQL Server, Power Query, DAX, dataflows, or semantic models.
Familiarity with data governance, master data management, data quality, metadata, reporting standards, and system‑of‑record decisions.
Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, or related Microsoft data tools.
Familiarity with SOX, Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC), National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800‑171, Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), controlled unclassified information (CUI), access controls, or audit‑driven reporting environments.
Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), site reporting standardization, ERP harmonization, or enterprise reporting consolidation.
Power BI, Microsoft Data Analyst, SQL, Epicor, Lean Six Sigma, business analysis, or analytics-related certification preferred.


This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

Benefits


Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid time off
Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
Company‑paid life and AD\&D insurance
Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
Tuition reimbursement


Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst, Returns SX
Description:
Description

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights and identifying opportunities through the use of business intelligence, data mining and visualization techniques. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. The candidate should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and present the insights in concise and effective manner. Additionally, the candidate should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impacts the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities


Use analytics and data mining techniques to solve complex problems and drive business decisions.
Employ the appropriate tools, methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse and help reduce bad debt
Dive into customer behavioral patterns and recommend the policy change hypothesis
Solve analytical problems, and effectively communicate methodologies and results
Build analyses for product launches and provide launch recommendations
Draw inferences and conclusions, and create dashboards and visualizations of processed data, identify trends, anomalies
Work closely with internal stakeholders such as business teams, engineering teams, and partner teams and align them with respect to your focus area


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System program experience
3+ years of maintenance planner/scheduler in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, or distribution industries experience
3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
Bachelor's degree in relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) full time experience
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
Experience in MS Access and SQL
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience using Microsoft Projects software
Experience with material handling systems (MHS) installation, operation and maintenance
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Title: Product Analyst
Description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About this role:

As a Product Analyst at Liftoff, you'll turn complex data into rigorous analysis that informs product decisions across our machine learning-powered platform. You'll own the analytical needs of your product team end to end: identifying the right questions, executing the analysis, and presenting results that shape what gets built. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Machine Learning Engineers to define success metrics, evaluate experiments, and understand the drivers of user behavior and advertising performance.

Responsibilities:


Source, scope, execute, and present analyses for your product team, working independently from question to recommendation.
Partner with Product Managers and ML teams to define and monitor key success metrics for product features.
Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments with statistical rigor.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that enable transparent, self-service monitoring of product performance.
Develop reusable SQL, analytical notebooks, and lightweight frameworks, including LLM-assisted workflows, to streamline recurring analyses.
Investigate unexpected changes in product or business performance and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
Build a strong working knowledge of Liftoff's core data tables, your product area, and the wider product suite.
Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to ensure data quality, metric consistency, and reliable instrumentation.
Document analytical approaches, assumptions, and methodologies to support reproducibility.
Other duties as assigned.


Requirements:


5+ years of experience in analytics
Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Experience delivering analytical projects independently, from scoping through to presentation.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar).
Degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


Location:

This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities in the Pacific Time Zone: California, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington (State).

Description:

Description

The purpose of this team is to support supply chain operations by ensuring accurate data collection, maintenance, and availability of required deliverables prior to project launches.

Key Projects

This role involves designing and implementing Power BI dashboards, AI-assisted solutions, and automated processes that identify, measure, and resolve data quality issues across enterprise systems, including OnePDM (Aras), Dynamics 365, and enterprise data platforms.




Candidate Requirements

Degrees or certifications required: Candidates with a bachelor's degree are highly preferred.




Required Skills & Experience

4 years of experience in relevant fields.
Experience designing and developing Power BI dashboards and business intelligence solutions.
Experience using Copilot, prompt engineering, AI agents, or similar AI technologies to solve business problems and automate processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including data quality assessment and root cause analysis.
Experience working with large and complex datasets across multiple systems.
Experience leading data quality, governance, remediation, or process improvement initiatives.
Demonstrated project management skills, including stakeholder management, issue resolution, and driving actions to closure.
Experience creating process documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to independently gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver results with minimal oversight.




Job Overview

The team is seeking a Business Intelligence & Data Quality Analyst to improve the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of critical supply chain master data. This role will design and implement Power BI dashboards, AI-assisted solutions, and automated processes that identify, measure, and resolve data quality issues across enterprise systems, including OnePDM (Aras), Dynamics 365, and enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate combines business intelligence development, data analysis, AI solution design, and project leadership to drive measurable improvements in data quality and operational efficiency.




Key Responsibilities

Develop Power BI dashboards and analytics solutions that provide visibility into data quality trends, exceptions, and key performance indicators.
Build AI-assisted solutions using Copilot, prompt engineering, and AI agents to improve data analysis and operational efficiency.
Analyze data across multiple systems to identify inconsistencies, duplicates, missing attributes, and process gaps.
Perform root cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions to prevent recurring issues.
Lead data remediation initiatives and coordinate stakeholders to ensure corrective actions are completed.
Establish data quality metrics, monitoring processes, and governance controls.
Create and maintain process documentation, business rules, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable and sustainable solutions.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience with SQL, data modeling, data lakes, or enterprise data platforms.
Experience with ERP, PLM, MRP, or supply chain systems.
Experience with Dynamics 365 and/or Aras Innovator (OnePDM).
Familiarity with master data management and data governance principles.
Experience working in manufacturing, engineering, or supply chain environments.




What Success Looks Like

Within the first six months, the successful candidate will:

Deliver a scalable dashboard and/or AI-based solution for monitoring and improving data quality.
Establish meaningful data quality metrics and reporting.
Identify and prioritize high-impact data issues across systems.
Drive remediation efforts through stakeholder engagement and project leadership.
Create sustainable processes and documentation that reduce recurring manual effort and improve long-term data quality.




Additional Expectations

This role is expected to operate with a high degree of independence. The successful candidate will gather requirements directly from stakeholders, design and develop solutions, manage implementation activities, and drive adoption with minimal oversight. Candidates should be comfortable translating ambiguous business problems into production-ready business intelligence and AI-enabled solutions.




Top 3 Must-Have HARD Skills & Years of Experience for Each

Experience with SQL, data modeling, data lakes, or enterprise data platforms: 2-4 years.
Experience with ERP, PLM, MRP, or supply chain systems: 2-4 years.
Experience with Dynamics 365 and/or Aras Innovator (OnePDM): 2-4 years.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As a Lunar Data Applications Engineer, you are responsible for building data models, crafting intuitive visuals, and providing analysis that helps Blue Origin build a road to the Moon. Within the Lunar business operations organization, we build relationships with budget owners to technical design teams that cover the design, build, and operate lifecycle. Our team accelerates program operations and strengthens the value of analytics in modern aerospace.

We are looking for someone to apply technical expertise, customer focus, and dedication to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight.

Active listening, digs into root causes, and translates pain points into actionable solutions
Demonstrates strong business acumen and understands complex program operations
Takes ownership of ambiguous problems and delivers high-quality solutions independently
Creates intuitive data visualizations that tell compelling stories and drive adoption
Writes clear documentation that enables others to understand and extend your work
Thrives in fast-paced environments where priorities shift as programs evolve


Key Responsibilities


Designs and builds data models supporting Lunar program planning, tracking configuration, schedule, and technical performance across Lunar Permanence programs
Creates dashboards and key metrics used by program leadership for decision-making and business reviews
Develops automated data pipelines using Python and SQL to enable teams across engineering, supply chain, configuration management, production, and operations
Partners with budget owners and technical teams to identify analytics needs and deliver self-service reporting solutions
Leads technical data modeling efforts for cross-functional analyses spanning multiple Lunar programs
Establishes data quality standards and documentation practices that enable team scalability


Minimum Qualifications


Passion For Our Mission: Millions of people living and working in space!
4+ years SQL experience with either Python, and/or Spark as a plus
Demonstrable experience with GenAI tools to generate, review, and deploy code, especially data reporting tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Databricks Apps)
Experience with professional visualization tools (e.g. Databricks / Tableau / PowerBI / etc.)
Experience working with customers to gather requirements and present data solutions


Preferred Qualifications


2+ years building models and reports with Databricks (preferably with Certified Data Analyst Associate)
Experience using Git, Gitlab for code management (Branching / Merging, CI/CD, Variables, Deployment)
Experience building automated data pipelines using Python, DBSQL, and/or Spark
Experience with AWS infrastructure and tools (ECS, RDS, Lambda, etc.)
Experience with hierarchical data structures, especially with hardware bill of materials and production plans
Domain knowledge in engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and/or aerospace

Title: Digital Analyst
Description:
Overview

REI Co-op is united around discovering, building and celebrating better ways of working in this world, all so that folks can find and pursue a love of the outdoors. When you work for the co-op, you do your best work with the support to live your best life. And you play a part in shaping the future of the outdoors, for people and our planet.

This role contributes to REI’s success by enabling better data-driven decision making, acting as an authoritative source for A/B testing, forecasting, advanced analytics, planning, data visualization, and statistical design. Specifically, this role will support Digital product teams through planning and analysis of A/B tests, as well as analytic data specifications and analytic data quality control.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities and Qualifications


Execute projects, reports, and insights to primary stakeholders under the guidance of a senior or principal analyst
Plan and analyze A/B and multivariate test activities (planning, design, execution, analysis)
Apply principles underlying statistical analysis (e.g. variance, population differences, effect size, significance)
Write and edit queries (SQL preferred) to retrieve data from relational databases
Produce compelling data visualizations
Support the Digital Product team as it relates to the annual budget and quarterly forecast process, delivering business performance metrics, and identifying upcoming risks and opportunities
Utilize advanced modeling tools (e.g. R, Python, SAS, SPSS)
Effectively communicates a summary of customer performance to stakeholders
Create visually effective interactive dashboards that lead to insights and actionable recommendations



Required Skills And Experience


Undergraduate degree with 2-3 years of related experience, OR an advanced degree in quantitative field, business, psychology, or marketing-related major with 1 year of experience
Ability to effectively create data driven stories for stakeholders with a bias for understanding and action
Experience with web-based analytics tools (Adobe Analytics preferred)
Familiar with the principles underlying statistical analysis (e.g. variance, population differences, effect size, significance), including Bayesian statistics, and can apply them to analysis design with supervision
Demonstrated experience with visualization programs like Sigma or Tableau, including a solid understanding of preparing data and writing calculations
Proficiency with data models and schemas
Experience with cloud-based data and AI platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks)
Familiarity with data transformation frameworks (e.g. dbt, SQLMesh, Alteryx)
Familiarity or experience with AI-powered agentic coding assistants
Experience building visually effective interactive dashboards that lead to insights and actionable recommendations
Consistently demonstrates ability to shape story around data where there is a clear problem statement, hypothesis, evidence of the hypothesis, results, and clear recommendations
Ability to clearly convey and accurately receive information from a variety of methods and in various situations



Preferred Qualifications


Proficiency with SQL, R, or other programming languages for querying relational databases
Experience with A/B and multivariate test activities (planning, design, execution, analysis) and A/B testing platforms (e.g. Adobe Target, Optimizely, VWO, GrowthBook)
Experience with statistical analysis and/or advanced modeling tools (e.g. SAS, SPSS, R, Python)
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Tableau, PowerBI)



Closing

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
About Starform

Starform is a ~25-person studio building bold, new multiplayer games. Our first title, Metalstorm — a 5v5 arcade air-combat game — has reached over 15 million players worldwide. We operate leveraging AI to be more ambitious: small team, high bar, AI woven into workflows that make sense. We believe that a small team of the right people, moving fast with modern tools, out-builds studios ten times our size.




The Role

Your analysis moves real decisions weekly: where UA dollars go, which experiments ship, how the game economy gets tuned. There's no analytics bureaucracy here — the distance between your work and a decision is one conversation, and the decisions are often critical to the team’s direction and decision-making.




What You'll Do

Own UA and ROAS analysis. Build cohort-level ROAS and payback curves from MMP data (we use Singular), separate signal from attribution noise, and make scale/hold/kill recommendations on live campaigns.
Analyze the game economy. Track sinks, sources, conversion, and progression — how players actually move through new systems, not how we hoped they would.
Help Design and read experiments. A/B tests across events, offers, onboarding, and pricing, with honest uncertainty and a clear recommendation every time.
Run the studio's vital signs. Weekly top-line metrics and monthly retention deep dives by geography, cohort, platform.
Build AI-assisted analysis workflows. Agents and pipelines that pull, clean, and pre-analyze data so your time goes to judgment, not plumbing.




What We're Looking For

3+ years of quantitative analysis on a live product; free-to-play experience strongly preferred.
Expert SQL.
Real statistical judgment: experimental design, uncertainty, and the classic traps — selection effects, survivorship, immature cohorts. You know why a forward-filled ROAS curve lies.
AI-fluent. You already use LLMs and agents daily in your analysis work, and you can show us how.
You communicate like a decision is on the line: clear writing, plain language for non-technical audiences, and you always land on a recommendation.
You actually play games — Candy Crush, Halo, or anything in between.




Nice to Have

Redshift and Hex (our stack), or comparable warehouse/BI tools.
Attribution/MMP data experience (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust).
LTV, payback, and predictive modeling; marketing analytics.
Live-ops or virtual-economy analytics.

Title: Financial Systems Analyst, Automation & Analytics
Description:
Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (MPS) is one of the fastest growing companies in the Semiconductor industry. We are worldwide technical leaders in Integrated Power Semiconductors and Systems Power delivery architectures. At MPS, we cultivate creativity, are passionate about sustainability, and are committed to providing leading-edge products and innovation to our customers. Our portfolio of technology helps power our world ---come join our team and see how YOU can make a difference.

Job Description

Job Summary

We are transforming Finance at MPS. We are looking for candidates who can help us build the future. We are investing in the systems, data, and automation that will allow us to scale the business. We are looking to grow our team with true builders that have an entrepreneurial mindset. This role will be part of the foundation team that is designing, building, and implementing systems and automated workflows across Finance. At MPS systems and automation are not separate from the business, so this role will play a critical part in supporting FP&A activities through the lens of enabling speed and efficiency. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, comfortable operating with ambiguity, and energized by building things that don't yet exist.

Key Responsibilities

Systems & Automation (Primary Focus)


Design, build, and scale automated workflows and system integrations that reduce manual effort across Finance processes (close, reporting, forecasting, reconciliations).
Own the roadmap for automation opportunities. Identify high-friction manual processes, prototype solutions, and drive them to production.
Build and maintain ETL pipelines, dashboards, and analytics infrastructure from ingestion through analysis.
Serve as a Center of Excellence for Finance's core systems (e.g., Databricks, Power BI, ERP/IFS Cloud), providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support to the broader team.
Evaluate and pilot emerging tools, including AI/LLM-based workflows, to further automate and scale Finance operations.
Maintain system and process documentation and ensure data governance standards are followed.


FP&A Support (Secondary Focus, Systems-Oriented)


Support monthly close and management reporting by building and automating the underlying reporting infrastructure, not by performing manual variance analysis.
Partner with FP&A and Accounting to translate recurring, manual analytical work into repeatable, self-service systems and tools.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Accounting, IT, business units) to gather requirements and ensure systems solutions meet FP&A's needs.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or other quantitative fields.
3–5 years of experience in a role combining data/systems work with finance or accounting exposure.
A builder mindset demonstrated. Examples of having independently designed, built, or automated a tool, process, or system will be required.
Self-starter with an entrepreneurial approach: comfortable defining your own roadmap, working through ambiguity, and driving projects from idea to production with minimal oversight.
Proficiency with Databricks and one or more data analysis/visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Python, Alteryx, or SQL (Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server), plus advanced Excel skills.
Experience with data warehousing, database management, and/or data modeling.
Familiarity with utilizing LLMs/AI tools in workflows.
Experience with Enterprise Financial Forecasting/EPM tools (Hyperion, OneStream, Anaplan, Planful) is a plus.
Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Strong desire and willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly.


Locations


Kirkland, WA
West Palm Beach, FL


MPS offers a comprehensive benefits package. We provide health care coverage, dental and vision, and life and disability protection. Employees in sales positions may be eligible for our sales incentive bonuses. Employees in certain positions may be eligible for stock compensation. For more information on MPS’ benefits please view our company website at www.monolithicpower.com.

Pay is based on market location and may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education and other job-related reasons. The target hiring range for this position is $75,000 – $110,000 annually.

Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Description:
The Washington State Housing Finance Commission (WSHFC) is currently recruiting for a full-time, permanent Business Intelligence Specialist in the Information Technology Division.




The Information Technology Division at the Washington State Housing Finance Commission works to support the commission staff to accomplish the commission's goals and objectives. This position is one of ten positions within the Information Technology Division and is responsible for all Commission systems that store and manage the Commission’s data. This position is one of five positions within the Information Technology Data Management unit responsible for maintaining the Commission’s data systems.




The primary focus of this position is working closely with the Laserfiche Administrator to design, implement, and maintain automated document repository workflows and Business Intelligence solutions. The Business Intelligence Specialist maintains high system availability, manages secure and compliant electronic records storage, and leads projects to completion within strict deadlines and budgets. In doing so, this role drives overall operational efficiency and continuous process improvement across the organization.




The duty station for this position is Seattle, WA. The work associated with this position will be performed through a combination of teleworking and complemented with on-site work and meetings as needed. Employees are required to work in the Seattle office at least once a week and may need to come in more frequently based on Division needs. Employees must reside in Washington state and within a reasonable distance of our worksite to respond to workplace reporting requirements.




Who we are:

The Commission is a market-driven and self-supporting agency created to provide below-market rate financing for building, purchasing, or preserving affordable housing and nonprofit capital facilities. The Commission functions as a financing conduit between developers, lenders, first-time home buyers, real estate professionals, and nonprofit organizations to provide affordable financing for homes, rental housing, civic and social services facilities, energy conservation projects and first-time farmers and ranchers. 




We believe that creating a diverse, inclusive, and equitable environment is important and vital to the success of the Commission. We believe in working together to create an environment free from harassment and discrimination and moving beyond simple tolerance to embracing and celebrating the rich dimensions of diversity contained within each individual. 

Principal Responsibilities:




·      Lead and manage projects implementing and using new BI software tools and systems

·      Integrate BI platforms with existing enterprise systems and applications

·      Develop the semantic layer, metadata, reports, and report definitions

·      Analyze user requirements to design functional specifications

·      Design and deliver end user training while providing ongoing technical support

·      Promote BI benefits and usage across relevant divisions within the organization

·      Implement integration plans for electronic records with internal and external portals, document repositories, and content management systems

·      Establish policies and standards to verify that electronic records remain uniform, secure, compliant, and rapidly accessible to authorized staff

·      Formulate and execute records retention and disposal plans for official business records

·      Evaluate tools, track industry developments, and collaborate with systems experts to support hardware, software, and quality assurance processes

·      Work on additional special projects throughout the year as identified by management and perform other duties as assigned.

We are most interested in candidates who meet or exceed the following criteria:




·      Demonstrated skill configuring, maintaining, and integrating tier one applications, databases, and data warehouses, including MS SQL Server, Power BI, Crystal Reports, Laserfiche, CRM, and SaaS platforms

·      Proficiency in analyzing user requirements to design, build, and deploy front end BI applications according to functional specifications

·      Extensive experience working with relational database structures, theories, principles, practices, and database design tools

·      Comprehensive knowledge of the full project management and software development lifecycle from inception to execution

·      Proven ability to provide effective customer service and technical support for IT systems and software applications

·      Familiarity with public information requests and managing associated workflows through specialized software platforms

·      Ability to Take Action to Learn and Grow: Candidates who are curious about themselves and others, take responsibility for knowing their own strengths and weaknesses, and use that learning to make government programs more efficient and effective to serve all Washingtonians. This includes staying current on new solutions and adapting to a changing IT environment to meet the Commission’s needs.

·      Ability to Take Action to Meet the Needs of Others: Candidates who are flexible, adaptable, and customer-service focused, demonstrating a willingness to empathetically respond to the unique needs of colleagues and the public. This includes collaborating across the Commission to overcome challenges, find solutions, and adapt communication styles to different communities and individuals.




Preferred/Desired:




·      A Bachelor's and/or Master's Degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or related field

·      Experience with Salesforce

·      Experience with Laserfiche




A combination of skills, abilities, experience, and education may be substituted to demonstrate that you are qualified for this position. If you don't meet all the qualifications, we still encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences and perspectives, and you may have skills that are a great match for our team




Benefits:        

We offer a generous benefits package that includes a full array of family medical, dental, life and long-term disability insurance coverage; a state retirement plan; deferred compensation; 12 paid holidays; paid vacation, sick and military leave; subsidized bus, train, or ferry passes; credit union memberships; alternate workweek schedules, and telecommuting.




The hiring range for this position is $7,508 to $8,497 Monthly. However, the full salary range for this position is $7,508 to $10,098 Monthly. We may go higher based on the following: experience, internal equity, and market. Salary is negotiable




Application Procedures:

Applicants who meet the qualifications are asked to submit all the following items to be considered for this position:




Completed NEOGOV online application: https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/washington/jobs/5443328/business-intelligence-specialist
Cover letter describing how your skills and experience align with the stated job responsibilities and qualifications.
List of three or more professional references. (all references must be current and/or former supervisor/managers)
Current resume indicating relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and education.




Web Site: http://www.wshfc.org.




Applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The recruitment process will be open until filled. First review of applications is August 24th, 2026.

Please include your name and pronouns in your application to ensure we address you appropriately throughout the application process.

To qualify and receive veteran’s preference, you must attach a copy of the discharge, DD214 or NGB Form 22, with your application materials.

By submitting the application materials, you are indicating that all information is true and correct to the best of your knowledge. You understand that the Housing Finance Commission may verify information and that untruthful or misleading information is cause for removal from the applicant pool or dismissal if employed. Only those individuals who clearly demonstrate the stated qualifications will be considered.

We strive to create a working environment that includes and respects cultural, racial, ethnic, sexual orientation and gender identity diversity. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to all staff as needed. Women, black, Indigenous and people of color, persons with disabilities, persons over 40 years of age, all honorably discharged veterans and people of all sexual orientations and gender identities are encouraged to apply. Persons needing accommodation in the application process or this announcement in an alternative format may contact the WSHFC Recruiting Team at Christopher.vasquez@wshfc.org or at (206) 287-4439.

Title: Data Analyst II - Marketing Analytics
Description:
As a Data Analyst II within Marketing Analytics, you’ll perform in-depth analyses to best evaluate marketing investment and drive optimal spending decisions. You will build scalable reporting solutions that enable confident, data-driven decision-making and deliver reliable data-driven insights that contribute to marketing strategy, while working closely with predictive models and forecasting algorithms.

About The Role


Be a subject matter expert on marketing measurement.
Leverage analytical expertise and sound statistical reasoning to deliver clear, meaningful insights to complex, ambiguous questions.
Build and maintain Tableau dashboards, communicating trends and opportunities to stakeholders.
Collaborate with team members to review analyses, code, and dashboards, ensuring high-quality deliverables that answer the right questions.


About You


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field required; advanced degree a plus.

Strong background in statistical analysis, with practical experience in experimental design, forecasting, and incrementality testing, and understanding of foundational statistical concepts (conditional probability, causal inference, statistical significance).
Experience reporting on and analyzing outputs from machine learning models.
Experience using AI code generation tools such as Snowflake Intelligence, Github CoPilot, and Anthropic Claude Code.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and build alignment.
Strong communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to non-technical audiences in both written and verbal formats.
Strong curiosity that doesn’t stop at the “What?” but seeks to understand the “Why?” and “What if?”

Title: Site Operations Capacity Analyst
Description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate


Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.
Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.


The Supply Chain Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on


Supply compute at a scale of 10s to 100s of GWs, the largest build out of compute in history. Qualify and dual-source across every critical equipment category, with lead-time and capacity thresholds tied directly to the forward build pipeline.
Make supply chain the reason we build faster than anyone. Our modular build redefines speed in this industry, and it lives or dies on supply chain. Keep procurement permanently off the critical path so schedule compression stays our advantage, not our constraint.
Build the most accurate supply chain prediction modelling that exists. Use the frontier of AI to forecast lead times, demand, and disruption with a precision the industry has never had, and turn that foresight into a structural edge.


Role Scope


Model capacity across the fleet: power, space, cooling, and compute, so allocation decisions run on numbers, not recollection.
Track capacity consumption against plan and flag constraints quarters before they bind.
Build the reporting that connects deployment schedules to sellable capacity for commercial and leadership.
Run scenario analysis for deal and allocation decisions: what fits where, by when, at what displacement.


What We're Looking For


The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.
You've done capacity, utilization, or demand analysis for infrastructure, data centers, cloud, or heavy industry.
You build models in SQL or Python that others rely on, and you version them like it matters.
You translate analysis into a one-page answer an executive can act on.
You chase down data quality problems to the source instead of footnoting them.
Bonus: Data center capacity planning. Power systems knowledge. BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Hex). Cloud capacity or fleet economics.


We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application-- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

Compensation Range: $180K - $250K

Title: Demand and Revenue Management Analyst
Description:
Job Description

At Seabourn, we are passionate about travel. We believe that traveling for pleasure has a redemptive power that enriches people’s lives. And we believe that people should travel well. Seabourn pioneered small-ship, ultra-luxury cruising, and continues to represent the pinnacle of that unique style of travel.

We’re looking for an experienced Demand & Revenue Management Analyst to fill this hybrid role which is based in our Seattle office. The Revenue Management Analyst is responsible for optimizing the commercial performance of assigned Seabourn sailings through strategic pricing, inventory management, and demand forecasting. The role oversees pricing and inventory decisions across independent traveler, group, and contracted business segments, continuously balancing occupancy, yield, and revenue objectives at the cabin-category level. By leveraging multiple business intelligence sources and revenue management systems, the Analyst monitors booking performance, market conditions, and competitive activity to identify opportunities that maximize net ticket revenue while supporting the overall commercial strategy for the brand.

Here’s a summary of what Seabourn is looking for in its Demand & Revenue Management Analyst. Is this you?

Responsibilities


Revenue Optimization & Pricing Strategy
Lead pricing and inventory strategy for assigned sailings, managing independent traveler, group, and contract pricing at the cabin-category level to maximize net revenue and occupancy.
Analyze booking, pricing, and inventory data to identify yield optimization opportunities and evaluate pricing, inventory management & commercial actions.
Develop and recommend data-driven pricing and inventory actions, ensuring timely execution and alignment with promotional and commercial objectives.
Monitor and manage capacity risk, including oversells, buy-offs, and buy-downs, to protect revenue performance and inventory integrity.
Performance Analysis & Commercial Insights
Produce regular performance reporting on bookings, revenue, pace, forecasts, risks, and recommended actions for leadership review and trading meetings.
Monitor competitive pricing, promotional activity, product positioning, and broader travel industry trends to inform revenue decisions.
Translate booking trends, demand signals, and market performance into actionable insights that support commercial strategy and future business planning.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting and analytics capabilities by designing, building, and productionalizing scalable tools, dashboards, and automated reporting solutions that support commercial decision-making and team efficiency
Strategic Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Commercial leadership to stimulate demand and support strategic decision-making through data-driven recommendations.
Serve as a Revenue Management representative across the organization, responding to business needs and providing analytical support to stakeholders.
Share demand and booking trend insights with Deployment Planning teams to influence future itineraries, deployment strategies, and market investment decisions.
Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
Maintain data accuracy and integrity across revenue management systems through validation, documentation, and reporting support.
Support and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of pricing, inventory management, reporting, and analytical processes.
Ensure revenue management processes and system updates are executed accurately and consistently to support business objectives.
Perform other duties as assigned.


Requirements


Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, Revenue Management, Commercial Planning, Sales, or Finance.
Strong analytical, communication & organizational skills essential.
Ability to analyze data, make decisions and be accountable for bottom-line performance.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of database and report writing tools.
Effective interpersonal and communication skills.
Comfortable speaking with senior leadership.
2 years of related revenue management experience preferred
Familiarity with cruise or travel-industry revenue management concepts preferred
Knowledge of the cruise industry business environment, including marketing, sales, and operations
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Holland America is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time (e.g., H-1B status).


Please note that this is a hybrid position based in Seattle, WA or Miami, FL. Candidates must be comfortable coming into the office 4 days/week (Monday -Thursday).

What You Can Expect


Cruise and Travel Privileges for You and Your Family
Health Benefits
401(k)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Training & Professional Development
Tuition & Professional Certification Reimbursement
Rewards & Incentives
Salary Range: $75,000 -$95,000. The range is applicable for the labor market where the role is intended to be hired. Final base salary is directly related to each candidates' qualifications and experience uniquely.

in the communities we touch and serve, and our shipboard and shoreside employees. Please visit our site to learn more about our Culture Essentials, Corporate Vision Statement and our Core Values at: https://www.seabourn.com/en_US/our-company/mission-values.html

Title: Data Analyst 3 - Store Operations
Description:
Job Description

The Data Analyst 3 is a lead member of the Store Operations Data Analytics team which owns the acquisition and delivery of data and insights for Store Operations initiatives impacting Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack stores. The ideal candidate can think strategically and creatively about the needs of the business, build productive relationships with a diverse array of stakeholders, and provide ongoing data support that will produce quantitative analysis, drive meaningful action, and improve store-level performance. This individual operates as a Looker developer and AI-native analyst — building, maintaining, and continuously improving a modern reporting suite powered by Looker and accelerated by AI tools including Claude. They will keep a constant pulse on all Store Operations initiatives and priorities and influence change through compelling, accurate, and timely data delivery.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter and strong technical contributor who is always looking for new opportunities to solve business problems with data-driven tools. The individual should be highly curious about how the business works and possess the skills to unlock rich, nuanced insights from complicated data and communicate those insights in a way that drives positive business outcomes. Proficiency with Looker (LookML development, Explores, dashboards) and active use of AI tools — particularly Claude — for development acceleration, analysis, and workflow automation are required competencies for this role.

Store Operations Responsibilities


Own “the truth” in Store Operations data through governance and process including the acquisition, management, automation, and integrity of all data
Champion the data needs and priorities of the HQ Store Operations team, coordinating with key business/data/tech partners across the Nordstrom organization
Own requirements gathering for Store Operations Looker projects; document business needs, metric definitions, and stakeholder sign-off in alignment with SODA SOP standards prior to development
Maintain and improve the SODA Looker reporting suite, proactively identifying gaps, deprecating legacy content, and applying AI-assisted workflows to drive continuous improvement


Key Responsibilities


Collaborate with team members and business partners to deliver high quality solutions and recommendations to a variety of problems
Dive deep into complex business problems and provide insights on performance through hypothesis testing and monitoring trends in key metrics
Develop and manage the environment of reports and analysis delivering a simple and organized user access and experience
Maintains consistent Jira hygiene including daily worklogging, real-time ticket updates, active sprint participation, and proactive communication of blockers and timeline risks before deadlines are missed.
Experience writing custom LookML dimensions and measures including conditional logic, type casting, and field-level governance; ability to debug Explore SQL and validate output against source systems
Design, build, and maintain Looker dashboards and Explores using LookML; leverage AI tools including Claude to accelerate development, validate data accuracy, and improve delivery speed
Validate data accuracy throughout development by cross-referencing outputs against source systems; document validation steps and findings in Jira per SODA data validation SOP
Demonstrate ability to submit, manage, and iterate on GitHub pull requests through the full lifecycle — from initial submission through internal code review participation, feedback response, merge conflict resolution, and final deployment; operates in alignment with Nordstrom LookML Coding Standards and holds a high bar for production-ready quality before merge.
Support the analysis and diagnosis around business performance and provide expert guidance to improve results
Use advanced analytical and statistical practices to create thorough and actionable insights
Excel at compelling story telling with data, providing clear insights that bring facts to support business hypothesis and anecdotes
Influence leadership and program management through fact-based recommendation using data analysis
Mentor and support junior analysts (DA1/DA2) on LookML development, SQL best practices, data validation techniques, and AI-assisted workflows; contribute to team knowledge base and SOPs


Qualifications


3-5 years of professional experience querying, transforming, and analyzing large operational datasets using SQL and cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery), with a track record of translating data into actionable business recommendations
3-5 years of experience in development, manipulation, and management of large data sets from various relational databases using SQL
3-5 years of hands-on Looker development experience, including LookML authoring, Explore configuration, and dashboard design for operational or retail reporting
Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Computer Science, Math, Engineering, Science, Business, or a related field with documented coursework in statistics or business analytics
Demonstrated experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code) for development acceleration, code generation, data validation, and workflow automation; comfort working alongside AI as a standard part of the development workflow is required
Strong SQL skills required; experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) preferred; Python or other scripting languages a plus
Ability to be flexible and work in a fast-paced and dynamic organization
Clear and effective written and verbal communication for individuals at all levels of analytical expertise
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization
High degree of working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills
The ability to find innovative ways to resolve problems
Retail industry experience a plus

About The Job

In this role, you will be responsible for safeguarding the Google Ads ecosystem. This role is a blend of technical data analysis, strategic cross-functional leadership, and direct investigative work. You will use data to predict their next moves, influence how engineering teams build detection systems, and ensure that safety measures do not disrupt the experience for legitimate advertisers.

We are on a critical mission to protect Google's users and ensure online safety across core and emerging Ads products. Our team is at the forefront of raising the bar on content through coherent policies and scaled, effective enforcement. We have expanded beyond traditional product protections to manage emerging challenges—including brand safety, controversial content, violent extremism, and political interference driving expertise across Google's growing Ads ecosystem.

You will partner with key stakeholders to optimize operational performance, scale cross-functional initiatives, and lower abuse rates. You will deliver high-impact solutions with a focus on user trust, operational efficiency, and abuse mitigation strategies. You will align with product, policy, and engineering teams to implement scalable enforcement frameworks.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with cross-functional groups such as Product Manager (PM), Engineering, Sales and Legal to drive projects that increases users' safety and provide better online experience through Google Ads.
Execute complex queries and analyses, build visual models, and construct presentations on abuse trends to aid in fraud prevention and influence change in existing abuse detection systems without compromising advertiser experience.
Conduct investigations to catch fraudsters, enforce our product policies, learn scam patterns/ trends and identify product vulnerabilities.
Identify automation and efficiency opportunities and drive solutions through analysis or cross-functional partnerships

General Summary

The AI Applications & Data Analytics Lead is responsible for building and scaling practical AI and data solutions that drive measurable improvements in safety, production, cost, and performance across construction materials operations.

This role serves as the bridge between field operations and technology—turning operational data into actionable intelligence and deploying AI-enabled applications that improve decision-making, automate workflows, and enhance productivity.

Essential Job Accountabilities

Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, and services enabling real‑time and near‑real‑time operational insights. Analyze large datasets from production systems, quality labs, and equipment to generate actionable intelligence. Collaborate with operations, sales, quality, maintenance, and IT teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. Ensure AI solutions align with cybersecurity standards, company policies, and responsible AI practices. Document systems, models, and processes to support long‑term sustainability and user adoption. Continuously evaluate emerging AI and software technologies relevant to construction materials

Bachelor’s Degree in artificial intelligence, computer science, data science, mathematics, or related quantitative fields. Equivalent practical experience may be considered for candidates with a strong portfolio.

Experience working with databases, analytics platforms, and modern application architecture.

Operational and sales mindset focused on safety, quality, and efficiency
Collaborative and partnership mindset.
