Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Title: Finance Data Analyst – Financial Planning & Analysis
Description:
Alberta Blue Cross® is an Alberta based organization dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experience and community leadership. We’re committed to providing the best health coverage to over 1.8 million members and take an active role in promoting wellness. We believe in what we do—and place trust in our employees to deliver our vision.

Working at Alberta Blue Cross® means having a career where you’ll be recognized for your contributions. We value diversity, encourage our team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance and provide opportunities for career growth.

OVERVIEW:

Alberta Blue Cross is looking for a Finance Data Analyst to join our Financial Planning & Analysis team. Reporting to the Manager, Finance Intelligence and Analytics, the Data Analyst will be quality focused, passionate, a quick learner, self-motivated, analytical and detail oriented. They will ensure a high caliber of data quality and will support and collaborate with the other data teams in the organization. In this flexible work style arrangement, you will be able to work from home and go into office when required.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:


Collect and extract financial and operational data from internal systems and external sources.
Clean, validate, and prepare datasets to ensure accuracy and reliability for analysis.
Develop financial reports and analytics to support business and finance decision-making.
Interpret data trends and explain insights, variances, and findings to the finance team.
Participate in finance data projects, automation, and system enhancements.
Collaborate with Enterprise IT and analytics teams to create and maintain data pipelines and data governance for finance.
Support the maintenance of financial data models, metrics, and reporting tools.
Ensure adherence to data quality standards and contribute to continuous improvement.



WHAT YOU WILL HAVE:


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
3 years’ experience in a similar role in a finance department.
Strong foundation in quantitative analysis, data management, and financial concepts.
Analytically minded with hands on skills in Advanced Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, Power BI and the ability to work with large and diverse sets of data. Experience with other power platform tools is an asset.
Experience in data extraction.
Demonstrated ability to deal with change and excel in high-stress situations.
Ability to manage multiple responsibilities with varying priority to deliver timely results.
Commitment to a highly collaborative team environment including cross-training.
Knowledge of Workday Adaptive planning is an asset.



This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is selected.

Alberta Blue Cross® is an inclusive employer committed to a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We empower and are advocates for our team members by welcoming, respecting and valuing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

We offer the opportunity to work in an innovative, high-energy team-focused environment. If you have the qualifications we are looking for, apply online at careers.ab.bluecross.ca

A criminal record check satisfactory to Alberta Blue Cross will be required as a condition of employment, following a conditional offer.

Title: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist
Description:
POSITION TITLE: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist

DEPARTMENT: Finance, Administration & Information Technology

CLASSIFICATION: MGO-07

SALARY RANGE: Starting at $79,591.00 Per Annum

POSITION TYPE: Full-time, Permanent

LOCATION: Saskatoon

ACCOUNTABLE TO : Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT

Brief Overview

The Financial Database & Analytics Specialist is responsible for the profiling, development, integration, and optimization of enterprise databases and reporting solutions that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, performance measurement, and operational analysis. This position serves as the government's technical specialist in database profiling, data availability, systems integration, business intelligence, and analytical reporting, helping transform data from multiple systems into reliable information for decision-making across government.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Compliance, Governance & Risk Management


Profiles, develop, maintains, and optimizes enterprise databases, data models, and reporting structures that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, operational analysis, and performance measurement.
Supports the integration of data across finance, payroll, human resource, procurement, project management, funding agreement, and other government systems.


Financial Analysis & Decision Support


Provides technical and analytical support for budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, funding agreement reporting, trend analysis, key performance indicators, and executive reporting.
Works closely with Finance to ensure reliable information is available to support financial planning, resource allocation, reporting obligations, and decision-making.


Enterprise Reporting & Business Intelligence


Develops and maintains reports, dashboards, data extracts, automated reporting solutions, and analytical models that support government-wide reporting requirements.
Translate business requirements into practical database structures, queries, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions that improve accessibility and use of information while maintaining data security, privacy protection standards.


Data Quality, Automation & Continuous Improvement


Improves the accuracy, consistency, reliability, and accessibility of enterprise data used for financial and operational reporting.
Identifies opportunities to streamline reporting processes, automate recurring reporting requirements, reduce manual effort, and improve the efficiency of data collection and analysis activities across government.


Technical Documentation, Collaboration & Advisory Support


Develops and maintains technical documentation related to databases, data models, data flows, and system integrations.
Works collaboratively with ministries, departments, program areas, internal consulting teams, external consulting teams, Information Technology, and system vendors to assess data availability, recommend appropriate data structures and classifications, and support reporting and analytical requirements.
Other duties as assigned by the Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong proficiency in SQL, data extraction, transformation, and reporting development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the ability to translate reporting requirements into technical solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power Query, and financial data analysis tools.
Ability to assess data availability, relationships, and appropriate categorization across multiple systems.
Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
Understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, performance measurement, and government reporting environments.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years progressive financial analysis, database development or relevant experience.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SSRS, or equivalent.
An equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and progressively responsible experience may be considered


Additional Requirements


Must undergo a Criminal Record Check
Valid Saskatchewan driver’s license and access reliable transportation
Please submit your application by 9:59 PM on August 27, 2026.


Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Place: Open Hall, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Description:
Job Category: Developer

Job Type: Full Time

Job Location: Remote

Job status: Open

Job Description

About xCroTek

xCroTek is a product- and service-based AI software company that builds innovative, AI-powered solutions to drive intelligent automation and digital transformation. We specialize in creating scalable, impactful technologies for modern businesses.

Job Overview

We are seeking a skilled DOMO Developer to support our enterprise analytics initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing existing DOMO data marts, integrations, and reports, and will play a key role in optimising our data ecosystem. This role will involve creating detailed data mapping documents, defining business rules, and ensuring data consistency and accuracy across multiple systems.

Key Responsibilities


Analyse existing DOMO data marts, data pipelines, and source system integrations.
Review and optimize DOMO reports, dashboards, and overall implementation.
Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into data mapping documents and apply business rules.
Develop, maintain, and optimise complex SQL queries for data validation, transformation, and reporting purposes.
Perform in-depth data analysis and data modeling to support reporting and decision-making.
Collaborate with data engineers and architects on data integration and modeling best practices.
Provide insights and recommendations to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and scalability.
Leverage Snowflake (or other cloud data warehouses) for data exploration and integration support.


Required Skills


1–5 years of hands-on experience in business intelligence and analytics development.
Strong expertise in DOMO platform (data flows, data sets, cards, dashboards, and Magic ETL).
Excellent proficiency in SQL (writing, optimizing, and debugging queries across large data sets).
Solid understanding of data analysis, data modeling, and ETL processes.
Experience in documenting data mapping and business rules.
Exposure to Snowflake or similar modern cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Redshift, Azure Synapse).
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Effective communication skills to bridge technical details with business needs.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience in data governance, data quality, or metadata management.
Familiarity with integration tools (e.g., DOMO Workbench, APIs, or cloud connectors).
Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.


How To Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief cover letter explaining their interest in the role to hr@xcrotek.com. Please include “DOMO Developer/Data Analyst” in the subject line.

Apply with a one-page cover letter and CV to hr@xcrotek.com

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA Sports FC Live
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.


What We're Looking For


A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
Strong capabilities in project management processes
Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

The Data Analyst II plays a critical role in strengthening McCain’s enterprise data foundation as part of our digital transformation journey. This role is responsible for ensuring data is accurate, trusted, secure, and well-governed across the organization. By leading data quality initiatives, supporting metadata management, and operationalizing governance tools and policies, the Data Analyst II enables business teams to confidently leverage data for operational, reporting, and strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Be Doing.


Support and maintain enterprise data quality frameworks, ensuring accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness of data
Perform data profiling, cleansing, and monitoring using modern tools, including AI-enabled anomaly detection
Investigate data quality issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and remediation efforts
Collaborate with business and technical teams to define and track data quality KPIs and validation processes
Document business rules, validation logic, and exception handling procedures for critical datasets
Maintain enterprise data catalog and lineage, ensuring alignment with system changes and business needs
Partner with data engineers, architects, and stakeholders to capture data flows, transformations, and lineage
Utilize governance tools and AI-driven features to improve data classification, tagging, and discoverability
Support onboarding and training efforts for data governance tools, including developing user guides and documentation
Provide day-to-day support to users, troubleshooting governance tool issues and answering questions


What You’ll Need To Be Successful.


Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Technology, or related field
Minimum of 2 years of experience in data governance, data management, data engineering, or a related discipline
Strong understanding of metadata standards, data lineage, and data classification practices
Proficiency in SQL and/or Python for data profiling, validation, and analysis
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including data owners, stewards, IT, and business stakeholders
Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision
Preferred: Knowledge of CPG data structures, including product hierarchies and regulatory requirements
Preferred: Experience with governance tools such as Ataccama, Syniti, Collibra, MS Purview, Informatica, or Alation
Preferred: Exposure to AI governance and responsible AI practices

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Title: Jr. Data Analyst - ACX Corporate Support Edmonton
Description:
Join the ride!

Position : Jr. Data Analyst

Collision Centre: ACX Corporate Support Edmonton

Location: Edmonton, Alberta

Classification: Full-time, Immediate hire

Part of a bigger team!

ACX Corporate Support Edmonton is proud to be part of the AutoCanada Collision Centres’ network and a division of AutoCanada. AutoCanada is the largest Canadian owned and publicly traded automotive dealer group operating in Canada and the US. We are innovative, data-driven and our commitment to our Team Members, customers and operational excellence fuels our success. 

Our Team Members are at the heart of our success, building long-lasting, trust-based relationships with customers across Canada. Our national network provides opportunities and support to build the career that’s right for you. Working here is fast-paced, non-stop, and a little unpredictable—and we love it. 

Your area of focus.

You'll join the ACX (Collision Centre & Hail) Analytics & Innovation team at AutoCanada in an entry-level role focused on keeping our reporting suite running and helping migrate it from Tableau to Power BI. You'll grow into designing new dashboards, running data validation, and supporting stakeholders across our national collision repair network. Reporting into the Analytics & Innovation Lead, you'll get hands-on mentorship, direct exposure to shop managers, regional directors and senior leadership, and visibility into our AI and innovation work as your skills develop.

What drives your day-to-day?


Maintain and monitor the existing Tableau dashboard suite, ensuring reports run accurately and on schedule during the migration period.
Perform routine data validation across dashboards and reports, investigating discrepancies and partnering with Data Engineering when source data needs to be corrected.
Produce recurring monthly reports and one-off ad hoc reports for shop managers, regional directors and corporate stakeholders.
Manage the ACX user list across Tableau and Power BI, provisioning access and keeping permissions aligned with role.
Help rebuild ACX dashboards in Power BI — recreating calculations in DAX and validating that new versions match the originals.
As your Power BI skills develop, grow into designing new dashboards from scratch, contributing to dashboard digests, and helping train managers on how to use them.
Document your work so the rest of the team can pick it up.


What Are The Must-haves…


Post-secondary education in Operations Management, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, ora related field — recent graduate's welcome.
Some hands-on experience with SQL or another programming language (coursework, co-op, internship or personal projects all count).
Working proficiency in Excel — formulas, pivot tables, and comfort cleaning up messy data.
An eye for visual design and a genuine interest in making data clear and engaging.
Self-starter mindset with the willingness to try something before asking for help, balanced with the self-awareness to ask good questions when you are genuinely stuck.
Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable talking with shop managers and regional leaders, not just other analysts.
Any prior exposure to Power BI (including DAX), Tableau, or another BI/dashboarding tool is a major plus. Power BI coursework, certifications (PL-300), or personal projects stand out given our current migration. 


The Perks.


Competitive Compensation and Benefits Package
Employee Vehicle Purchase & Service Plans
Employee and Family Assistance Programs
Company-wide appreciation events and contests throughout the calendar year 
Professional development and the opportunity to grow your career 


And those are just the basics. We strive every day to create a workplace culture that embraces diversity and inclusivity, ensures fairness and equal opportunities, and fosters a sense of belonging for all Team Members. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively support everyone in expressing themselves and reaching their full potential. 

Can you picture yourself here already?

We hope so. It’s equally as important that you choose us as we choose you. Take a sneak peek at what we think makes this one of the best workplaces around. 

 If you think you’re a good fit to come along on our ride, apply now through our website at www.autocan.ca/careers. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 Our commitment extends to reaching out to individuals from various backgrounds and identities. We do not discriminate based on gender identity, race, national origin, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, marital or family status, or mental/physical disabilities. AutoCanada is committed to collaborating with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need accommodation during the recruitment process, please inform your recruiter.

Title: Business Analyst, Fan Care Community
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

#WeAreEA and we exist to inspire the world to play. EA values creativity, pioneering, passion, determination, learning, and teamwork. We mean things like acting with curiosity, speaking up with original ideas, and committing to each other as one team.

Come join us! We’re hiring a Business Analyst, Fan Care Community to join EA’s Fan Care Community organization.

EA’s Fan Care organization exists to help our fans get the most fun from their games. From onboarding new players to getting them back in the game, we support fans across their EA experiences. We value people who bring new ideas and perspectives to make Fan Care a great place to be and be from. We strive to make EA known for taking care of its fans. We’re fans taking care of fans and people talking to people

We're looking for a Business Analyst, Fan Care Community to transform community and fan experience data into actionable insights that support Fan Care Community strategies. Sitting at the intersection of strategy and execution, you'll analyze fan behaviors, community health, and business performance to identify opportunities that improve fan experiences and drive better outcomes across EA's games and services.

Success in this role means delivering insights that improve community engagement, fan experiences, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

You will report to the Director of Programs and Planning and work with key stakeholders in the Community and Fan Intelligence organizations.

What You’ll Do


Analyze community health, engagement, growth, and sentiment across owned and social channels.
Identify emerging player trends, concerns, and opportunities through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Develop reporting frameworks that measure community program effectiveness.
Partner with Community leaders to measure and optimize the impact of community initiatives and campaigns.
Analyze fan experience data from multiple tools and sources to understand fan behaviors and needs
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, helping drive data-informed decisions and prioritization.
Evaluate business processes, anticipate requirements, and uncover areas for improvement
Stay up-to-date on the latest processes and IT advancements to automate and modernize systems
Update, implement, and maintain documentation for procedures
Manage competing resources and priorities
Set and manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring clear communication and timely completion of deliverables


What You Bring


3+ years of experience in business analytics, community analytics, customer experience analytics, or a related field.
Experience working with large datasets and identifying actionable trends and insights.
Experience translating fan feedback and behavioral data into actionable recommendations.
Advanced knowledge of community measurements, metrics, and tools
Advanced knowledge of customer support strategies and tools
Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to influence decision-making.
Exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking skills
Excellent documentation skills
Experience creating detailed reports and giving presentations
A track record of meeting commitments
Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$77,700 - $107,900 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Title: Member Contact Operations Analyst (20-Month Contract)
Description:
Our Story & Purpose:

We’re Vancity, a member-owned credit union built on the principles of inclusion and social justice. Since 1946, our relentless commitment to these values has helped us challenge the status quo and break down barriers. We’ve made bold commitments to become net-zero by 2040 across all mortgages and loans, and we’re actively pursuing strategies in Indigenous banking and financial resilience for our members.

As the largest private sector Living Wage Employer in Canada, we’re proud to be consistently recognized as one of the country’s Top Employers. If you’re ready to join our team of 2,300 diverse individuals, access competitive rewards and benefits, and be part of a greater movement - apply today!

Your Role in Supporting Our Members:

As a Member Contact Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in enabling the development of optimized business results through data-driven insights. You will define and translate business needs into actionable requirements, develop operational reports using real-time and historical data, and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver solutions that enhance member experience. We’re looking for a detail-oriented, analytical thinker who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about leveraging technology to improve processes. Experience in Genesys Cloud admin will be integral for success in this role. 

This is a Full-time, Temporary role based at our Surrey Central Office or from your B.C based home office under remote working arrangements, and will report directly to the Team Manager, Member Contact Operations. While this position provides a hybrid work arrangement, you will be expected to be on-site for events and business demands.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Defining, analyzing and interpreting business needs into clear business requirements, user stories, and process models
Developing cross-functional reports using data from multiple sources to meet business needs
Identifying process or access changes required and communicating these to stakeholders
Collaborating with end users to create new or enhance existing report templates in conjunction with IT teams
Contributing to project deliverables in both agile and waterfall methodologies
Supporting design, build, test, training, and deployment phases of projects
Creating and maintaining documentation for reporting processes and actively managed documents
Managing end-user profiles and permissions on Genesys reporting platforms
Support Genesys Cloud admin, with an emphasis on A3S, Snowflake, App Foundry, Kibana etc.


What You’ll Bring to the Team:

At least 2 years of post-secondary education in a relevant field (e.g Database Admin, Data Analytics, Data Science)
Minimum 2+ years of experience in a contact center environment
1+ year back-end administrative experience with Genesys Cloud Platform
Minimum 1+ year of experience with Database Management Systems (e.g., Power BI, SQL)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Self-driven persistence in conducting deep data analysis to gain a comprehensive understanding, uncover insights, and resolve discrepancies.
Ability to communicate effectively and translate business requirements into technical specifications


Extra Skills That Set You Apart:

Experience providing technical guidance or acting as a subject matter expert
Familiarity with agile and waterfall project methodologies
Creativity in developing reporting solutions and improving processes


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

An Analyzer & Problem Solver - Skilled at detecting anomalies and resolving discrepancies.
Solutions-focused & Process-oriented - Confident in decision-making and improving tools and processes.
A Communicator with Influence - Able to present data effectively and collaborate with stakeholders.
Self-starter - Proactive and motivated to meet timelines and deliverables.


What You’ll Earn:

This role offers a salary range of $55,300 to $65,000 per annum. The base pay offered may vary depending on factors such as relevant qualifications, skills, previous experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards package, employees may also be eligible for our annual incentive program, subject to program eligibility requirements.

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

A career at Vancity is more than just a job, you’re joining a tradition of change-makers who are creating lasting change for our communities. Beyond base pay, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package to ensure our employees are empowered to thrive:

Living Wage Employer: We’re the largest private-sector Living Wage Employer in Canada and consistently ranked among Canada’s Top Employers.
Customizable Benefits: Permanent employees receive flexible benefit packages that can be tailored annually to meet evolving needs.
Generous Vacation: New employees start with 3-4 weeks of vacation per year, with additional days earned over time.
Extra Stat Holidays: In addition to BC’s 11 statutory holidays, we offer 2 extra days, plus care days for personal or family illness.
Immediate Health Coverage: Health and dental benefits begin on your hire date, with three levels of coverage to choose from.
Defined Benefit Pension: Our retirement plan provides a guaranteed income for life, recognizing that retirement looks different for everyone.


Vancity Talent Programs:

Vancity supports an inclusive hiring process for candidates who self-identify as Indigenous, Black, or Trans. With special permission from the BC Human Rights Commissioner, this initiative provides access to career development opportunities, prioritized job screening, and feedback. For details, please see our dedicated Talent Programs job posting.

At Vancity we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace to help our people and communities thrive and prosper. Diversity in our workforce is integral so that we can truly represent, understand and respond to our community needs and deliver on our member experience.

Title: Operations Reporting Analyst
Description:
Branch: Gas

Affiliation: MoveUP

Employment Status: Full-Time Regular

Salary: $3,478.00 bi-weekly

Short-term Incentive Eligible: No

Workplace Flexibility: No

Posting End Date: Open until filled

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Position Overview

Are you passionate about transforming complex operational data into meaningful insights? As an Operations Reporting Analyst, you'll play a key role in helping leaders make informed business decisions by analyzing operational performance, identifying trends, and developing reporting solutions that drive continuous improvement.

In this role, you'll partner with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful reporting, benchmarking, and analytical insights that support operational excellence and strategic planning.

In this role, you will


Analyze operational metrics, activities, and costs to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement.
Develop, maintain, and enhance ERP-based reports and queries that support business operations and decision-making.
Conduct benchmarking, cost, and performance analyses to help establish targets and evaluate operational results.
Perform trend analysis, forecasting, and scenario modeling to assess potential business impacts and support strategic planning.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, investigate data gaps, and deliver actionable insights.
Present findings and recommendations that improve reporting practices, processes, and operational performance.
Support continuous improvement initiatives, system enhancements, and implementation projects.
Create training materials and procedural documentation that help users effectively understand and utilize reporting tools.


Requirements


Education: Successful completion of Diploma in Accounting, Finance, or a related field from an accredited post-secondary institution.
Experience: Minimum of six (6) years’ experience of recent and related experience, of which one year experience involves complex data analytics.
Strong analytical skills including the ability to organize, interpret and present data through reports, summaries and procedural documentation.
Excellent organizational skills, initiative and ability to balance priorities and meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis, cost-benefit analysis and related analytical techniques.
Advanced knowledge of ERP financial systems (e.g. SAP) and reporting tools (including SAP BW) used to support cost accounting as well as other specialized software used within the department.
Ability to work with limited supervision and direction.
Strong interpersonal, presentation, verbal and written communication skills.


Our engaging workplace offers a wide range of challenging opportunities, while being safe, inclusive, and diverse. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, while supporting life-long career development. We also encourage volunteerism and nourish the need to give back to your community.

Title: Analyst, Low Carbon
Description:
Location: Calgary Headquarters

Position Type: Full time, salaried

Reports to: Director, Analytics

About Orennia

Orennia provides an all-in-one platform for accurate data, predictive analytics and actionable insights across the energy transition. We drive faster capital allocation decisions and help our clients maximize returns across the solar, wind, storage, power, RNG, CCUS, clean fuels and hydrogen sectors. The technology that powers Orennia’s platform delivers an unparalleled experience, distilling information into actionable insights to give our clients a competitive edge.

As the world decarbonizes its energy stack, trillions in capital need to be deployed. Global investment in the energy transition must quadruple to over $5 trillion annually to stay on the 1.5°C pathway, according to the International Renewable Energy Agency. Without accurate data and predictive analytics, developers and investors will struggle to deploy capital efficiently and maximize returns. Orennia’s platform expedites the energy transition with effective and robust information for smarter capital allocation choices.

Why Join Orennia?

People are at the heart of the best technology companies. We’ve brought together some of the industry’s top experts and brightest minds in data orchestration, analytics, software development, and industry insights to uncover opportunities where others can’t. At Orennia, you’ll become part of a collaborative culture and do work that matters. We trust and support each other, ask hard questions and solve complex problems together. Guided by a spirit of inquiry, our team has a product-driven, continuous delivery mindset to drive our innovation forward.

The Opportunity

As an Analyst, Low Carbon, you'll help shape the future of the energy transition by delivering data-driven insights and analytical solutions across Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) and Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (CCUS). Working with a highly collaborative team, you'll develop innovative models, solve complex market challenges, and partner directly with clients to inform high-impact strategic and investment decisions. If you're intellectually curious, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to build your career while contributing to a lower-carbon future, this is an exceptional opportunity to grow with us.

What You’ll Do


Contribute to market analysis across energy transition sectors, with a focus on Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) and Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (CCUS).
Develop advanced analytical models that leverage large data sets to provide insights to our clients.
You will develop tools and models to streamline the collection, management and reporting process for large datasets and modeling results.
Work closely with our clients to create customized solutions to their most pressing and complex problems.
Develop and maintain economic models for RNG and CCUS projects.
Participate in conference calls, virtual and in-person meetings with clients and prospects, leveraging and demonstrating our solutions.


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of relevant work experience.
You have experience or demonstrable passion in RNG or CCUS.
You have completed your bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Mathematics/Computer Science/Finance.
You have strong analytical ability including statistical methods and optimization concepts.
You have programming, database and software skills (VBA, Python, Excel, SQL).
You have the ability to work in a team setting with others from varying disciplines.
Excellent written and communication skills with an ability to explain complex problems.
You have strong attention to detail and are comfortable working with large data sets.
You are hungry to learn and contribute. Our organization is growing and this role is an exceptional opportunity to grow with us.
Deep intellectual curiosity with a results-focused relentless pursuit of answers. Ability to work in a fast-paced start-up environment, embrace change and ambiguity.


Why You’ll Love Orennia

At Orennia, you'll join a high performing, people-focused team where everyone has a role to play. We offer our regular, full-time employees a competitive total rewards package, comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits, a savings program that includes company matching, and a learning and development budget to master your craft. In addition, we offer generous time off with regular company holidays, paid vacation days and paid sick days.

We thank all applicants in advance for their interest and for taking the time to apply; however, only applicants invited for an interview will be contacted.

Orennia is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated fairly and with respect, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable provincial, federal, state, or local law.

We believe in fostering a work environment that promotes equal opportunities for all individuals and strive to eliminate any barriers to employment and advancement. We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotions, compensation, benefits, training, and all other aspects of employment.

Title: Portfolio Analyst, Capacity & Portfolio Performance
Description:
Embark on a rewarding career with Sobeys Inc., celebrated among Canada’s Top 100 employers where your unique contributions drive success.

Sobeys is full of exciting opportunities, and we are always looking for bright new talent to join our team! We currently have a full time opportunity for a Portfolio Analyst, Capacity & Portfolio Performance. This role can be based out of one our main offices including: Stellarton, NS; Mississauga, ON.

As a Portfolio Analyst, Capacity & Portfolio Performance with Sobeys, you will:


Maintain hygiene of capacity, demand, and allocation data across all CTAO delivery teams to support annual and multi-year planning..
Support resource feasibility and Portfolio impact assessments for new initiatives and/or changes to inflight projects by gathering inputs and validating data accuracy.
Update and maintain portfolio performance dashboards and KPIs (on‑time delivery, resource utilization, milestone health, etc.).
In collaboration with the prioritization and governance team, conduct bottleneck and constraint analysis, surfacing early indicators to key portfolio stakeholders
Prepare scenario modelling inputs (resource shifts, deferrals, acceleration options, etc.) to support portfolio planning.
Maintain Planview data quality for capacity, demand management, allocations, project /program management, performance metrics, and project/portfolio execution views.
Provide data analysis, insights and decision support for governance forums, delivery reviews, and Quarterly ELT updates in partnership with delivery teams regarding status updates, milestone progress and performance indicators in the portfolio platform.
Support continuous improvement of capacity models, reporting structures, and data standards.
Technology Solutions / Cyber / Data / Advanced Analytics / Operations: resource capacity and constraint information.
Resource Managers: Confirm availability, forecast effort, validate /approve allocations, planning accuracy, scenario planning and demand projections,
Finance: Collaborate with Prioritization and Governance team to provide inputs for capacity‑driven project cost adjustments and performance reporting.
Planview User Community: Enforce data standards, support updates, and maintain portfolio platform accuracy.
Project & Program Managers: RAID log, WBS, milestone and planning accuracy to support performance updates, portfolio dashboards and other reporting.


What You Bring


Experience leading and developing teams, supporting people through change and driving accountability.
Strong background in enterprise portfolio management across business and technology initiatives.
Hands-on experience with capacity planning and resource management, balancing supply, demand, and timing.
Advanced expertise in Planview, including configuration, reporting, workflows, data structures, and governance.
Proven ability to translate ambiguous or early-stage ideas into structured, actionable plans.
Strong analytical skills, including scenario modelling and “what-if” analysis.
Experience producing clear, executive-level portfolio reporting.
Solid understanding of delivery lifecycles (SDLC, PLC, business change) and how they impact sequencing and capacity.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders using data.


Who We Are

Sobeys is one of Canada’s leading grocery retailers, with more than 1,600 stores across all 10 provinces and banners including Sobeys, Safeway, IGA, Foodland, FreshCo, Thrifty Foods, and Lawtons Drug Stores. Our 128,000 teammates and franchise affiliates are passionate about delivering great food and exceptional experiences to our customers and communities.

Learn More About Our Story And Culture

Who We Are | Why Work With Us

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You And The Role

Zipline is on a mission to transform how goods move by making autonomous drone delivery the fastest, most reliable, and most delightful logistics system in the world. As we continue to scale our Platform 2 (P2) business, we are looking for a Business Data Analyst to help turn data into actionable insights that drive growth.

As a member of Zipline's centralized Data Science & Analytics team, you will serve as an embedded business and analytics partner to stakeholders across Marketing, Commercial, and Growth. You will help teams make better decisions by translating business questions into analyses, dashboards, and recommendations that improve performance, identify opportunities, and accelerate growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with business curiosity. You are comfortable working with large datasets, building intuitive reporting solutions, and communicating complex findings in ways that inspire action. You are excited by the opportunity to use modern analytics and AI tools to automate manual work, improve visibility, and help Zipline scale efficiently.

What You'll Do


Own analyses of customer behavior, commercial performance, market dynamics, and Platform 2 growth opportunities.
Define KPI frameworks and metric definitions that give Marketing, Commercial, and Growth teams a consistent view of progress against strategic priorities.
Build and maintain business-facing dashboards and self-service reporting that stakeholders use to assess performance and plan action.
Translate analysis into recommendations that inform campaign investment, commercial prioritization, growth initiatives, and strategic tradeoffs.
Monitor performance to identify material trends, risks, and opportunities requiring a decision or change in business approach.
Partner with Data Science, Product, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting capabilities, and analytical processes.
Use AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring reporting and analysis, reducing manual work and improving the speed of insight delivery.



What You'll Bring


5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence work in analytics, operations, technology, logistics, eCommerce, or a related environment.
Advanced SQL proficiency and experience querying complex relational datasets.
Experience building business-facing dashboards in Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or a similar platform.
Familiarity with data warehouses such as Snowflake or Redshift and a scripting language such as Python.
Ability to turn ambiguous commercial or growth questions into rigorous analyses, clear measurement approaches, and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication and business judgment, with evidence of helping technical and non-technical stakeholders act on data.
Experience using AI tools to automate analytical workflows or recurring reporting, plus a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or related field.



What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $140,000 - $180,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other characteristics protected by state, federal or local law or our other policies.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Title: Staff Data Analyst
Description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Great decisions aren't built on intuition alone – they're built on data.

As a Staff Data Analyst, you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives.

The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role.

Some of the Problems You'll Solve:

🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact?

Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making.

📈 How healthy is the business?

Build dashboards and reporting that provide leaders with visibility into operational performance, customer outcomes, and organizational health.

🔍 What trends should we be paying attention to?

Analyze data across multiple sources to identify patterns, emerging opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

👥 What behaviors drive successful outcomes?

Use segmentation, cohort analysis, and behavioral data to understand customers, users, or operational processes and identify opportunities to improve results.

🤝 How can data guide better decisions?

Partner with stakeholders across departments to answer high-impact business questions, evaluate tradeoffs, and provide analytical recommendations.

🎯 What should we be measuring that we aren't today?

Improve data quality, instrumentation, and reporting by identifying gaps in existing data collection and helping teams capture the information needed to make informed decisions.

How You'll Make an Impact:

📊 Build confidence in business decisions by designing analyses and communicating insights that help teams understand what is working – and what isn't.

📈 Turn data into strategic direction by uncovering trends, identifying opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations.

📉 Create visibility into organizational performance through dashboards, reporting, and metrics that stakeholders rely on every day.

🤝 Partner with cross-functional teams to frame business problems, evaluate options, and ensure decisions are supported by data.

🎯 Develop meaningful metrics and reporting frameworks that enable teams to consistently measure success and track progress over time.

🔍 Identify opportunities to improve business processes, customer experiences, and operational efficiency through thoughtful analysis.

🧩 Bring clarity to complex problems by asking the right questions, exploring the data, and delivering insights that move the business forward.

You'll Probably Thrive Here If You:

🧩 Use data to drive decisions.

You have a track record of solving complex business problems through thoughtful analysis and influencing decisions with data.

📊 Have strong analytical fundamentals.

SQL is a core part of your toolkit, and you're comfortable working with large datasets to uncover meaningful insights.

📈 Think beyond reporting.

You don't just build dashboards – you investigate root causes, identify opportunities, and recommend actions.

💬 Communicate with clarity.

You can explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and help stakeholders make informed decisions.

🤝 Enjoy solving ambiguous problems.

You're comfortable starting with a business question—not a predefined report—and determining what data, analyses, or metrics are needed to answer it.

🔄 Adapt quickly to new tools and technologies.

You enjoy learning new platforms and approaches and focus on solving problems rather than relying on a specific technology stack.

🛠 Bring experience with modern analytics tools.

Experience with SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms is a plus, but not required. Great analysts learn new tools. Great critical thinking is harder to teach.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

As a Staff Data Analyst, you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives.

The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role.

🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact?

Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making.

📈 How healthy is the business?

Build dashboards and reporting that provide leaders with visibility into operational performance, customer outcomes, and organizational health.

🔍 What trends should we be paying attention to?

Analyze data across multiple sources to identify patterns, emerging opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

👥 What behaviors drive successful outcomes?

Use segmentation, cohort analysis, and behavioral data to understand customers, users, or operational processes and identify opportunities to improve results.

🤝 How can data guide better decisions?

Partner with stakeholders across departments to answer high-impact business questions, evaluate tradeoffs, and provide analytical recommendations.

🎯 What should we be measuring that we aren't today?

Improve data quality, instrumentation, and reporting by identifying gaps in existing data collection and helping teams capture the information needed to make informed decisions.

🧩 Bring clarity to complex problems by asking the right questions, exploring the data, and delivering insights that move the business forward.

You don't just build dashboards – you investigate root causes, identify opportunities, and recommend actions.

Title: Data Analyst II - Omni Analytics
Description:
Tailored Brands, Inc. is a leading omni-channel specialty retailer of menswear, including suits and a broad selection of business casual offerings as well as the largest provider of tuxedo rental products in the U.S. and Canada. We operate retail stores in all 50 states and Canada. Our U.S. retail stores are operated under the brand names of Men’s Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Men’s Wearhouse and Tux, and K&G Fashion. Our Canadian stores are operated under the brand name of Moores in ten provinces. Our purpose is we help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments. We accomplish this by putting customers at the center of every decision, rallying together to achieve common goals, and striving for excellence and continuous improvement. We help fulfill this purpose by valuing differences and knowing they make us better and showing up with courage to always do the right thing. If you want to make a difference, be part of a great team and grow, you might be a perfect fit.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for an Data Analyst II – Omni Analytics to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. You will serve as a vital role as a “data detective” investigating trends underlying KPIs to uncover the "why" behind performance. Collaborating with merchandising and ecomm teams, you will go beyond retrospective reporting to identify who is impacted and what it means for our future. Your proactive, forward-looking insights will guide, monitor, and measure key ecomm and merchandising strategies.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities


Data Analysis: Dive deep into sales, inventory, and website activity to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Reporting: Create clear, concise, and insightful dashboards via Power Bi, Looker Studio, and Excel Pivots.
Forecasting: Use statistical models to create forward-looking prediction models.
Presentations: Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
Collaborate: Partner with data engineering, ecommerce teams, and across analytics to share learnings, align on methodologies and leverage best practices.


What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, merchandising, or a related field is required.
Minimum of 3 years career experience in a similar role
SQL: Proficiency in querying databases for data extraction is required.
Data Visualization: Experience visualizing insights in enterprise Business Intelligence tools effectively is required, preferably in Power BI.
AI Tools: Ability to use tools (such as CoPilot and Glean) to amplify, but not replace thinking, in work is required.
Google Analytics: Proficiency in analyzing data in GA is preferred.
Python/R: Proficiency in scripting data manipulation and modeling for analysis is preferred.


Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands


Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time.
Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment.
Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location.


Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go to mytbtotalrewards.com.

Work-Life Balance

Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:


Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development.
Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend.
Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday.

Experience with statistical analysis or forecasting.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. Inquisitive mindset that is willing to challenge status quo and various stakeholders

Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to synthesize key takeaways and present data-proven results

Experience in using SQL with enterprise datasets is required
Experience in R or Python is required
Experience with Tableau or other related Business Intelligence Tool is required
Experience with automation in an enterprise setting is a major place
