Title: Senior Data Analyst, New Account Risk
Description:
About The Role

At Chime, the moment someone becomes a member is everything—it’s where trust begins, and where bad actors try to slip in. As an L4 Risk Analyst on the New Account Risk team, you will help protect Chime’s enrollment funnel from fraud while ensuring every legitimate applicant gets a fast, frictionless path to membership. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Operations, digging into data to spot emerging fraud patterns and turning your findings into policies, dashboards, and recommendations the team can act on.

Your work will directly support the team’s two headline goals for 2026: improving the Funnel Enrollment Rate (FER) and reducing the post-enrollment synthetic identity theft rate.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $133,000.00 and up to $185,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to


Analyze enrollment and application data to identify opportunities to reduce synthetic identity and ID theft losses, with minimal impact to legitimate applicants (35%)
Support the design, testing, and monitoring of new account risk policies and decision rules, partnering with Product and Engineering to ship improvements (30%)
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track Funnel Enrollment Rate, fraud loss, and approval/false-positive rates against team goals (20%)
Monitor the performance of third-party vendor models and risk signals used at enrollment, flagging anomalies and trends to senior team members (10%)
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to fulfill ad-hoc analysis requests as needed (5%)


To thrive in this role, you have


3+ years of experience in a Fraud, Risk, Compliance, or Investigations role, ideally with exposure to new account enrollment, identity fraud, or KYC/CIP
Working knowledge of identity fraud domains such as synthetic identity and identity theft, and an interest in the threat landscape that targets enrollment funnels
Strong SQL skills; familiarity with Python, R, or a similar analytical language preferred
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Hex, or equivalent
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Glean, Claude) to accelerate day-to-day analysis
Exceptional detail-orientation and organizational skills; you’re eager to solve challenging analytical problems for our members
The drive to work in a fast-paced environment and meet ambitious deadlines while ensuring flawless completion
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitatively rigorous discipline like engineering, statistics, math, or economics is preferred
A passion for Chime’s mission


A Little About Us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

Because if we don't—who will?


Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.


What We Offer For Our Full-time, Regular Employees


🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress


We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.

Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. About the Role

Join Midi Health as a Growth Analyst. As we scale our D2C and B2B segments (partnering with health systems and employers) and deepen our analytical capabilities across marketing channels, we need a data-driven analyst to grow alongside us. In this role, you will play a critical part in developing actionable dashboards and uncovering insights to drive user conversion. If you love data visualization, story telling, and diving deep into funnel analytics to drive business impact, this is the perfect opportunity to accelerate your career.

What You’ll Do


Dashboarding & Reporting: Develop, iterate, and maintain comprehensive reports and automated dashboards using our visualization platforms to track KPIs and keep cross-functional stakeholders informed.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Analyze the end-to-end user journey.
B2B Growth Support: Partner with the growth and commercial teams to track performance and scale our B2B initiatives across health system and employer partnerships.
Lifecycle Marketing Support: Support the lifecycle marketing team by tracking engagement metrics, user re-engagement campaigns, and email/SMS performance.
Grow & Own: Work closely with your mentor to upskill, refine your analytical frameworks, and eventually transition into a senior role owning specific growth and marketing analytics domains.


What You Bring


Passion for Women's Health Tech: A genuine interest in Midi’s mission to close the gap in midlife care and improve healthcare outcomes for women.
Experience: 2-4 years of experience in data analytics, marketing analytics, growth, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL and data visualization/BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, Looker). Strong hands-on experience with event-based analytics platforms (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel) and Ad Platform dashboards (Meta, Google, etc.).
Analytical Capabilities: Ability to analyze conversion funnels and translate complex data points into a clear narrative. Strong attention to detail in reporting and maintaining data integrity.
AI Adoption & Tech Fluency: Comfortable integrating generative AI tools (like Claude) and modern platform AI agents into your daily data workflows to write code faster, troubleshoot tracking schemas, and scale analytics output.
Experimentation: Heavy statistical experimentation experience is not required. A basic understanding of straightforward A/B testing is sufficient, and you will learn as you go.
Growth Mindset: You are eager to learn, highly collaborative, and excited to be mentored by senior team members while building the foundation to become a domain owner.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Marketing Analyst



Drive Growth Through Data, Insights & Innovation

Are you a data-driven marketing professional who thrives on turning complex information into actionable business strategies? We are seeking a Senior Marketing Analyst to play a key role in shaping marketing performance, member/customer growth, and strategic decision-making through advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and compelling data storytelling.

In this high-impact position, you will partner with marketing and business leaders to uncover opportunities, optimize campaigns, improve member/customer engagement, and deliver insights that drive measurable results. This is an excellent opportunity for an analytical thinker who enjoys building solutions, influencing strategy, and taking ownership of business outcomes.



What You'll Do


Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions using T-SQL.
Gather requirements, build prototypes, conduct testing, and deliver insights through Power BI dashboards and executive presentations.
Perform quantitative analysis, data mining, and predictive modeling to support marketing initiatives and growth objectives.
Create forecasting models for budgeting, growth projections, and campaign performance.
Build analytical models focused on churn analysis, customer lifetime value, and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools.
Analyze digital performance, including website behavior, conversion funnels, and online engagement metrics.
Lead research initiatives to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and optimization strategies.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity through ongoing quality validation processes.
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating data into business recommendations.
Automate reporting processes and improve operational efficiency through innovative solutions.
Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders to support strategic business goals.


What We're Looking For


Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable with a strong attention to detail.
Experience presenting complex insights to executive and business audiences.
A passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and using data to influence decisions.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in an analytical role, preferably within marketing, business analytics, or financial services.
Advanced SQL programming experience (T-SQL preferred).
Strong experience applying statistical and mathematical techniques to data analysis and modeling.
At least 2 years of recent Power BI experience.
Experience working in agile, fast-paced environments.
Experience with cloud technologies (Azure preferred).
Knowledge of Google Analytics and/or Adobe Analytics.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience measuring and optimizing marketing campaign performance.
Background in banking, credit unions, or financial services.
Experience with customer segmentation, acquisition, retention, and lifecycle analytics.

Description:

Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

Success. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
Career growth. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow
Teamwork. We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2025 revenues of $22.8 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

General Purpose

The Senior Analyst, Business Intelligence will conduct critical strategic analysis for the Stores teams at Ross and dd's Discounts, leading to insight and actions that improve business performance. This position will report to the Director of Business Intelligence and will interact with VP+ stakeholders and Stores Leadership. The candidate will utilize their training in analytics to accurately and efficiently process large amounts of data, revealing store performance trends and identifying root causes. They summarize results into clear written communications for Stores Leadership and Senior Executives. These reporting and analysis responsibilities are a mix of recurring (weekly, monthly, quarterly) and ad-hoc activities, depending on business needs and priorities. The position will require the Manager to establish cross-functional partnerships across all facets of the organization (both Field and Corporate).

The base salary range for this role is $81,000 - $121,800. The base salary range is dependent on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, relevant education, certifications, seniority, and location. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards vary by position and location.

Essential Functions

Design and conduct financial and operational analyses to understand drivers of performance and identify root causes of changes in performance trends:


Examples include analysis of operational metrics such as store fixture capacity across the year, impact from strategic initiatives, etc.
Proactively identify opportunities and execute analysis to develop tangible and fact-based recommendations to improve performance.
Partner with key stakeholders to build and continuously improve business intelligence processes, tools, dashboards, metrics, and insights to provide the business with access to actionable data.
Support operational and technical responsibilities that include data preparation, data warehousing, data flow, reporting integrity and accuracy, predictive analytics, data exploration, and socialization.
Manage projects from end to end, including work plan creation, coordination with other functions in the organization, and support materials development and verbal communication/presentation of findings and recommendations.

Communicates Effectively
Ensures Accountability & Execution
Organizational Agility

Collaboration
Business Acumen
Leading by Example
Plans, Aligns & Prioritizes

Bachelor's degree required with demonstrated superior college performance (preferably in an analytical field such as Finance, Economics, Accounting, etc.)
Minimum of 3+ years of work experience in an analyst role is required.
Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group - including Senior Executives, managers, and subject matter experts within and outside the department - and the ability to explain analytical methodology and results to non-technical audiences. Must be able to clearly communicate results and implications of analysis in both verbal and written (PowerPoint) forms
Outstanding analytical ability - must have a data driven approach to solving problems. Requires very strong quantitative skills, a good sense of how to dissect problems and a strong ability to "connect the dots" - e.g., understand how pieces of data interact with each other or how one finding should inform the result of another analysis
Proficiency with statistical tools (e.g., SQL, R, Python), data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Excel), and other statistical & reporting packages.
Passionately analytical and innately curious creative thinker. Must have the drive and self-motivation necessary to be part of managing in a fast-paced, changing retail environment
Proven ability to develop and apply analytic solutions to solve business problems.
Experience developing short- and long-term visions for solutions that have a significant business impact.
Unquestionable personal and professional character and integrity - must be trustworthy with confidential information


Physical Requirements/Ada

Job requires ability to work in an office environment, primarily on a computer.

Requires sitting, standing, walking, hearing, talking on the telephone, attending in-person meetings, typing, and working with paper/files, etc.

Consistent timeliness and regular attendance.

Vision requirements: Ability to see information in print and/or electronically.

This role requires regular in-office presence, including to engage in in-person team interaction, meetings and collaboration, client support, mentoring, coaching, and/or feedback. However, this role can perform duties effectively using a combination of in-office and remote work.

None

About Berkeley

At the University of California, Berkeley, we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth. We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.

Departmental Overview

At UC Berkeley School of Public Health (UCBPH), health equity and social justice are part of our DNA. For more than 75 years, we’ve been pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo. Established in 1943, we are a top-10 national school of public health located on the UC Berkeley campus, comprising six academic divisions, more than 20 graduate programs, and nearly 30 research centers and programs. Our mission is to improve population health, especially for the most vulnerable, and our most cherished values are health as a right; strength through diversity; thinking forward; and impact first. Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Verisign helps enable the security, stability, and resiliency of the internet. We are a trusted provider of internet infrastructure services for the networked world and deliver unmatched performance in domain name system (DNS) services.

We are a mission focused, values driven company where each individual can contribute to building a stronger, more secure internet. We offer a dynamic and flexible work environment with competitive benefits and the ability to grow your career.




The Data Analyst II, as a member of the Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team, analyzes and helps solve complex business problems using data and available resources to provide insight to decision-makers. In this role, you will analyze trends in domain name usage, digital service activation and channel distribution dynamics.




The role requires consistent communication across teams -- including marketing, account management, product management, finance, and platform engineering -- to translate between technical and behavior trends and end-user demand characteristics. Your work on the team will involve studying data trends and patterns to derive insights that support data-driven presentations with creative visualizations highlighting key trends.




An ideal candidate cares deeply about data quality, visualization, business impact, and understanding global DNS or the broader web hosting ecosystem.




Summary of key responsibilities:

Evaluate extensive datasets leveraging large-scale data analysis platforms to explain how end users are utilizing domain names
Create specifications for data acquisition to support exploration of emerging technologies impacting the global DNS.
Develop and maintain manual and automated processes to ensure data quality and integrity.
Research trends to support briefings, presentations, and reporting on business performance and progress relative to plans.
Support the formation of recommendations and strategic/tactical plans based on capturing relevant business metrics.




Qualifications:

4 years of progressively responsible, related business and/or data analysis experience
Bachelor’s degree in either Computer Science, Data Analytics or Business, or equivalent work experience, is required
Strong Excel and SQL skills required, with hands-on experience with data visualization tooling (such as Tableau or related tools)
Strong analytic skills and the ability to share insights with peers
Demonstrable planning and organization skills
Experience performing data ETL, including designing data collection methods, data models, and transformation processes for relational databases (Oracle/SQL) and distributed data systems (such as Snowflake, Hadoop, Spark with scripting languages like Python)




This position is based in our Reston, VA office and offers a hybrid work schedule.




The pay range is $89,900 - $121,700.




The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is noted above, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience. Verisign offers a discretionary bonus which is based on individual and company performance, and certain roles may be eligible for discretionary stock awards.

Title: Big Data Laser Analyst
Description:
Description -

Job Summary


We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. In this role, you will translate consumer and enterprise print telemetry into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights, with a primary focus on laser printer data. You will partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to improve data reliability, define KPI and metric semantics, and influence cross-functional decisions through clear data storytelling.


Responsibilities


Own laser print telemetry business insights for the Print Supplies organization, from problem framing and metric definition through analysis, visualization, and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, translate business questions into analytical requirements, define critical KPIs, and deliver insights that drive decisions.
Provide consultative support and ad hoc analyses with clear hypotheses, methods, and assumptions; produce reusable queries, datasets, and shareable outputs with documented limitations.
Collaborate with internal and external partners to align on telemetry instrumentation, data collection methodology, and platform differences to ensure consistent interpretation across printer platforms.
Investigate data quality issues (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), perform root-cause analysis across pipelines and sources, and communicate impacts and remediation paths with appropriate caveats.
Enable self-service analytics by documenting dashboards and KPI definitions, and coach users on correct interpretation and common pitfalls.
Design and maintain measurement frameworks (e.g., adoption, usage, retention, share, funnel/driver analyses); when applicable, support experiment or pre/post evaluation and interpret results for stakeholders.
Create clear narratives through written summaries, presentations, and recurring reporting that highlight trends, drivers, risks, and recommended actions for leadership and partner teams.
Provide guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members.
Solve difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
Lead moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans.


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.


Preferred Certifications


Programming Language/s Certification (SQL, Python, or similar)


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, and KPI design
SQL: complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Python (and/or PySpark) for analysis, data validation, and automation. Familiar with VSCode and Databricks Ideally
Ability to interpret telemetry and pipeline outputs in business context, including communicating uncertainty and known limitations
Comfort working across multiple data sources/layers and explaining differences in source-of-truth, grain, and transformations
Comfort with modern analytics tooling (including AI-assisted development) while maintaining reproducibility and reviewable outputs
Dashboarding & data visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced excel / PowerPoint or similar; ability to build stakeholder-ready reporting
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, and documentation
Strong documentation habits for metric definitions, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance; familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) a plus. Familiar with Jira and Confluence.
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity
Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams


Impact & Scope


Impacts function by providing analytics and data quality validation that supports business-critical reporting and stakeholder decision-making for laser telemetry KPIs
Serves as a key point of contact for laser telemetry interpretation and investigation requests, partnering across teams to drive consistent definitions and reliable use of outputs


Complexity


Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.


Disclaimer


This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.


Salary

The pay range for this role is $83,000 to $127,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:


Health insurance
Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Long term/short term disability insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Life insurance
Generous time off policies, including;
4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
11 paid holidays
Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)


The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst I
Description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About The Role

As a Senior Analyst in a well-funded Series C stage start-up, you will be defining our growth potential for years to come.You will be an integral part of Reserv's data team, working to develop and maintain our data model, curate the semantic layer that powers our analytics and intelligent tools, and generate the new features that unlock deeper insight into our claims. For this role, we are seeking data analysts with strong Python and SQL skills, a curiosity for how claims work and how our systems work them, the ability to communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, and the ability to both run independently and collaborate with our engineering and operations orgs. If you are ready to mold the vision for Reserv’s technology, join us on the journey.

What You'll Do


Build and maintain dashboards that provide actionable insights for executive and functional leaders
Develop robust Python- and SQL-based reports to support a deeper understanding of the claim lifecycle and operational performance
Collaborate closely with engineering and operations teams to understand source system structures and translate them into our standardized data model
Conduct analyses to investigate performance issues, identify root causes, and make recommendations to leadership
Serve as the primary technical liaison between the data team and key internal stakeholders, ensuring analytical solutions meet real business needs
Communicate ideas and solutions through clear, concise writing and presentations
Help influence the culture, values, and processes of a growing data team
Enjoy and have fun being creative and thinking outside of the box. You will need to draw on analogous situations you’ve worked on before, but we are not traversing well-traveled roads. “Where we’re going, we don’t need roads!”


Qualifications


2–4 years of experience as an individual contributor in data analytics, business intelligence, or consulting
Strong proficiency in SQL (e.g., Postgres, BigQuery, or Snowflake) and experience working with large, structured datasets
Experience building reports or dashboards in Looker (preferred) or a similar BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Mode)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to distill complex data into clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills — able to summarize findings and present recommendations to senior leaders
Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
Have a strong technical skillset but also the willingness and ability to take over tasks outside your core competency


Benefits


Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!


At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The Company

Cover Genius is a Series E insurtech that protects the global customers of the world’s largest digital companies including Booking Holdings, owner of Priceline, Kayak and Booking.com, Intuit, Uber, Hopper, Ryanair, Turkish Airlines, Descartes ShipRush, Zip and SeatGeek. We’re also available at Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Wayfair and SE Asia’s largest company, Shopee. Our partners integrate with XCover, our award-winning insurance distribution platform, to embed protection for millions of customers worldwide each year.

Our team and products have been recognized with dozens of awards including by the Financial Times which ranked Cover Genius as the #1 fastest-growing company in APAC in 2020. Our diverse team across 20+ countries and many language groups commit itself to diverse cultural programs, in particular “CG Gives” which makes social entrepreneurs out of us all and funds development initiatives in global communities.

Our People are

Bold, Authentic, Purposeful and Inspired

Our People are not

Perfect, Traditional, Complacent or Cautious

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical, adaptable, and impact-driven Senior Data Analyst to join our growing Product Operations team. This pivotal role will embed within our product domains and problem spaces, acting as a critical partner to Product Managers in driving growth and optimizing the end-to-end customer experience.

You will be obsessed with leveraging data to support teams with strategic product decisions, identify growth opportunities, and ensure operational excellence at scale. This role is ideal for someone excited by continuous change, eager to tackle diverse challenges across various product initiatives, and committed to a data-driven culture

Key Responsibilities

What will your day look like?


Empower Product Teams to be Data Driven: As a strategic partner, you will provide cross-product insights and connect the dots across multiple programs. As the "truth seeker," you will objectively analyze data and identify opportunities. You will design, develop, and own insightful dashboards and reports that provide visibility into key product metrics, user engagement patterns, and feature performance. These tools will empower product teams to be data-led and make informed decisions by ensuring Product Managers have accurate information.
Support Data-Driven Decision Making: You will translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined data problems and deliver actionable recommendations through clean, compelling data narratives. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers to understand user needs and ensure that all decisions are informed by robust data and analysis
Drive Product Growth with Actionable Insights: You will perform deep-dive analysis to unpack insights and recommend solutions to top-of-mind problems the business is facing. Your analysis will go beyond simple reporting of "what happened" to provide a clear understanding of "why it happened", supporting product teams in leveraging data for strategic initiatives and decision-making, influencing product strategy and feature prioritization.
Champion Continuous Improvement & Automation: Actively participate in retrospectives and contribute to a culture of learning and iteration, using data to identify areas for process and product improvement. Drive automation and productisation of analytical solutions, transforming client questions into scalable analytical solutions. Proactively identify data quality issues or opportunities for improvement in analytics tooling and reporting.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with diverse teams, including product, marketing, data engineering, and other relevant teams, to align efforts toward growth initiatives and ensure shared understanding of product performance.
Stakeholder Communication: Communicate findings to stakeholders at various levels, adjusting content and complexity to suit the audience, and translating complex analyses into clear, actionable takeaways tailored for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure Accountability: Ensure accountability for analytics quality and successful delivery of key projects with measurable client outcomes. Support quarterly and annual planning efforts with data inputs, forecasting trends, and key performance analytics.


Experience & Skills

What you will bring:


4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably within a product-led organization or supporting product teams.
Strong SQL proficiency is essential for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
Experience with data modeling and transformation tools like dbt (Data Build Tool).
Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Proficiency in building dashboards and reports using business intelligence tools (e.g., Superset) to visualize data and communicate insights effectively.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
A strong understanding of product metrics, user behavior, and sales funnels.
A proactive and curious mindset, with a relentless focus on identifying opportunities for improvement and driving measurable outcomes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence decisions through data.
Adaptability and excitement for working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, embracing new challenges across different product areas.
Basic understanding of Python for data analysis and scripting is a plus.


To Help Us Level Up, You Will Have/be


Data-Driven Mindset: Demands data to inform every significant operational decision.
Problem Solver: Approaches challenges with a solution-oriented attitude.
Accountable & Results-Oriented: Takes full ownership of work and focuses on tangible execution and measurable improvements.
Collaborative Communicator: Fosters clear, timely communication and values constructive feedback.
Systems Thinker: Designs processes that are repeatable, documented, and built to scale; avoids one-off solutions.
Adaptable: Thrives in a dynamic and evolving environment.


Why Cover Genius?

Cover Genius not only cares about being the best in our industry, we care about our team. We’re a business that understands life can be fluid and so we flex to ensure we provide the environment to suit that. What does that mean?


Flexible Work Environment - our teams are hybrid. We work from home on Wednesdays and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times. We also have the added bonus of a Wellness day a month.
Employee Stock Options - we want our people to share in our success, we reward them with ownership for their contribution in creating a world-class company.
Work with like-minded people who are passionate about both the work we're doing and giving back. Our CG Gives programs enables us to all become philanthropists through our peer recognition and rewards system.
Social Initiatives - pictures speak a thousand words!


Sound interesting? If you think you have the best composition of the above, send us your resume and let's chat!

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy.

This position has an annual base salary range C$135,000 - C$175,000

Position Overview

Data is central to how we understand customer behavior, measure product success, and build better experiences for our customers. Autodesk is seeking a Senior Data Analyst - Product Analytics to join the Product Development & Manufacturing Solutions organization. In this role, you'll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Finance, Sales, and Marketing to transform product data into actionable insights that influence product strategy and business outcomes.

As a trusted analytics partner, you will help answer critical questions about feature adoption, customer engagement, retention, and product health. You'll define meaningful success metrics, develop scalable measurement frameworks, and uncover opportunities to improve the customer experience through data.

We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is naturally curious, and enjoys asking difficult questions that lead to better decisions. You combine strong analytical thinking with business acumen and exceptional communication skills to translate complex analyses into compelling stories that drive action.

At Autodesk, we value a hybrid work culture. Remote work is supported in Toronto and Vancouver, Canada. If you live near one of our offices, you're welcome to work there full- or part-time based on your preference.

Responsibilities


Partner with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle to define success metrics and measurement strategies before features launch
Analyze product telemetry, clickstream, and user behavior data to identify opportunities that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention
Design, maintain, and evolve scalable product KPIs and data models that provide consistent measurement across products
Build self-service dashboards, reports, and visualizations that enable teams to independently explore product performance while maintaining trusted business definitions
Conduct deep-dive analyses to understand product usage, customer journeys, and feature performance, translating findings into actionable recommendations
Develop hypotheses, evaluate product changes, and support experimentation and A/B testing where applicable
Partner with Data Engineering to improve event instrumentation, data quality, and analytics infrastructure
Communicate analytical findings to executive and cross-functional audiences through clear storytelling and data visualization
Improve analytics documentation, metric definitions, and best practices to promote consistency and scalability across teams


Minimum Qualifications


5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, or Business Analytics, including experience influencing product or business decisions through data
Demonstrated experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to senior leadership and executive audiences
Expertise in SQL and working with modern cloud data warehouse environments
Advanced experience building dashboards and visualizations using Power BI (required); experience with Tableau or Looker is a plus
Experience analyzing event-based product telemetry, clickstream, or user behavior datasets
Strong understanding of analytical methods, hypothesis-driven problem solving, and translating ambiguous business questions into measurable analyses
Experience working with modern analytics engineering and data pipeline technologies (DBT, Airflow, GitHub, or similar)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience)


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, or product measurement methodologies
Experience using Python (pandas, Jupyter, NumPy, or similar) for exploratory analysis and automation

Experience working within SaaS or cloud software organizations

Autodesk is seeking a Senior Data Analyst - Product Analytics to join the Product Development & Manufacturing Solutions organization. In this role, you'll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Finance, Sales, and Marketing to transform product data into actionable insights that influence product strategy and business outcomes.

As a trusted analytics partner, you will help answer critical questions about feature adoption, customer engagement, retention, and product health. You'll define meaningful success metrics, develop scalable measurement frameworks, and uncover opportunities to improve the customer experience through data.

We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is naturally curious, and enjoys asking difficult questions that lead to better decisions. You combine strong analytical thinking with business acumen and exceptional communication skills to translate complex analyses into compelling stories that drive action.

At Autodesk, we value a hybrid work culture. Remote work is supported in Toronto and Vancouver, Canada. If you live near one of our offices, you're welcome to work there full- or part-time based on your preference.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle to define success metrics and measurement strategies before features launch
  • Analyze product telemetry, clickstream, and user behavior data to identify opportunities that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention
  • Design, maintain, and evolve scalable product KPIs and data models that provide consistent measurement across products
  • Build self-service dashboards, reports, and visualizations that enable teams to independently explore product performance while maintaining trusted business definitions
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to understand product usage, customer journeys, and feature performance, translating findings into actionable recommendations
  • Develop hypotheses, evaluate product changes, and support experimentation and A/B testing where applicable
  • Partner with Data Engineering to improve event instrumentation, data quality, and analytics infrastructure
  • Communicate analytical findings to executive and cross-functional audiences through clear storytelling and data visualization
  • Improve analytics documentation, metric definitions, and best practices to promote consistency and scalability across teams

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, or Business Analytics, including experience influencing product or business decisions through data
  • Demonstrated experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to senior leadership and executive audiences
  • Expertise in SQL and working with modern cloud data warehouse environments
  • Advanced experience building dashboards and visualizations using Power BI (required); experience with Tableau or Looker is a plus
  • Experience analyzing event-based product telemetry, clickstream, or user behavior datasets
  • Strong understanding of analytical methods, hypothesis-driven problem solving, and translating ambiguous business questions into measurable analyses
  • Experience working with modern analytics engineering and data pipeline technologies (DBT, Airflow, GitHub, or similar)
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, or product measurement methodologies
  • Experience using Python (pandas, Jupyter, NumPy, or similar) for exploratory analysis and automation
  • Familiarity with product analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, or similar tools
  • Experience integrating product analytics with Sales and Marketing data sources (Salesforce, Marketo, etc.)
  • Experience working within SaaS or cloud software organizations

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

The Growth and Performance Marketing team within Sun Life’s Client Experience Office (CXO) has embarked on a major transformation. As part of this transformation, we are continuously launching and testing new ideas, platforms, and solutions to generate new leads and identify opportunities for existing clients and group members.

As a senior data analyst on the Client Acquisition Analytics team, you will be part of a large analytics community and will be focused within the Growth and Performance Marketing business helping the team by, but not limited to, mining data for business insights, analyzing and interpreting trends using statistical tools and techniques, reporting on business performance, and triaging code and data-related issues.

You will be supporting several key initiatives that are tied to our vision of growing our client base, improving advisor lead conversion, supporting the Head Office lead Evolution program and Channel of Choice, monitoring of our key performance indicators and championing the Retail Leads Data Modernization.

To achieve this, we will be leveraging many systems across Sunlife, gathering requirements, engaging with subject matter experts, and creating reporting. All of this is to be able to tell the story of our clients’ journeys and gather insights to improve their experience.

What will you do?


Work closely with business partners to identify complex business problems to solve and provide data driven solutions.
Analytic work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations in order to solve business problems.
Work with stakeholders across Sun Life as a subject matter expert in the prospect, client, and advisor data
Ongoing support to uncover opportunities that will drive incremental sales.
Develop metrics and KPIs to measure the performance of analytical and data products in the overall portfolio.
Provide support for annual business plan, monthly sales forecast, and insight analysis.
Operationalize reporting processes and synthesize key metrics into impactful and insightful dashboards to monitor and assess the success of the business initiatives/performance.
Perform reporting automation, self-serve analytics enablement, and promote the culture of analytics-driven decision making.


What you need to succeed:


5 + years experience working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating, and analyzing data, hypothesis testing, data modelling and data visualization)
5 + years experience with SQL, PySpark and other programming languages. Comfortable writing accurate, efficient, but complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources.
2+ years of experience with AWS Cloud Services (e.g. Glue, S3, Athena, Quick Suite)
2+ years of experience working with Tableau or other visualization tools
Experience using oral and written storytelling to share data driven insights in a clear, succinct manner.
Strong partnering approach with a commitment to meeting business partners' unique needs and expectations.
In-depth prioritization, planning, and change management skills to stay within time/scope of a task in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable learning new applications and processes quickly with minimal direction
Ability to document work.


What will be nice to have?


Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, forecasting etc.)
Experience in Salesforce
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Additional statistical programming languages (i.e SAS/R)
Advanced user of MS Excel and MS Access


Preferred Skills:


Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles, with strong attention to detail.
Understanding business. We have got a lot of data, and you need to turn it into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.
A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.


What’s in it for you:


We’re honoured to be recognized as a 2026 Best Workplaces in Canada by Great Place to Work® Canada.
We are thrilled to be recognized by Excellence Canada with their top-level certification, the Canada Order of Excellence for Mental Health at Work®, for prioritizing employee well-being, fostering a positive work culture, and achieving excellence in mental health.
Wellness programs that support the three pillars of your health – mental, physical, and financial
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential.
As a hybrid organization, you and your leader use business and Client need to choose where you work, at home or in the office


This role requires Reliability Security Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time.

Must be able to satisfactorily complete applicable background checks prior to the start date and during employment, in accordance with Sun Life’s policies and practices.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Product
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support our product reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns with our product teams in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on our product teams
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly our product teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around product performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among product stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in supporting product teams through data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise supporting analytics for product teams
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

Headquartered in Detroit, Rocket Loans was established to create the most simple, rocket fast personal loan process. We assembled a top-notch team of individuals combining new, passionate team members with some of the best veterans from Rocket Mortgage to create the most user-friendly lending platform in the world. We have given it our best to create an experience that is best-of-breed in the personal loan industry and commit even more to continuously improving it. At Rocket Loans, you’ll build a career that helps you achieve your professional goals while helping clients get the loans they need to reach their financial goals. We’re looking for innovators and those unafraid to disrupt the status -quo. With an inclusive culture and opportunities to make a positive impact, we’re here to help you foster your career growth.

Title: Analyst Statistician
Description:
Mandate

The Analyst/Statistician advances evidence based decision making across the university by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data related to enrolment, student success, academic programs, operations, and strategic initiatives. The role leverages modern analytics tools—including Power BI and emerging AI driven technologies—to transform complex information into actionable insights. This position supports institutional planning, accreditation, assessment, and compliance reporting while collaborating with academic and administrative units to strengthen the university’s strategic capacity.

Objectives

This position strengthens the university’s ability to make informed, strategic decisions. By integrating advanced analytics, Power BI dashboards, and AI driven insights, the Analyst/Statistician helps shape academic planning, improve student outcomes, and ensure accountability to internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a bachelor’s degree in education, Statistics, Social Sciences, Data Science, or a related field and 3 years related experience. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Include


Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills.
Proficiency with statistical software (e.g., SAS, SPSS, R, Python) and database tools (e.g., SQL).
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and independent work.
High level of attention to detail, clear documentation, and ability to work with sensitive information.
Experience with data visualization tools, including Power BI.
Predictive modeling, time series analysis, forecasting.
Familiarity with AI assisted analytics tools (e.g., natural language query features, automated insights, predictive modeling platforms) and the curation of results.


Preferred


Master’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience in higher education or institutional research, especially in the BC context.
Knowledge of student information systems (e.g., Banner).
Experience applying AI tools to data analysis, forecasting, or workflow automation.
Familiarity with accreditation standards and government reporting requirements.

Title: Product Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
Your Job

Flint Hills Resources is seeking a Product Analyst/Data Analyst to join our team in Wichita, KS. As an IT Product Analyst/Data Analyst, you will serve as a highly capable contributor who helps ensure strong delivery execution and continuity within the product team. You will play a critical role in translating product direction into high-quality delivery outcomes and in extending the team's impact across the broader technology ecosystem. This role is well-suited for someone ready to take accountability for delivery outcomes, influence how work gets done, and contribute meaningfully to business and technology objectives.

What You Will Do


Work closely with the business to understand problems at their root and drive solutions through technology — whether through your own development work or by collaborating across the business, software engineering, data architecture and solutions architecture.
Develop and maintain scripts, agents, and lightweight applications using tools like Python to automate processes, move data, and solve business problems.
Understand data models, system integrations, and application behavior to effectively translate business needs into sound technical approaches.
Analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and surface insights that inform product and business decisions — including understanding how application data and APIs translate into graph and analytical data models.
Own projects end-to-end — from problem statement through delivery and adoption — maintaining accountability for outcomes throughout.
Contribute to roadmap development, collaborating closely with product and business leadership to identify new features, enhancements, and incremental improvements aligned with product direction.
Continuously innovate and push the team forward — challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities to transform how work gets done, and raising the bar for those around you.



Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


Experience in IT, data, software engineering, or a business role with demonstrated technical aptitude
A passion for or experience writing scripts, queries, or code (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL, AI agents, or equivalent) to solve problems, automate processes, or move and validate data
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions
Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship



What Will Put You Ahead


Experience with Cypher, graph databases, or data modeling
Experience with data engineering or API integrations — building pipelines, moving data, or connecting systems
Experience with cloud technologies, specifically AWS (e.g., SQS, CloudWatch, Lambda)
Experience with AI agents, LLMs, or prompt engineering
Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, data modeling, or analytics — including building reports, dashboards, or data products that inform business decisions
Experience in procurement, accounts payable, source-to-pay, or operations



At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Flint Hills Resources is an industry-leading refining company making the oil and transportation products that keep the world moving. We make a large supply of fuel for gas stations and airports in addition to transporting crude oil, natural gas liquids and refined products through 4,000+ miles of pipeline – delivering energy to farmers, manufacturers and families. Our team champions innovation and excellence to help power modern life.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Title: Data Analytics Coordinator
Description:
Position Summary

The Data Analytics Coordinator plays a supporting role as a steward of PRPA's data warehouses, from data ongestion through to the creation and maintenance of reports. They are responsible for ensuring the quality and integrity of data used for various activities from infrastructure planning to business development.

Position Accountabilities


PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.
Load data assets into PRPA’s data warehouses following best practices.
Support and maintain PRPA’s data warehouse.
Maintenance of reports and dashboards.
Training of PRPA staff in end user reporting tools available for accessing PRPA’s data.


WORKING CONDITIONS


Works predominantly in an office environment.
Regular, full-time position (37.5 hours per week). Regular working hours are Mondays to Fridays, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM with 1 hour unpaid lunch break.


JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Formal Education


College diploma in Analytics, Computer Science Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Information Technology.


Related Experience


Three to five years' experience in the industry


Other Requirements


Experience with reporting tools and software including SSRS, PowerBI, Informatica.
Experience with SSIS or other data ingestion and transformation tools.
Experience using Safe FME for processing geospatial data.
Experience with report writing, organizing, and presenting data in support of decision making
Demonstrates statistical and empirical analytical skills
Knowledge of relational database structures, theories, principles, and practices is an asset
Knowledge of ETL methodologies, T-SQL and ArcGIS is an asset
Familiar with the transportation and logistics industry
Demonstrates ability to learn new skills and acquire industry knowledge
Good spoken and written communication skills
Strong problem solving and organizational skills
Accuracy and attention to detail, with an analytical eye
Superior judgment and tact in dealing with sensitive issues and confidential information.
Demonstrates ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and to effectively handle changing priorities.
Enthusiastic and self-motivated. Works well individually as well as in a team environment.
Creative and intuitive thinker.
Demonstrates commitment to the Port’s Vision.
Resilient. Embraces change and thrives on change.
Proficient in MS Office, especially Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint; some exposure to MS Access and Project.
Able to obtain security clearance under Transport Canada's Security Clearance Program.


The base salary range for this role is $77,689 - $97,112. This position is eligible for a performance-based variable incentive targeted at 10% of the base salary.

Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging are at the heart of PRPA’s culture and play a vital role in our growth strategy. We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels a sense of belonging and can contribute to their maximum potential. Our differences are the reason great things happen here. If you are an applicant in need of accommodation or special assistance throughout the interview process, please submit a request by email to careers@rupertport.com.

Individuals of Indigenous descent are strongly encouraged to apply.

Title: Pricing & Reporting Analyst
Description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Sr. Pricing Analyst

Location: Cottonwood Heights, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)

About The Role

The Merchandise Planning team needs a data-driven analyst to own the day-to-day mechanics of pricing across Backcountry's four banners—competitive pricing audits, markdown execution, MAP/MSRP compliance, and the reporting that powers pricing decisions.

As Pricing & Reporting Analyst, you will work directly with the Sr. Pricing Analyst to maximize profitability through smart pricing execution. By 6–12 months, you will be running pricing operations independently, regularly making recommendations that move sell-through, margin, or working capital, and serving as the team's go-to for AI-augmented workflows.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

About The Role


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


What You'll Do


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


Required Qualifications


3–5 years of analyst experience, preferably in retail, ecommerce, or a related data-driven role
Demonstrated daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) for real work—you iterate on prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when AI is the right tool versus when it is not
High proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, formulas) and a strong aptitude to learn technical applications quickly
Solid understanding of retail math (margin, markdown, sell-through, IMU) and financial concepts (GMROI, NPV, CM%)
Awareness of customer pricing behavior—anchoring, discount perception, and how merchandising and pricing decisions land on a product detail page
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with messy datasets
Excellent attention to detail—pricing errors are expensive, and you treat that responsibility seriously
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate analysis into a clear, concise recommendation
Able to work both independently and collaboratively across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred; equivalent demonstrated experience considered
Passion for the outdoor industry and knowledge of outdoor gear is a plus.


Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.


Cross-Functional Impact: Your pricing work carries weight beyond the Pricing team—recommendations you make will shape decisions across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance.
AI-First Skill Building: AI is a first-class tool here, not a buzzword. You will use Claude, Copilot, and similar tools daily and actively shape how the team adopts them.
Real Ownership: This role pairs tactical pricing execution with strategic contributions. You will report to an experienced Sr. Pricing Analyst with growth-focused mentorship and high visibility from day one.
Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.


Interview Process


Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Sr. Pricing Analyst focused on your analytical approach, pricing experience, and AI tool proficiency.
Take-Home Assignment - A pre-built test requiring high-level analysis, the use and documentation of AI as a working partner, and advanced communication skills to convey complex business recommendations.
In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Cottonwood Heights office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.


Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.
