Title: Data Specialist
Description:
Role

The Data Specialist manages the credit union's data infrastructure, ensures the accuracy and accessibility of core and third-party data, and partners with departments across the organization to turn data into actionable insights that support member service and business decisions. This is an in office position.

Major Duties And Responsibilities


Data Warehouse & Database Management: Manage the data warehouse solution; validate and reconcile data from core banking and third-party systems for accuracy and completeness. Administer SQL Server/database environment — updates, table management, indexing, performance tuning, and backup/recovery processes. Maintain data lineage and documentation so data sources, transformations, and definitions are traceable and auditable. Monitor data quality on an ongoing basis (not just at point of extract) using validation rules, exception reporting, and reconciliation checks
Dashboards & Reporting: Partner with management to design, build, and maintain data dashboards that support operational and strategic decision-making. Develop self-service reporting capabilities so departments can pull standard reports without ad hoc requests, freeing capacity for higher-value analysis
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary point of contact for data-driven requests and custom extracts from internal departments (Lending, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, etc.). Translate business questions into data requirements and deliver clear, actionable outputs. Provide basic data literacy support/training to help staff interpret and use dashboards and reports effectively
Emerging Responsibilities / Current Trends: Data governance: Support development and enforcement of data governance policies — data ownership, access controls, retention schedules, and standardized definitions across systems. Data security & privacy compliance: Ensure data handling practices align with GLBA, NCUA guidance, and other applicable member privacy/security regulations, including monitoring for unauthorized access and supporting audit/exam data requests. Cloud & integration management: Manage or support cloud-hosted data solutions and API-based integrations with fintech/third-party vendors, ensuring secure and reliable data flow
Carries out supplementary tasks aligned with the role and department objectives

Knowledge and Skills


Two to Five years of similar or related experience, including time spent in preparatory positions

Microsoft SQL Certification, Associates Degree, College Degree

Work with third party data providers, management, and subject matter experts, developing data visualizations. Dialog is of technical nature that may require communicating abstract data relationships


Other Skills


Knowledge of technology programs utilized by the financial industry including but limited to JackHenry Symitar, Fiserv, Origence, Internet/Intranet applications, and Microsoft Office products. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Purpose of this Position:

The Enterprise Data Analyst is responsible for both designing and developing our data architecture and performing data analysis to support business decision-making. This role encompasses the end-to-end process of data collection, transformation, storage, and analysis. The Enterprise Data Analyst will work with departments across the organization to provide data solutions to our internal teams, ensuring data is reliable, accessible, and actionable, driving insights and strategic initiatives throughout the organization. They will also assist in deploying special projects for the other departments as requested.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes to support data reporting and dashboards.
Organize, model, and store raw data in our data warehouse and data lake.
Analyze and interpret data using statistical methods and tools.
Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
Ensure the reliability, efficiency, and quality of data by developing and implementing processes for data cleaning, transformation, and validation.

Competencies:

Ability to learn internal software and systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage competing projects and priorities effectively.
Ability to interact with varying organizational levels confidently.
Ability to communicate technical information coherently to a variety of stakeholders.
Ability to confidentially interact with and interpret organizational information.
Strong analytical skills.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience:

Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience in data analysis, interpretation, and visualization; or an equivalent combination of education and experience, including 6+ years of experience in data analysis, interpretation, and visualization.
Experience with enterprise software or the transportation and logistics industry is a plus.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Working knowledge of at least one major programming language (e.g., Python, C#, Java, or Scala) required.
Proficiency with statistical analysis and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) required.
Familiarity with big data technologies and platforms such as Delta Lake, Spark, and Databricks required.
Experience with SQL and relational databases is highly preferred.
Knowledge of schema design, data modeling, and data analysis is preferred.
Familiarity with data orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect is preferred.
Preferred certifications in Azure, Power BI, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering include, but are not limited to:
Azure Data Engineer Associate
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
DataCamp Data Engineer Certification
DataCamp Data Analyst Certification
DataCamp Data Scientist Certification
Other related cloud, analytics, or data engineering certifications

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

FTE: 1.0

Hybrid eligible - located in Eugene or Portland, Oregon

Special Instructions to Applicants

To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a complete application that includes (1) an online application, (2) a cover letter, and (3) a resume that addresses how they meet the minimum and/or preferred qualifications. Please include the position location (Eugene or Portland) you are applying for.

We are interested in finding the best candidate for the position. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t think you meet every one of our preferred qualifications- use your application to let us know what is meaningful to you about the role and what transferable skills or other qualities you would bring.

If you have questions about the application process or the position, please reach out to fass@uoregon.edu.

Department Summary

University Advancement (UA) supports the University of Oregon’s (UO) mission of providing exceptional teaching, discovery, and service by strategically positioning the university to create awareness, build long-term relationships, and secure resources that increase understanding and further its aims. The division consists of approximately 200 employees primarily working out of Eugene, with offices in Portland and Bend. We are committed to fostering equity and inclusion in a welcoming, safe, and respectful environment that recognizes the value of all members of our community.

The Advancement Strategies and Technology Innovation (ASTI) department is focused on finding the solutions for foundational issues that will best position UO Advancement to achieve its goals around engagement and fundraising. The department has a unique function in that it is based in UO Advancement, but also has strong working partnerships with The Office of Development as part of University Advancement has a mission to maximize philanthropic impact at the University of Oregon. We do this by identifying, connecting and engaging alumni and friends around the globe with their passions to advance the vision and priorities of the university.

Prospect Development is responsible for the implementation of the prospect management system and for the identification of prospects, strategic prospect review and providing intelligence for the purpose of aiding development officers in optimizing portfolios and fundraising to their highest capacity. This department's work is critical to the future success of fundraising at the University of Oregon and the Advancement initiative to identify the next generation of philanthropic leaders. Prospect Development collaborates with each development team and the department as a whole to promote a systematic and quantifiable framework through which development staff manage relationships and to analyze and identify prospects and related strategies.

Position Summary

Title: Data Analyst, Enterprise Data Governance Team
Description:
Job Details

Job Description:

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in transforming Intel's enterprise data ecosystem and enabling data-driven decision-making? As a Data Analyst on the Enterprise Data Governance Team, you will help improve Intel's business performance by applying data analysis, governance operations, process execution, and measurement practices to complex enterprise data challenges.

In addition to domain analytics responsibilities, this role serves as a key execution partner to EDGT. The role supports the operationalization of enterprise data governance decisions, standards, controls, and processes across one or more data domains. The role is expected to engage across multiple enterprise data domains over time to support consistent governance execution, adoption, and maturity.

This position acts as a bridge between business stakeholders, EDGT, domain owners, data stewards, architecture teams, platform teams, and development teams. The role translates governance decisions into executable actions, supports fit-gap and readiness assessments, manages governance work visibility, and helps ensure standards are adopted and sustained across the enterprise.

The role will also support Governance Operations, Platform, and JIRA responsibilities within the proposed EDGT capability-based model. This includes EDGT operations, JIRA/work tracking, tooling roadmap coordination, capacity visibility, operating rhythm support, templates, documentation, and process orchestration. A critical part of this role is the development and ongoing measurement of data governance metrics that help Intel track progress on its enterprise data governance journey during IAO and beyond. The successful candidate will help define, maintain, and improve governance KPIs, scorecards, maturity indicators, adoption measures, and value-realization metrics that show how governance is progressing across domains, where gaps remain, and where leadership attention is needed.

Key Responsibilities Include


Support execution and adoption of Enterprise-approved data governance standards, guidelines, controls, procedures, and decision frameworks.
Support Governance Operations, Platform, and JIRA activities, including work tracking, backlog visibility, status reporting, dependency tracking, capacity views, templates, and operating rhythm support.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve data governance metrics, KPI frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, and maturity measures.
Track governance progress during IAO and ongoing enterprise transformation, including adoption of standards, data quality outcomes, stewardship engagement, metadata maturity, issue remediation, and governance value realization.
Provide executive-ready reporting and insights that show governance progress, risks, trends, gaps, and recommended actions.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities that drive business insights and operational improvements.
Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into actionable data specifications, governance requirements, and execution plans.
Perform fit-gap analyses, readiness assessments, and risk assessments of data systems, processes, and domains to evaluate alignment with EDGT-approved governance standards.
Serve as the day-to-day bridge between EDGT, domains, architecture, tooling, stewardship, and execution teams.
Partner with domain, architecture, platform, and business teams to translate governance decisions into sustained practices and measurable outcomes.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in a related field such as data science, information systems, supply chain, material science, industrial engineering, business analytics, or a related discipline.
3+ years of relevant experience in data governance, data quality, data processes, business analysis, operations, and technology-enabled process improvement.
Experience analyzing complex datasets and translating insights into business recommendations.
Experience working across business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements, document processes, clarify ownership, and support execution.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, metrics, or KPI measurements.
Experience with JIRA or similar work-management tools to track work items, owners, status, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to perform fit-gap analysis, readiness assessment, risk identification, or implementation support for data, process, or system changes.
Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering, information systems, data science, business analytics, or a related field with 2+ years of relevant experience.
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Python.
Experience with business intelligence, reporting, dashboarding, data visualization, and executive-level performance reporting.
Experience developing enterprise KPI frameworks, governance scorecards, maturity models, value-realization reporting, or adoption metrics.
Familiarity with data governance, master data management, metadata management, data lineage, data quality, data stewardship, or governance operating models.
Knowledge of Intel's Product Life Cycle, supply chain planning, manufacturing execution, product architecture, planning BOM, or dependent planning and execution processes.
Familiarity with tools such as Collibra, Informatica, JIRA, Confluence, SAP, LRP, Atlas, or related governance, workflow, and enterprise data platforms.
Ability to influence stakeholders, structure ambiguous work, drive execution, and communicate governance progress in a clear, measurable, business-focused way.

The role will also support Governance Operations, Platform, and JIRA responsibilities within the proposed EDGT capability-based model. This includes EDGT operations, JIRA/work tracking, tooling roadmap coordination, capacity visibility, operating rhythm support, templates, documentation, and process orchestration. A critical part of this role is the development and ongoing measurement of data governance metrics that help Intel track progress on its enterprise data governance journey during IAO and beyond. The successful candidate will help define, maintain, and improve governance KPIs, scorecards, maturity indicators, adoption measures, and value-realization metrics that show how governance is progressing across domains, where gaps remain, and where leadership attention is needed.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Support execution and adoption of Enterprise-approved data governance standards, guidelines, controls, procedures, and decision frameworks.
  • Support Governance Operations, Platform, and JIRA activities, including work tracking, backlog visibility, status reporting, dependency tracking, capacity views, templates, and operating rhythm support.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve data governance metrics, KPI frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, and maturity measures.
  • Track governance progress during IAO and ongoing enterprise transformation, including adoption of standards, data quality outcomes, stewardship engagement, metadata maturity, issue remediation, and governance value realization.
  • Provide executive-ready reporting and insights that show governance progress, risks, trends, gaps, and recommended actions.
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities that drive business insights and operational improvements.
  • Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into actionable data specifications, governance requirements, and execution plans.
  • Perform fit-gap analyses, readiness assessments, and risk assessments of data systems, processes, and domains to evaluate alignment with EDGT-approved governance standards.
  • Serve as the day-to-day bridge between EDGT, domains, architecture, tooling, stewardship, and execution teams.
  • Partner with domain, architecture, platform, and business teams to translate governance decisions into sustained practices and measurable outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field such as data science, information systems, supply chain, material science, industrial engineering, business analytics, or a related discipline.

Title: Operations Systems Analyst
Description:
The Operations Systems Analyst will assist in tactically driving applications to evolve and enhance Click Bond’s business decision making capabilities. This role will support the identification, research, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues as it relates to database management, data conveyance mechanisms, graphical representation, and AI/Automation processes as well as applications. This role will support and work closely with all functional departments of Click Bond.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Responsible for examining and diagnosing trends and optimizing manufacturing processes to improve efficiency and productivity. This involves conducting data analysis, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing strategies to enhance overall operations.
Develop and create AI/Automation tools to support Click Bonds initiative.
Develop and create dashboards and reporting tools to support team members.
Participate in the development of new methods utilizing data to improve manufacturing processes and outcomes.
Propose process enhancements through data analysis.
Assist in developing and maintaining manufacturing measures, and metrics and apply Lean principles where applicable.
Conduct training on various manufacturing-related tasks.
Learn Click Bond manufacturing processes to better understand data outputs.
Will comply with and meets or exceeds requirements of Click Bond’s Quality and Environmental Management System (QEMS), AS9100, ISO14001, and 27001.
Tasked with the collection of stakeholder requirements, the orchestration of meetings, and the advancement of collaborative efforts in line with the industry’s recognized project management best practices.
Report immediately all suspicious and hazardous conditions to a supervisor.
Understand and observe all safety guidelines and assure quality and safety by complying with all appropriate Click Bond policies and procedures.
Assist in maintaining clean, orderly, and hazard-free work areas.
Able to work with minimal supervision, be a self-starter and be detail oriented.
Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to demonstrate the following competencies:


Strong analytical skills with attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience building dashboards, using measures, and metrics.
Skillful at reading, writing and interpreting documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
Demonstrated ability to present business solutions to executive teams.
Proficient in AI/Automation tools (i.e. – CoPilot Studio, Power Automate, Python, HTML coding).
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Power BI).
Ability to utilize reports, accounting database applications, and MRP/ERP software.
Solid understanding of data structures, relational database, and MRP/ERP systems.
Strong SQL skills and understanding of data warehousing techniques.
Ability to collect business requirements and develop effective reports and dashboards. Additional requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
Ability to write and read English.


Education And/Or Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Field or 3+ years’ experience in a related field.
EPICOR experience is a plus but not required.


Supervisory Responsibilities


This is not a supervisory position.

The work is primarily sedentary, although there may be some walking, standing, bending, and carrying of items, such as paper or books, weighing less than 10 pounds.


Work Environment


Work primarily performed in a standard office environment. If in manufacturing areas, may be exposed to noise, smells, heat, dust, etc.
Work requires the observance of fire regulations and safe work practices.

Communicates respectfully to all team members, vendors, and visitors.
Models a positive attitude.

Title: Print Supplies Big Data Analyst
Description:
Description -

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. This position sits at the intersection of analytics, data quality, product data stewardship, monthly reporting operations, and forecasting enablement. In this role, you will partner closely with data engineers, data scientists, and the supplies forecasting teams to ensure data processing pipeline integrity, maintain key business reference and enrichment data, and automate data verification and acceptance processes.

Responsibilities


Own and support monthly validation processes for print telemetry outputs, dashboard semantic layers, and related usage/share reporting handoffs
Serve as a key analytical partner for Forecasting and business stakeholders, helping answer usage, share, installed base, product readiness, and release approval questions through structured analysis and clear communication
Develop and maintain automated and well-documented processes that support recurring validation, issue diagnosis, data quality checks, and stakeholder decision-making
Conduct root-cause analysis on data discrepancies across sources, grains, tables, dashboards, and processing layers, especially where definitions, filters, platform coverage, or reporting timing create mismatches
Provide consultative support for quick-turn ad hoc requests, escalation support, and deep-dive investigations while helping route work through the appropriate intake, prioritization, and transition processes
Collaborate with dashboard, data engineering, and business intelligence partners to improve transparency, repeatability, and maintainability of analytics outputs
Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members
Applies advanced subject matter knowledge, leads, and contributes to complex projects, and exercises independent judgment in resolving business issues and establishing policies
Develops and builds productive internal/external working relationships and may provide mentoring and guidance to lower-level employees


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field.


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics and problem solving: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, metric design, data validation, anomaly detection, and ability to diagnose complex data issues across multiple factors
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, documentation, data lineage, privacy awareness, and the ability to communicate quality risks and remediation paths
Business intelligence and visualization: experience with Power BI, Qlik, advanced Excel, or similar tools to build stakeholder-ready dashboards, analyses, and presentations
Python for data analysis, validation, automation, time-series analysis, reproducible workflows, and tooling to support recurring quality checks and investigations
SQL, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Databricks and modern analytics tooling: ability to work in notebooks, queries, dashboard-supporting datasets, and AI-assisted development environments while maintaining reproducible and reviewable outputs
Forecasting and time-series: ability to support forecasting partners, interpret restatements and metric volatility, and contribute to forecasting automation or time-series analysis workflows
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation (role-dependent)
Strong documentation habits for code and process development, data analyses and investigations, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance. Familiar with version control (e.g., Git), Jira, and Confluence


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity


Impact & Scope


Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.


Complexity


Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
A Brief Overview

This position builds databases, data pipelines, and dashboards, and performs queries to generate relevant information, and interpret and communicate results. This position analyzes and makes recommendations to improve database, query, and report functioning. This position designs and implements data discipline, quality assurance, data sharing, and legislative compliance. This position also updates and maintains the data catalogue and metadata repository. To be successful in this position, proficiency in Power Automate including the ability to develop and deploy Copilot Studio agents with custom Power Automate flows is essential.




What you will do

Builds databases, data pipelines, and dashboards.
Builds database queries to generate relevant information, and interpret and communicate results.
Develops and maintains reports, dashboards and visualizations.
Performs data analysis using statistics and modeling and creates reports.
Analyzes and makes recommendations to improve database, query, and report functioning.
Interprets data needs, and determines which data sources to use.
Supports staff on use of systems, troubleshoots issues that may arise, and communicates problems to technical resources.
Designs and implements data discipline, quality assurance, data sharing, and legislative compliance.
Updates and maintains the data catalogue and metadata repository.
Serves as a liaison between technical and non-technical resources.
Designs, develops, and delivers educational material for a range of data management workshops.
Other duties as required in support of the department and/or unit.




Required Education

Four-Year Bachelor Degree or equivalent. In addition, requires trade certification, qualification, or on-going learning to remain ahead of changes in technology or emerging fields.

Required Experience

More than 3 years and up to and including 5 years of experience.
Experience with Microsoft Power Automate considered an asset.
Familiarity with Copilot Studio Agents, including integration with Power Automate (Power Flows), considered an asset.
Consideration may be given to an equivalent combination of education and experience.




Job Knowledge and Requirements

Knowledge of concepts and principles in a specialist field that is typically acquired through a combination of advanced professional or academic qualifications and/or substantial work experience.
Provide effective consultation and advice on non-straightforward and/or complex issues.
Interaction with others requires interpersonal skills and the ability to understand and influence.
Adapt messages to meet the different needs of different audiences.
Builds relationships, trust and credibility.
Prioritize and distribute work to deliver objectives on time and to the highest standard.
Identify in advance when the intended results may not be achieved and develops a plan to address the gaps.
Actively participate in project team meetings and develop individual and unit project plans.
Lead procedural or technological change within a unit.
Identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of work processes.
Seek information and input to fully understand the cause of problems.
Appropriately assesses risks before making a decision.
Contribute to the creation and evaluation of possible solutions.
Take action to remove obstacles and address problems before they impact performance and results.
Apply equity, diversity, accessibility, inclusion and Indigenization considerations to decision making and planning.
Promote a work environment that is free from sexual violence, harassment and discrimination, and the ability to show empathy for those who have experienced trauma.

BEC is seeking a Data Analyst who turns the cooperative’s energy and demand-response data into clear reports, dashboards, and analysis that support day-to-day program decisions and season performance. This position reports to the Energy Services Director, with program work directed by the Demand Response Program Manager. It supports program decisions; it does not own the bid-approval, capacity-certification, or validation steps that the program reserves to other roles. A working knowledge of electric power distribution and demand-response concepts is expected.

Essential Job Duties


Build and maintain demand-response performance dashboards and recurring reports — event count, thermostat and battery participation, estimated MWh, member savings, and 4CP versus non-4CP value — benchmarked against the prior-year baseline
Validate all reports and dashboards for data accuracy before distribution
Maintain documentation for all reporting solutions, including data sources, logic, and refresh schedules
Update reports and dashboards promptly when underlying data or program needs change
Analyze event outcomes, enrollment trends, and forecast accuracy; surface anomalies and trends
Prepare the data views that inform the weekly schedule, the monthly bid cycle, and the season benchmark
Build lightweight, self-serve connections (Power Query, scheduled refreshes, direct queries) to pull program data for reporting and benchmarking
Do not build or own production pipelines feeding the bid or validation path; durable, shared data infrastructure remains with the data and reconciliation engineer
Support analysis only; do not certify capacity, prepare or approve bids, or serve as the validation gate
Route platform issues through the Program Manager rather than directly to the developer or vendor
Work with Energy Services staff and the Program Manager to understand reporting needs and translate them into useful views
Provide clear status updates on in-progress work at regular intervals or upon request
Contribute to program planning and continuous-improvement efforts
As time allows and as assigned, provide the same reporting, dashboard, and analysis support to other departments across the cooperative


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSA’s)


Working knowledge of data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, dashboard design, and data visualization principles.
Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL, Power BI, Power Query, Excel, and data-quality practices.
Working knowledge of electric utility operations, demand response, distributed energy resources, and related program performance measures.
Working knowledge of Python software.
Knowledge of forecasting, trend analysis, KPI development, and documentation standards.
Knowledge of data governance and documentation best practices
Strong data analysis, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Proficiency in developing reports, dashboards, visualizations, and SQL queries.
Strong data-validation, documentation, and quality-control skills.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical information to nontechnical audiences.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Ability to interpret complex data, identify trends and anomalies, and translate findings into actionable insights.
Ability to understand business needs and develop practical reporting and analytical solutions.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Energy Services, the Demand Response Program Manager, and other departments.
Ability to adapt reports and dashboards as data sources, program needs, and priorities change.
Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain accuracy, and protect confidential or sensitive information.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and communicate proactively about workload and timelines


Qualifications And Requirements

Education


Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business, engineering, energy, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification or 2 years of experience working extensively with SQL, Power BI, or advanced Excel (Power Query)


Required Experience


1-3 years of experience producing reports or dashboards or analyzing operational data
Experience writing SQL queries against relational databases
Experience working with Python software


Preferred Experience


Familiarity with electric utility or cooperative operations
Familiarity with demand response, distributed energy resources, or ERCOT data
Experience with Apolloware or comparable utility/energy platforms


Additional Requirements


Valid Texas Driver’s License and Related Insurance
Must pass background and drug screening

Competitive salary
Comprehensive benefits, including extended health & dental, life and disability insurance, and more

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. Join an exceptional team of Digital Strategy & Technology professionals helping to power the Canadian Cancer Society’s (CCS) operations and fuel our mission through innovative digital solutions. The Digital Strategy & Technology team is at the forefront of CCS’s digital transformation. Together, they are harnessing digital tools, data and technology to boost fundraising capabilities and enhance the experience of everyone who interacts with us online. With a passion for continuous improvement and a commitment to making an impact, the team ensures CCS’s digital presence is strategic and engaging, helping us inspire and empower more Canadians who care about cancer every day.

MAKING AN IMPACT

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Governance and Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytics solutions, reports, and dashboards that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Leverage SQL, scripting, and modern analytics platforms to extract, transform, and analyze complex datasets, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that align with business goals
Partner with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytics solutions
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making by applying automation, engineering best practices, and modern design patterns to improve how data is analyzed, visualized, and utilized across the organization


What You’ll Be Doing


Analytics & Reporting Development


Report & Dashboard Development


Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Reporting, and Power BI to support organization teams
Build and optimize semantic models and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs
Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility


Analytics & Insights


Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams
Use predictive models and statistical analyses to support donor segmentation, campaign targeting, and fundraising forecasting
Leverage advanced analytics techniques including propensity scoring, trend analysis, and cohort modeling to inform business strategy


Collaboration & Engagement


Partner with cross-functional teams including business partners, data engineers, and digital teams
Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools
Data Development & Transformation


Data Preparation & Processing


Extract, transform, and prepare analytical datasets using SQL, Python and scripting languages
Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required


Data Modeling & Documentation


Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes
Operational Excellence


Automation


Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting


DevOps


Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps


Quality


Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review
Data Governance & Standards


Governance & Compliance


Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)


Data Standards


Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices
Other
Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
Other duties as assigned


Qualifications


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline
More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analytical dataset development
Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design
Others may apply


Operational Excellence


Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows
Knowledge of Agile development practices including code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review
Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports


Analytical Skills


Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable analytics solutions
Strong exploratory data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights from large and complex datasets
Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques


Communication Skills


Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to present complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience collaborating across business functions to support data-driven decision-making
Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred , with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions


What You Can Expect From Us

CCS provides impactful opportunities to transform the lives of Canadians affected by cancer. We are devoted to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse experiences and skills, encouraging all qualified candidates to join us. Our inspiring culture is rooted in our core values and commitment to meaningful change: COURAGEOUS UNITED CARING RIGOROUS

We offer a competitive salary, excellent benefits, including paid parental leave, family sick time, and health insurance—and a fulfilling work environment where your efforts make a meaningful impact daily.

COME AS YOU ARE

At CCS, we celebrate individuality and the strength of diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace that empowers everyone. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those from equity-deserving groups such as BIPOC, 2SLGBTQI+ communities, individuals with disabilities, veterans, and others who contribute to the richness of our organization. Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
About the Opportunity:

The analytics engineer makes sure data is ingested, transformed, scheduled, and ready to be used for analytics. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining data pipelines, analytics systems, and reporting solutions. The analytics engineer also models raw data into clean, tested, and reusable datasets to allow business stakeholders to view and understand data in a warehouse or database.

Qualifications (Required & Preferred):

Education: A bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, or related field (R)

Experience: At least five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, software engineering, or a similar role (R); Expertise in data modeling, ETL development, and data analysis (R)

Skills: Strong ability in SQL for data extraction and manipulation, and proficiency in data warehousing concepts/tools such as Targit, Ignite, and Power BI; Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms such as Azure for data storage and processing; Substantial programming ability using languages/tools such as C++ & .NET for data manipulation and scripting; Solid understanding of relevant data governance, data quality, and data security best practices; Strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to think critically and analytically; Knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, and data warehousing concepts.; Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Targit & Power BI; Knowledge of upgrading data systems like Targit; Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and present insights to business stakeholders (all R).

Role Responsibilities:

Delivers well-defined, transformed, tested, documented, and code-reviewed datasets for analysis
Builds data aggregation pipelines using SQL, .NET, Targit, Power BI
Creates robust data models and architectures to support analytics initiatives
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their analytics needs and deliver comprehensive reports, dashboards, and models
Identifies and implements optimizations to continually enhance query performance, reduce processing time, and increase overall productivity
Designs, develops and maintains data pipelines to ensure efficient and reliable ETL processes
Implements and maintains analytics systems, data warehouses, or data lakes to store and manage structured and unstructured data
Creates and maintains dashboards, visualizations, and reports using tools such as Targit & Power BI to enable data-driven decision-making
Collaborates with Data Analytics Manager to incorporate Power BI and data governance across the organization
Ensures data quality and accuracy by implementing data validation, monitoring, and error-handling processes

Title: BI Data Analyst
Description:
Summary

The Business Intelligence Data Analyst designs and develops software-based data modeling and visualizations with Business Intelligence (BI) tools. This role utilizes various analytical and programming skills to develop BI solutions and supports leadership by designing proactive, value-added data models to provide insight into data driven decision-making

Job Duties


Builds should-cost models for key categories based on commodity indices, labor, transportation, and overheads
Monitors raw material and input costs (e.g., steel, rubber, oil) and supports supplier price increase challenge logic
Manages the Procurement Gains Tracker, ensuring accurate documentation and alignment of savings, cost avoidance, and rebate realization by wave and by category
Supports Category Managers in building strategic fact packs including market sizing, supplier concentration, pricing benchmarks, and share of wallet
Conducts variance analysis to identify margin leakage, supplier underperformance, or pricing gaps
Builds executive-level dashboards and bridges for category reviews and transformation updates
Responsible for end-to-end design and maintenance of BI tool data sets, data models, reports, dashboards and visualizations in support of all department functions,
Designs, develops and optimizes data models for the business unit and other departments.
Routinely meets with various stakeholders to understand their data needs. Develops solutions and processes to fulfill requirements. This typically includes BI dashboards, Python programs, or Excel/VBA reports.
Enhances business insights and decision making with robust, intuitive data visualizations.
Leverages transactional data from enterprise resource planning (ERP) applications to extract, transform and model into reporting and analytics solutions.
Coordinates incremental creation and structure of QVD files from disparate data sources.
Identifies the most impactful layout and presentation of key performance metrics in easy to use self-service dashboards.
Partners with the IT team to develop security standards for BI applications and usage of QVD files containing sensitive financial information.
Partners and develops relationships with cross-functional leaders to improve processes and documentation, and recommends changes that lead to the adoption of world class processes.
Proactively seeks out opportunities to increase business knowledge and create visibility within the organization.
Generates new ideas to streamline processes and collaborates with other departments to create operational efficiencies.
Establishes and implements best practices for data modeling & visualization. Ensures data accuracy.
Performs other duties as assigned.


Education & Experience

Typically requires a bachelor's degree in information systems and three (3) to five (5) years of related work experience or an equivalent combination.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities


Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.
Advanced SQL and experience with a variety of relational databases.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to propose positive business solutions.
Reliability, organization and attention to detail.
Excellent written and oral communication, including presentation skills.
Knowledge of database design techniques and advanced SQL skills required.
Proficiency in Python, R, or other statistics platform preferred.
Professional presence with excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to interact with management at corporate and department levels.
Forward-thinking in implementing tools and techniques to improve analytics, driving better business decisions. Self-motivated and able to independently manage multiple responsibilities concurrently
Ability to collaborate within a team, managing team dynamics and relationships.
Strong partnership skills, across all levels of management, with ability to influence and challenge decisions and processes.
Driver of results, developer and influencer of peers.


LICENSES & CERTIFICATIONS: BI tool certification preferred.

Company Information

Motion Industries offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k), tuition, reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay.

Description:
Job Description

Turn data into impact. Join our team as a Data & Reporting Analyst supporting our PLUS companies, where you’ll transform insights into actionable strategies that drive performance and growth. If you love solving problems, telling stories with data, and partnering with business leaders to make smarter decisions—this is your opportunity to make a real difference.

Essential Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and manage data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor data performance
Use statistical methods to validate and interpret data for business decisions
Create clear data visualizations (charts, graphs, dashboards) to communicate insights
Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver data-driven solutions
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a meaningful way
Document processes, data definitions, and reporting standards
Stay current on data tools, technologies, and industry best practices
Support special projects and continuous improvement initiatives


Qualifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or related field.
Experience: 2-3 years of relevant experience in data analysis. Experience in insurance, healthcare, or financial services is preferred. Relational database experience. Knowledge of reporting/analytical tools. Advanced Excel skills.
Skills: Advanced proficiency in data analysis tooling and software (e.g. SQL, dbt, Excel, and Python).
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI).
Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.
Thorough knowledge of relational database theory and practice.
Technical Competencies: Business & Technology Knowledge: Understands business needs, makes informed decisions, and effectively delivers technology solutions, including related processes and procedures.
Analytical Skills: Ability to identify an opportunity and / or root cause, apply logical reasoning to analyze the facts, and develop and execute and effective outcome.

Title: Research/Data Analyst
Description:
The Office of Workforce and Community Initiatives (OWCI) is seeking candidates to fill a Research/Data Analyst in the position located in Cole County based at 3705 MO Blvd 2nd Floor, Jefferson City, MO. Remote or hybrid is not an option.

The essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

This position is primarily responsible for preparing, managing, and optimizing OWCI program data systems and using those data assets to deliver high‑impact visual analytics for program leadership, management, and executive leadership. The role applies experience in data management to prepare moderate to complex data structures, analyze specifications, and ensure accurate, secure, and reliable data environments that support advanced reporting and visualization.

Using specialized software such as Tableau, MS Office products, and coding languages including Python and SQL, this position develops dashboards, interactive reports, and executive‑level briefings that clearly communicate trends, outcomes, and performance indicators. The role requires strong data modeling skills, attention to data integrity, and the ability to translate complex information into intuitive, visually accurate, and meaningful representations.


Prepare, review, and maintain data structures and data pipelines used for program reporting, ensuring alignment with specifications and adherence to data management standards.
Work with internal and external data analysts, stakeholders, and contractors to create recurring and ad hoc dashboards, visual reports, and data summaries built on stable, secure, and well‑structured data systems.
Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and executive‑ready presentations using Tableau, and other visualization tools, ensuring UI/UX standards and intuitive layouts.
Gather, blend, model, and validate data from multiple disparate sources to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and a single source of truth for reporting and analytics.
Support data management system migration into operational environments and ensure proper testing, documentation, and data integrity throughout the process.
Review and interpret technical specifications to create conceptual and logical data representations that support both data management functions and downstream visual analytics.
Monitor and evaluate database performance considerations relevant to analytics workflows; partner with technical staff to identify issues affecting reporting accuracy or system efficiency.
Present data in simplified and visually compelling formats that highlight trends, anomalies, KPIs, and program performance through charts, visualizations, and narrative explanations.
Apply UI/UX principles including visual hierarchy, accessible layouts, appropriate chart selection, and established color standards to support use by both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Gather requirements from management and executive stakeholders and translate business questions into technical specifications for data structures and reporting products.
Review and evaluate legislation for potential impact on agency operations; prepare visual and data‑driven summaries to support strategic planning and implementation activities.
Provide technical guidance on both data management practices and visualization standards, including effective dashboard design and best practices for analytics‑based performance monitoring.
Assist in evaluating workforce, medical, and community support programs by ensuring data assets are properly structured, validated, and used to generate reliable performance dashboards.
Demonstrate critical thinking and problem‑solving by producing clear, accurate data models and visual narratives that support decision makers at all levels.


Bachelor’s degree and 2-4 years of relevant experience and/or appropriate certification. (Substitutions may be allowed.)

Preferred Experience

Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms; proficiency in Python and SQL; knowledge of data blending and modeling; experience with UI/UX design principles for analytics; previous experience working in or with SkillUP, MWA, A2A, LIHEAP, LIHWAP, CSBG, Jobs League, Food Distribution, VOCA, DVS, JAG, or other programs overseen by OWCI.

Lack of post-secondary education will not be used as a sole basis denying consideration to any applicant.

Individual(s) selected for this position may receive a higher rate based on a pay differential (e.g. shift, or time-of-service pay).

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.
