Title: Data Analyst & Reporting Specialist
Description:
Guidacent is seeking a Data Analyst & Reporting Specialist who will support our public sector client’s Cost of Service Study by leading data collection, validation, reconciliation, workbook development, and reporting activities across financial, operational, staffing, vendor, licensing, infrastructure, and overhead cost data. This role will work closely with the Principal Consultant, Cost of Service & Financial Analysis to organize source data, support cost model development, identify data gaps, document assumptions, and ensure all analysis is traceable to agency-provided records. The Data Analyst will play a critical role in developing structured workbooks, supporting cost allocation analysis, and preparing reporting outputs needed to determine fully loaded service costs, compare costs to existing rates, and support executive-level findings and recommendations.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Data Collection & Organization


Support the development and maintenance of the Cost Data Collection Workbook required to capture source data by program, service, cost category, data source, and assumptions.
Gather, organize, and structure financial, HR/payroll, contract, licensing, procurement, infrastructure, and operational data provided by our client’s stakeholders.
Work with program contacts and business owners to collect data required for labor, vendor, consulting, licensing, maintenance, software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, miscellaneous, and overhead cost categories.
Maintain clear documentation of data sources, assumptions, definitions, and limitations.


Data Validation & Reconciliation


Validate completeness, accuracy, and consistency of source data received from agency systems and stakeholders.
Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and limitations that may affect the accuracy of cost determinations.
Support reconciliation of cost data to agency financial records and document unreconciled variances for review by the Principal Consultant.
Assist in validating allocation assumptions, cost drivers, units of measure, and service-level data inputs.


Cost Modeling & Financial Analysis Support


Support development of service-level cost models used to determine total and per-unit costs for each program or service.
Assist with analysis of direct, indirect, shared, and overhead costs across agreed-upon cost categories.
Support rate comparison analysis by organizing current rate, revenue, cost, surplus, shortfall, and variance data.
Help prepare supporting analysis for cost drivers, variance explanations, cost recovery gaps, and rate adequacy findings.


Reporting & Deliverable Support


Develop and maintain Excel-based analytical workbooks with formulas, documentation, and traceability to source data.
Prepare tables, charts, summaries, and supporting exhibits for the Full Cost of Service Report, Rate Adequacy Analysis, Forecast Analysis, and Executive Summary.
Support creation of reporting materials for agency leadership presentations and oversight briefings.
Ensure work products are organized, editable, agency-accessible, and suitable for review, comment, and final delivery.


Project Team Support


Work directly with the Principal Consultant to support day-to-day analysis, data requests, model updates, and reporting needs.
Coordinate with the Government Cost Allocation SME to ensure data inputs support approved allocation methodologies.
Support the Project Manager by providing status updates on data collection progress, data gaps, and analytical workstream risks.
Maintain organized files, version control, assumption logs, and supporting documentation throughout the engagement.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Public Administration, or a related field.
Three to seven years of experience in financial analysis, data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, accounting support, or consulting analytics.
Strong experience working with financial, operational, staffing, vendor, contract, or budget data.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, structured workbooks, lookups, data validation, and model support.
Experience collecting, cleaning, validating, reconciling, and documenting complex datasets.
Ability to translate raw data into clear analytical outputs, tables, summaries, and reporting exhibits.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain traceability between source data, assumptions, analysis, and final deliverables.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Experience supporting cost allocation, rate analysis, cost recovery, budgeting, or financial forecasting initiatives.
Experience working with public-sector, government, shared services, technology services, or internal chargeback environments.
Experience using Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Access, or similar business intelligence and data management tools.
Familiarity with financial reconciliation, budget variance analysis, cost driver analysis, and operational reporting.
Experience supporting consulting engagements or cross-functional stakeholder data collection efforts.

This role will work closely with the Principal Consultant, Cost of Service & Financial Analysis to organize source data, support cost model development, identify data gaps, document assumptions, and ensure all analysis is traceable to agency-provided records. The Data Analyst will play a critical role in developing structured workbooks, supporting cost allocation analysis, and preparing reporting outputs needed to determine fully loaded service costs, compare costs to existing rates, and support executive-level findings and recommendations.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Data Collection & Organization

  • Support the development and maintenance of the Cost Data Collection Workbook required to capture source data by program, service, cost category, data source, and assumptions.
  • Gather, organize, and structure financial, HR/payroll, contract, licensing, procurement, infrastructure, and operational data provided by our client’s stakeholders.
  • Work with program contacts and business owners to collect data required for labor, vendor, consulting, licensing, maintenance, software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, miscellaneous, and overhead cost categories.
  • Maintain clear documentation of data sources, assumptions, definitions, and limitations.

Data Validation & Reconciliation

  • Validate completeness, accuracy, and consistency of source data received from agency systems and stakeholders.
  • Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and limitations that may affect the accuracy of cost determinations.
  • Support reconciliation of cost data to agency financial records and document unreconciled variances for review by the Principal Consultant.
  • Assist in validating allocation assumptions, cost drivers, units of measure, and service-level data inputs.

Cost Modeling & Financial Analysis Support

  • Support development of service-level cost models used to determine total and per-unit costs for each program or service.
  • Assist with analysis of direct, indirect, shared, and overhead costs across agreed-upon cost categories.
  • Support rate comparison analysis by organizing current rate, revenue, cost, surplus, shortfall, and variance data.
  • Help prepare supporting analysis for cost drivers, variance explanations, cost recovery gaps, and rate adequacy findings.

Reporting & Deliverable Support

  • Develop and maintain Excel-based analytical workbooks with formulas, documentation, and traceability to source data.
  • Prepare tables, charts, summaries, and supporting exhibits for the Full Cost of Service Report, Rate Adequacy Analysis, Forecast Analysis, and Executive Summary.
  • Support creation of reporting materials for agency leadership presentations and oversight briefings.
  • Ensure work products are organized, editable, agency-accessible, and suitable for review, comment, and final delivery.

Project Team Support

  • Work directly with the Principal Consultant to support day-to-day analysis, data requests, model updates, and reporting needs.
  • Coordinate with the Government Cost Allocation SME to ensure data inputs support approved allocation methodologies.
  • Support the Project Manager by providing status updates on data collection progress, data gaps, and analytical workstream risks.
  • Maintain organized files, version control, assumption logs, and supporting documentation throughout the engagement.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Public Administration, or a related field.
  • Three to seven years of experience in financial analysis, data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, accounting support, or consulting analytics.
  • Strong experience working with financial, operational, staffing, vendor, contract, or budget data.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, structured workbooks, lookups, data validation, and model support.
  • Experience collecting, cleaning, validating, reconciling, and documenting complex datasets.
  • Ability to translate raw data into clear analytical outputs, tables, summaries, and reporting exhibits.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain traceability between source data, assumptions, analysis, and final deliverables.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting cost allocation, rate analysis, cost recovery, budgeting, or financial forecasting initiatives.
  • Experience working with public-sector, government, shared services, technology services, or internal chargeback environments.
  • Experience using Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Access, or similar business intelligence and data management tools.
  • Familiarity with financial reconciliation, budget variance analysis, cost driver analysis, and operational reporting.
  • Experience supporting consulting engagements or cross-functional stakeholder data collection efforts.

Title: Technical Business Analyst (Reaching Home portfolio)
Description:
UNITED WAY BC IS PROUD TO BE RECOGNIZED AS ONE OF CANADA'S TOP 100 EMPLOYERS FOR 2026!












ABOUT US – WHY WE’RE HERE:




Across British Columbia, communities are facing urgent and complex social challenges. United Way BC is committed to delivering lasting, community-driven impact in partnership with diverse populations across the province including Indigenous communities whose territories we live and work on. From Vancouver Island to the Lower Mainland, and across the Thompson Nicola Cariboo, Southern Interior, Trail and District, and East Kootenay regions, we walk alongside communities to create meaningful and equitable change. 




Our mission is to strengthen vital connections that support people in need in our communities. 




Our vision is to create a healthy, caring and inclusive community. 




How do we deliver on our mission and vision – by delivering resources and support for those who need it most, and by living our values of being collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable, and inspiring. 




For a more in-depth to look into our work and programs, please visit: www.uwbc.ca.












ABOUT YOU:




As the Technical Business Analyst, you will have experience in business analysis, data analytics, and technical solution development, with a strong understanding of how data can be leveraged to inform decision-making and drive organizational impact. You have education and/or experience in areas such as business analysis, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, and are comfortable working across both technical and business domains.




You bring at least 3 years demonstrated experience in researching, organizing, analyzing, and presenting data to support strategic initiatives. You have strong skills in data analysis, reporting, and business process improvement, along with experience working with databases, BI tools, and data models. You are proficient in using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, and visualization platforms, and bring strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills. You have the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for a variety of audiences, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.












ABOUT THIS ROLE:




Reporting to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance, the Technical Business Analyst plays a key role in supporting United Way BC’s ability to leverage data to inform decision-making, strengthen community impact, and enhance organizational performance. This role will work primarily to support the Community Impact & Investment (CII) department, taking the lead on data-related priorities for multiple portfolios. This requires a deep understanding of United Way BC’s impact work and how data can be used to inform that work in a meaningful, community-centred way.




Working collaboratively with CII and other internal teams, the position develops and maintains reporting solutions, conducts analysis to identify trends and opportunities, and supports the development of data models and performance indicators. This position will require working closely with the direct supervisor, portfolio leads, and CII leadership to understand priorities, translate data and reporting requirements into practical solutions, and ensure reporting and analysis are aligned with impact objectives. The Technical Business Analyst also contributes to advancing data governance practices, improving workflows, and ensuring that staff are equipped with the tools and knowledge needed to effectively use data in their work.




* This is a regular full-time role with an end date of March 31, 2028, and may be subject to extension or early conclusion. The primary portfolio focus of this role is Reaching Home, and this position will report to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance.












Duties & RESPONSIBILITIES:




Key Responsibilities: Data and Reporting Solutions  





Develops, supports and manages reports and dashboards for monitoring key metrics including community impact and financial performance


Develops and implements organizational data models


Lead and/or participate in organizational initiatives related to research, reporting and analytics 





Key Responsibilities: Strategic Support and Analytics 





Conducts comprehensive analysis; highlighting key insights and recommendations on donor strategies, fundraising initiatives and impact strategy


Contributes to the development of operation strategies Including measurement, tracking, trends analysis, benchmarking and goal setting where applicable 


Educate and support staff to strengthen their data knowledge and facilitate effective communication and data usage





Key Responsibilities: Business Process Improvement





Support data governance practices and activities, contribute to development and maintenance of business glossary and data quality standards


Review methodologies, procedures and workflows to identify areas to improve operational efficiency 


Develops and manages process documentation 





General 





May participate in community engagement or fundraising activities 


Performs other duties related to the qualifications and requirements of the job 













QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:




Education:





Undergraduate degree focusing on Computer Science, Business, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent education/experience 





Experience:





Three (3) years' experience as a business, technical, data analyst or related role with experience in researching, organizing, analyzing and presenting data for management use 





Skills:





Proficiency in the use of databases, spreadsheets, project management tools at a moderately to highly complex level 


Advanced skills in data querying (SQL) and experience with associated BI Tools (PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) 


Experience with digital product development life cycles 


Knowledge of scripting or statistical languages (Python, R, etc.) is an asset 


Experience with any of the following is an asset, but not required; Advanced data analytics, Machine Learning, Predictive and/or statistical modelling 


Ability to use and interpret contact management databases 


Skilled in evaluating, developing and implementing processes and procedures to achieve objectives and use data effectively 


Ability to manage and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment by adapting and modifying sequence of work, methods, and standards to meet changing conditions 


Strong interpersonal skills to contribute to developing a successful team environment 


Strategic thinking with well-developed problem-solving skills 


Strong written and oral communication to communicate complex data to a variety of audiences 


Ability to exercise a high level of tact and discretion in both internal and external interactions is critical 













WORKING CONDITIONS:





Adaptable to schedule changes and outside of business hours to attend meetings and events 


Hybrid role with a minimum of three (3) days in the office





 




CHARACTERISTICS:




For success at UWBC and in this role, certain demonstrable characteristics will be required:





A commitment to building healthy, caring and inclusive communities, internally and externally 


Embodying the organization’s core values to be collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable and inspiring


Ability to navigate ambiguity and comfortably operate in it


Drive to succeed as an individual and as a team member













At UWBC, we don’t just accept difference - we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, programs, donors, and the communities we live and work in. At UWBC, we encourage all applicants regardless of age, sex, gender identity, colour, religion, sexual orientation, or any other basis to apply.




Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women, people of colour and indigenous people are less likely to apply to roles unless they meet every qualification. At UWBC, we are dedicated to Justice, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion, so if you are excited about this role, but your experience and qualifications are not perfectly aligned, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this, or other roles.




This is a bargaining unit role with CUPE Local 1760. This position is at Pay Grade 39, which is $92,310.40 annually, if you are within Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region and $88,615.80 annually, if you are outside Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region.




Candidates must live within 80 KMs (commuting distance) from any of our offices as this position is currently a hybrid role and office attendance is required.




Interested candidates are invited to apply by submitting a cover letter and resume to job competition C-2026-26.




We kindly ask for no phone calls, please. Due to the high number of applications UWBC receive, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in UWBC.

Title: Business Optimization Analyst
Description:
Drive Business Transformation Through Data, Process Improvement, and Artificial Intelligence.

Thompson Thrift is seeking a Business Optimization Analyst to identify, lead, and implement process improvements across our Construction and Accounting organizations. This role combines business analysis, process improvement, data analytics, automation, and emerging AI technologies to improve operational efficiency and business performance.

If you're a naturally curious problem solver who enjoys analyzing how work gets done, identifying opportunities for improvement, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful change, this is an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact within a growing real estate organization.

Why Thompson Thrift?

Thompson Thrift is an integrated, full-service real estate company engaged in the development, construction, leasing, and management of high-quality multifamily communities nationwide. We’re committed to building exceptional places, and developing the people who make them possible.

At Thompson Thrift, You’ll Find


Values-Driven Culture: Excellence, Service, and Leadership guide everything we do.
Career Growth: Training, mentorship, and long-term development opportunities.
Work-Life Support: Competitive benefits, flexibility, and wellness programs.
Real Impact: Hands-on involvement in industry-leading multifamily projects.


Your Role as a Business Optimization Analyst

As a Business Optimization Analyst, you'll partner with leaders across Construction, Accounting, and other business functions to improve processes, optimize workflows, and leverage technology to enhance operational performance. You'll combine business analysis, SQL, reporting, automation, and AI-powered solutions to streamline operations, improve decision-making, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

This is much more than a reporting role. Success requires strong business acumen, analytical thinking, project leadership, and the ability to influence change across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Improvement


Analyze existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimization.
Partner with stakeholders to understand operational challenges and business objectives.
Document current and future-state workflows and recommend practical improvements.
Lead process improvement initiatives from discovery through implementation.
Measure, track, and communicate the impact of optimization efforts.


Data Analysis & Business Intelligence


Utilize SQL to analyze operational and financial data.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities that support strategic decision-making.
Develop data-driven recommendations for business leaders.
Support reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Validate data accuracy and improve access to meaningful business information.


Automation & Artificial Intelligence


Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency.
Evaluate and implement AI-enabled solutions that increase productivity and business performance.
Promote the adoption of AI tools and best practices across the organization.
Support workflow automation initiatives using Microsoft Power Platform and similar technologies.


Project Leadership


Lead cross-functional business optimization initiatives.
Coordinate project plans, stakeholder communication, implementation activities, and timelines.
Build alignment across teams while driving adoption of new processes and technology.
Measure project success and communicate business outcomes.


Our Ideal Candidate for this Role

Education


Bachelor's degree in Business, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Operations Management, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.


Experience


5+ years of experience in business analysis, process improvement, business intelligence, operations, construction operations, or a related discipline.
Experience using SQL to analyze and interpret business data.
Proven success identifying and implementing process improvements.
Experience leading cross-functional projects and organizational change initiatives.


Skills & Attributes


Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to simplify complex business challenges into actionable solutions.
Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
Experience leveraging AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies to solve business problems.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience within construction, real estate development, or related industries.
Experience with Microsoft Power BI.
Experience with DAX and data modeling.
Experience using Microsoft Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools.
Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience supporting Accounting, Finance, or Operations teams.
Experience using advanced AI-assisted platforms such as OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar technologies to improve analysis, automation, and business processes.


Why This Role Matters

The Business Optimization Analyst helps shape how Thompson Thrift operates by improving business processes, enhancing data-driven decision-making, and introducing innovative technologies that drive operational excellence. Your work will directly influence efficiency, collaboration, and long-term business success while helping teams embrace smarter ways of working through automation and artificial intelligence.

If you're passionate about business optimization, analytics, process improvement, SQL, automation, and AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Use of AI in Hiring

Thompson Thrift uses AI-assisted tools within our applicant tracking system to support parts of the recruiting process. These tools assist recruiters but do not make hiring decisions or independently determine candidate outcomes. All hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. If you have questions about our hiring process, please contact us at recruiting@thompsonthrift.com.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge this information and confirm that the information you have provided is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge.

Title: Data Analyst, Amazon
Description:
Harvest Group is an integrated commerce agency that helps high-growth consumer brands win in today's complex retail landscape. Since 2006, we've partnered with some of the world's most recognized brands to navigate the intersection of in-store and digital commerce, retail media, and social platforms across leading retailers including Walmart, Sam's Club, Target, Amazon, Costco, and Kroger.

What sets Harvest Group apart is our connected approach. By aligning strategy, execution, and insights across every stage of the retail journey—and powering that work through our proprietary technology platform—we help brands create sustainable growth in an increasingly dynamic marketplace.

But our success starts with our people.

At Harvest Group, our culture and values shape how we work, serve our clients, and support one another. We believe in building meaningful relationships, pursuing excellence with humility, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do their best work while continuing to grow professionally and personally.

Our commitment to our people has earned recognition as one of the nation's best workplaces, including:


Inc. Best Places to Work (2025, 2026)
Great Place to Work Certified (2024)
Fortune Best Workplaces for Women (2024)
Fortune Best Medium Workplaces (2024)
Fortune Best Consulting & Professional Services Workplaces (2024)
Business Intelligence Group Best Places to Work (2023)



Our Values


Integrity – Doing what is right in all things
Relationship – Pursuing depth, trust, and collaboration
Service – Laboring for others with humility and care
Excellence – Delivering extraordinary performance and results with humility
Journey – Embracing our past and planning for our future with faith



Description

The Amazon Data Analyst is responsible for performing analytics and creating custom audiences using industry-leading clean room technology, primarily Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC). This role supports a broad portfolio of small to mid-sized client accounts, primarily conducting AMC measurement analysis and building custom audiences from established templates and custom client requests. The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, sharp analytical thinking, and a genuine interest in retail data and the Amazon ecosystem. This role reports to the AMC Specialist.

This role will be based in Rogers, AR. If you are applying but do not currently reside in Northwest Arkansas, please note that relocation will not be covered by Harvest Group.

Responsibilities


Execute AMC analytics across a defined menu of deliverables for small to mid-sized client accounts. Core use cases include path to conversion, average purchase cycle, new to brand analysis, incrementality measurement, and custom audience builds for Amazon DSP.
Utilize strong SQL skills to analyze data and generate insights
Build and maintain a library of repeatable AMC query templates and workflow documentation, ensuring work is organized, reproducible, and transferable across accounts.
Validate and quality-check AMC audience builds before activation, with particular attention to custom attribute logic and expected output.
Exhibit resilience by making informed decisions in uncertain or ambiguous situations
Communicate findings clearly to account managers and internal stakeholders, and support account manager education on AMC baseline capabilities including path to purchase, time to purchase, and new to brand incrementality metrics.
Apply analytical thinking to problem-solving and decision-making processes



Requirements


At least 2-4 years of experience in analytics/data insights
At least 2-4 years of experience writing SQL

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Title: Technical Business Analyst (Reaching Home portfolio)
Description:
UNITED WAY BC IS PROUD TO BE RECOGNIZED AS ONE OF CANADA'S TOP 100 EMPLOYERS FOR 2026!












ABOUT US – WHY WE’RE HERE:




Across British Columbia, communities are facing urgent and complex social challenges. United Way BC is committed to delivering lasting, community-driven impact in partnership with diverse populations across the province including Indigenous communities whose territories we live and work on. From Vancouver Island to the Lower Mainland, and across the Thompson Nicola Cariboo, Southern Interior, Trail and District, and East Kootenay regions, we walk alongside communities to create meaningful and equitable change. 




Our mission is to strengthen vital connections that support people in need in our communities. 




Our vision is to create a healthy, caring and inclusive community. 




How do we deliver on our mission and vision – by delivering resources and support for those who need it most, and by living our values of being collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable, and inspiring. 




For a more in-depth to look into our work and programs, please visit: www.uwbc.ca.












ABOUT YOU:




As the Technical Business Analyst, you will have experience in business analysis, data analytics, and technical solution development, with a strong understanding of how data can be leveraged to inform decision-making and drive organizational impact. You have education and/or experience in areas such as business analysis, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, and are comfortable working across both technical and business domains.




You bring at least 3 years demonstrated experience in researching, organizing, analyzing, and presenting data to support strategic initiatives. You have strong skills in data analysis, reporting, and business process improvement, along with experience working with databases, BI tools, and data models. You are proficient in using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, and visualization platforms, and bring strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills. You have the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for a variety of audiences, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.












ABOUT THIS ROLE:




Reporting to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance, the Technical Business Analyst plays a key role in supporting United Way BC’s ability to leverage data to inform decision-making, strengthen community impact, and enhance organizational performance. This role will work primarily to support the Community Impact & Investment (CII) department, taking the lead on data-related priorities for multiple portfolios. This requires a deep understanding of United Way BC’s impact work and how data can be used to inform that work in a meaningful, community-centred way.




Working collaboratively with CII and other internal teams, the position develops and maintains reporting solutions, conducts analysis to identify trends and opportunities, and supports the development of data models and performance indicators. This position will require working closely with the direct supervisor, portfolio leads, and CII leadership to understand priorities, translate data and reporting requirements into practical solutions, and ensure reporting and analysis are aligned with impact objectives. The Technical Business Analyst also contributes to advancing data governance practices, improving workflows, and ensuring that staff are equipped with the tools and knowledge needed to effectively use data in their work.




* This is a regular full-time role with an end date of March 31, 2028, and may be subject to extension or early conclusion. The primary portfolio focus of this role is Reaching Home, and this position will report to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance.












Duties & RESPONSIBILITIES:




Key Responsibilities: Data and Reporting Solutions  





Develops, supports and manages reports and dashboards for monitoring key metrics including community impact and financial performance


Develops and implements organizational data models


Lead and/or participate in organizational initiatives related to research, reporting and analytics 





Key Responsibilities: Strategic Support and Analytics 





Conducts comprehensive analysis; highlighting key insights and recommendations on donor strategies, fundraising initiatives and impact strategy


Contributes to the development of operation strategies Including measurement, tracking, trends analysis, benchmarking and goal setting where applicable 


Educate and support staff to strengthen their data knowledge and facilitate effective communication and data usage





Key Responsibilities: Business Process Improvement





Support data governance practices and activities, contribute to development and maintenance of business glossary and data quality standards


Review methodologies, procedures and workflows to identify areas to improve operational efficiency 


Develops and manages process documentation 





General 





May participate in community engagement or fundraising activities 


Performs other duties related to the qualifications and requirements of the job 













QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:




Education:





Undergraduate degree focusing on Computer Science, Business, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent education/experience 





Experience:





Three (3) years' experience as a business, technical, data analyst or related role with experience in researching, organizing, analyzing and presenting data for management use 





Skills:





Proficiency in the use of databases, spreadsheets, project management tools at a moderately to highly complex level 


Advanced skills in data querying (SQL) and experience with associated BI Tools (PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) 


Experience with digital product development life cycles 


Knowledge of scripting or statistical languages (Python, R, etc.) is an asset 


Experience with any of the following is an asset, but not required; Advanced data analytics, Machine Learning, Predictive and/or statistical modelling 


Ability to use and interpret contact management databases 


Skilled in evaluating, developing and implementing processes and procedures to achieve objectives and use data effectively 


Ability to manage and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment by adapting and modifying sequence of work, methods, and standards to meet changing conditions 


Strong interpersonal skills to contribute to developing a successful team environment 


Strategic thinking with well-developed problem-solving skills 


Strong written and oral communication to communicate complex data to a variety of audiences 


Ability to exercise a high level of tact and discretion in both internal and external interactions is critical 













WORKING CONDITIONS:





Adaptable to schedule changes and outside of business hours to attend meetings and events 


Hybrid role with a minimum of three (3) days in the office





 




CHARACTERISTICS:




For success at UWBC and in this role, certain demonstrable characteristics will be required:





A commitment to building healthy, caring and inclusive communities, internally and externally 


Embodying the organization’s core values to be collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable and inspiring


Ability to navigate ambiguity and comfortably operate in it


Drive to succeed as an individual and as a team member













At UWBC, we don’t just accept difference - we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, programs, donors, and the communities we live and work in. At UWBC, we encourage all applicants regardless of age, sex, gender identity, colour, religion, sexual orientation, or any other basis to apply.




Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women, people of colour and indigenous people are less likely to apply to roles unless they meet every qualification. At UWBC, we are dedicated to Justice, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion, so if you are excited about this role, but your experience and qualifications are not perfectly aligned, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this, or other roles.




This is a bargaining unit role with CUPE Local 1760. This position is at Pay Grade 39, which is $92,310.40 annually, if you are within Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region and $88,615.80 annually, if you are outside Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region.




Candidates must live within 80 KMs (commuting distance) from any of our offices as this position is currently a hybrid role and office attendance is required.




Interested candidates are invited to apply by submitting a cover letter and resume to job competition C-2026-26.




We kindly ask for no phone calls, please. Due to the high number of applications UWBC receive, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in UWBC.

Title: Technical Business Analyst (Healthy Aging portfolio)
Description:
UNITED WAY BC IS PROUD TO BE RECOGNIZED AS ONE OF CANADA'S TOP 100 EMPLOYERS FOR 2026!












ABOUT US – WHY WE’RE HERE:




Across British Columbia, communities are facing urgent and complex social challenges. United Way BC is committed to delivering lasting, community-driven impact in partnership with diverse populations across the province including Indigenous communities whose territories we live and work on. From Vancouver Island to the Lower Mainland, and across the Thompson Nicola Cariboo, Southern Interior, Trail and District, and East Kootenay regions, we walk alongside communities to create meaningful and equitable change. 




Our mission is to strengthen vital connections that support people in need in our communities. 




Our vision is to create a healthy, caring and inclusive community. 




How do we deliver on our mission and vision – by delivering resources and support for those who need it most, and by living our values of being collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable, and inspiring. 




For a more in-depth to look into our work and programs, please visit: www.uwbc.ca.












ABOUT YOU:




As the Technical Business Analyst, you will have experience in business analysis, data analytics, and technical solution development, with a strong understanding of how data can be leveraged to inform decision-making and drive organizational impact. You have education and/or experience in areas such as business analysis, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, and are comfortable working across both technical and business domains.




You bring at least 3 years demonstrated experience in researching, organizing, analyzing, and presenting data to support strategic initiatives. You have strong skills in data analysis, reporting, and business process improvement, along with experience working with databases, BI tools, and data models. You are proficient in using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, and visualization platforms, and bring strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills. You have the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for a variety of audiences, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.












ABOUT THIS ROLE:




Reporting to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance, the Technical Business Analyst plays a key role in supporting United Way BC’s ability to leverage data to inform decision-making, strengthen community impact, and enhance organizational performance. This role will work primarily to support the Community Impact & Investment (CII) department, taking the lead on data-related priorities for multiple portfolios. This requires a deep understanding of United Way BC’s impact work and how data can be used to inform that work in a meaningful, community-centred way.




Working collaboratively with CII and other internal teams, the position develops and maintains reporting solutions, conducts analysis to identify trends and opportunities, and supports the development of data models and performance indicators. This position will require working closely with the direct supervisor, portfolio leads, and CII leadership to understand priorities, translate data and reporting requirements into practical solutions, and ensure reporting and analysis are aligned with impact objectives. The Technical Business Analyst also contributes to advancing data governance practices, improving workflows, and ensuring that staff are equipped with the tools and knowledge needed to effectively use data in their work.




* This is a regular full-time role with an end date of March 31, 2030, and may be subject to extension or early conclusion. The primary portfolio focus of this role is Healthy Aging, and this position will report to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance.












Duties & RESPONSIBILITIES:




Key Responsibilities: Data and Reporting Solutions  





Develops, supports and manages reports and dashboards for monitoring key metrics including community impact and financial performance


Develops and implements organizational data models


Lead and/or participate in organizational initiatives related to research, reporting and analytics 





Key Responsibilities: Strategic Support and Analytics 





Conducts comprehensive analysis; highlighting key insights and recommendations on donor strategies, fundraising initiatives and impact strategy


Contributes to the development of operation strategies Including measurement, tracking, trends analysis, benchmarking and goal setting where applicable 


Educate and support staff to strengthen their data knowledge and facilitate effective communication and data usage





Key Responsibilities: Business Process Improvement





Support data governance practices and activities, contribute to development and maintenance of business glossary and data quality standards


Review methodologies, procedures and workflows to identify areas to improve operational efficiency 


Develops and manages process documentation 





General 





May participate in community engagement or fundraising activities 


Performs other duties related to the qualifications and requirements of the job 













QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:




Education:





Undergraduate degree focusing on Computer Science, Business, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent education/experience 





Experience:





Three (3) years' experience as a business, technical, data analyst or related role with experience in researching, organizing, analyzing and presenting data for management use 





Skills:





Proficiency in the use of databases, spreadsheets, project management tools at a moderately to highly complex level 


Advanced skills in data querying (SQL) and experience with associated BI Tools (PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) 


Experience with digital product development life cycles 


Knowledge of scripting or statistical languages (Python, R, etc.) is an asset 


Experience with any of the following is an asset, but not required; Advanced data analytics, Machine Learning, Predictive and/or statistical modelling 


Ability to use and interpret contact management databases 


Skilled in evaluating, developing and implementing processes and procedures to achieve objectives and use data effectively 


Ability to manage and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment by adapting and modifying sequence of work, methods, and standards to meet changing conditions 


Strong interpersonal skills to contribute to developing a successful team environment 


Strategic thinking with well-developed problem-solving skills 


Strong written and oral communication to communicate complex data to a variety of audiences 


Ability to exercise a high level of tact and discretion in both internal and external interactions is critical 













WORKING CONDITIONS:





Adaptable to schedule changes and outside of business hours to attend meetings and events 


Hybrid role with a minimum of three (3) days in the office





 




CHARACTERISTICS:




For success at UWBC and in this role, certain demonstrable characteristics will be required:





A commitment to building healthy, caring and inclusive communities, internally and externally 


Embodying the organization’s core values to be collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable and inspiring


Ability to navigate ambiguity and comfortably operate in it


Drive to succeed as an individual and as a team member

At UWBC, we encourage all applicants regardless of age, sex, gender identity, colour, religion, sexual orientation, or any other basis to apply.




Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women, people of colour and indigenous people are less likely to apply to roles unless they meet every qualification. At UWBC, we are dedicated to Justice, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion, so if you are excited about this role, but your experience and qualifications are not perfectly aligned, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this, or other roles.




This is a bargaining unit role with CUPE Local 1760. This position is at Pay Grade 39, which is $92,310.40 annually, if you are within Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region and $88,615.80 annually, if you are outside Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region.




Candidates must live within 80 KMs (commuting distance) from any of our offices as this position is currently a hybrid role and office attendance is required.




Interested candidates are invited to apply by submitting a cover letter and resume to job competition C-2026-25.




We kindly ask for no phone calls, please. Due to the high number of applications UWBC receive, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in UWBC.

Title: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist
Description:
POSITION TITLE: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist

DEPARTMENT: Finance, Administration & Information Technology

CLASSIFICATION: MGO-07

SALARY RANGE: Starting at $79,591.00 Per Annum

POSITION TYPE: Full-time, Permanent

LOCATION: Saskatoon

ACCOUNTABLE TO : Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT

Brief Overview

The Financial Database & Analytics Specialist is responsible for the profiling, development, integration, and optimization of enterprise databases and reporting solutions that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, performance measurement, and operational analysis. This position serves as the government's technical specialist in database profiling, data availability, systems integration, business intelligence, and analytical reporting, helping transform data from multiple systems into reliable information for decision-making across government.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Compliance, Governance & Risk Management


Profiles, develop, maintains, and optimizes enterprise databases, data models, and reporting structures that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, operational analysis, and performance measurement.
Supports the integration of data across finance, payroll, human resource, procurement, project management, funding agreement, and other government systems.


Financial Analysis & Decision Support


Provides technical and analytical support for budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, funding agreement reporting, trend analysis, key performance indicators, and executive reporting.
Works closely with Finance to ensure reliable information is available to support financial planning, resource allocation, reporting obligations, and decision-making.


Enterprise Reporting & Business Intelligence


Develops and maintains reports, dashboards, data extracts, automated reporting solutions, and analytical models that support government-wide reporting requirements.
Translate business requirements into practical database structures, queries, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions that improve accessibility and use of information while maintaining data security, privacy protection standards.


Data Quality, Automation & Continuous Improvement


Improves the accuracy, consistency, reliability, and accessibility of enterprise data used for financial and operational reporting.
Identifies opportunities to streamline reporting processes, automate recurring reporting requirements, reduce manual effort, and improve the efficiency of data collection and analysis activities across government.


Technical Documentation, Collaboration & Advisory Support


Develops and maintains technical documentation related to databases, data models, data flows, and system integrations.
Works collaboratively with ministries, departments, program areas, internal consulting teams, external consulting teams, Information Technology, and system vendors to assess data availability, recommend appropriate data structures and classifications, and support reporting and analytical requirements.
Other duties as assigned by the Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong proficiency in SQL, data extraction, transformation, and reporting development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the ability to translate reporting requirements into technical solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power Query, and financial data analysis tools.
Ability to assess data availability, relationships, and appropriate categorization across multiple systems.
Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
Understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, performance measurement, and government reporting environments.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years progressive financial analysis, database development or relevant experience.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SSRS, or equivalent.
An equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and progressively responsible experience may be considered


Additional Requirements


Must undergo a Criminal Record Check
Valid Saskatchewan driver’s license and access reliable transportation
Please submit your application by 9:59 PM on August 27, 2026.


Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Data Analyst, Revenue Operations
Description:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

Revenue Operations at FacilityOS owns the data layer behind how we go to market and how we build that that layer out on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, sourced primarily from Salesforce and our GTM stack.

We are hiring a Data Analyst to own the models and reporting that sit on top of it. This is not a dashboard-maintenance role. You will build the semantic models, write the transformation logic, and be the person the GTM leaders and CRO come to when a number doesn't reconcile.

The role suits someone who has spent two to four years doing real analytics work and wants ownership of a data platform rather than a queue of report requests.

What You'll Own


Semantic models and reporting. Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and reports covering pipeline, bookings, forecast accuracy, conversion, retention, and customer health. Own the definitions, not just the visuals.
Data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Build and maintain pipelines and notebooks bringing Salesforce and GTM system data into the lakehouse. Own transformation logic, refresh schedules, and data quality checks.
Analysis that changes decisions. Quarterly pipeline and coverage analysis, segmentation and territory work, win/loss and cohort analysis, and ad hoc investigation into why a metric moved. Bring a recommendation, not just a chart.
Data integrity across the GTM stack. Reconcile Salesforce against downstream systems, find and fix the breaks, and flag the process problems causing them.
Documentation. Metric definitions, model lineage, and runbooks that let someone else pick up your work.


Required

What we're looking for


2–4 years in an analytics, BI, or data analyst role, ideally supporting a B2B SaaS revenue or GTM function
Strong SQL — joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning
Hands-on Power BI: data modelling, DAX, star schema design, performance optimization
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a cloud platform. Microsoft Fabric is what we run; Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery experience translates
Python for data work — transformation, API pulls, automation
Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model (objects, relationships, reporting quirks)
Able to take an ambiguous business question, decide what analysis actually answers it, and present the result to leaders without hand-holding


Nice to have


dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Experience with Gainsight, Gong, SalesLoft, Clay, ZoomInfo, or HubSpot
Exposure to SaaS revenue metrics — ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, CAC payback
Git and a habit of version-controlling analytical work


How We Work

You will often be the most technical person in most rooms you're in. That means explaining your work clearly, pushing back when a request is the wrong question, and being direct about what the data does and doesn't support.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click here.

FacilityOS thanks all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

Compensation Range: CA$85K - CA$95K

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Description:
About The Role

We are looking for the VOC Data & Insights Specialist who thrives on turning raw data into actionable stories. In this role, you will be the bridge between our customer data systems and business decisions. You will be responsible for pulling data directly from APIs, querying a Data Warehouse as an advanced end-user, and building dynamic reports in Excel and Tableau.

A significant portion of this role focuses on Support Operations and Text Analytics. You will leverage Zendesk Explore to monitor support performance and use text analytics to extract meaningful customer sentiment and trends from unstructured data.

If you love data wrangling, have a knack for finding patterns in text, and enjoy building practical reports using both warehouse data and platform APIs, we want to hear from you.

You Will Be Responsible For


Data Extraction & Querying: Query data directly from our Data Warehouse to pull relevant operational datasets. Connect to and extract data from various platform APIs when direct warehouse integration isn't available.
Data Preparation: Clean, manipulate, and merge disparate datasets (from DWH, APIs, and manual uploads) to ensure accuracy and consistency before reporting.
CX & Support Analytics: Act as our internal expert for Zendesk Explore. Build, maintain, and optimize dashboards to track customer support KPIs, team productivity, and service bottlenecks.
Text & Sentiment Analytics: Analyze unstructured text data (customer tickets, feedback, chat logs) using text analytics techniques to identify emerging customer pain points, feature requests, and sentiment trends.
Report & Dashboard Creation: Design and maintain clear, user-friendly reports and dashboards in Tableau and Excel (utilizing advanced formulas, Power Query, and Pivot Tables) for cross-functional teams.


Our Successful Candidate Will Have The Following


DWH & API Familiarity: Strong experience as a DWH user (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) with the ability to write SQL queries to extract data. Experience working with APIs to pull data. SQL , Python.
Tool Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Excel (Power Query is a must) and hands-on experience building visualizations in Tableau.
Zendesk Explore: Direct, practical experience navigating and building custom reports within Zendesk Explore.
Text Analytics: Experience with text mining, sentiment analysis, or categorization of unstructured qualitative data.
Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot trends and anomalies that others might miss.
Communication: Ability to explain data concepts and insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 18 offices worldwide.

Data Analyst

About Nexters

Nexters is an international game development company that strives to introduce the joy of core gaming experiences to casual players. In 2021 we went public and listed on the NASDAQ (GDEV). We want brilliant professionals who love building great games in a team with one of the best cultures.

About Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst at the intersection of data and marketing to join the Data Ecosystem team and help transform data into actionable business tools. This role is not about traditional analytics and ad-hoc requests, but about building solutions - from research and prototyping to implementation of tools that are actively used by the marketing team in their daily work.

What You’ll Be Doing


Developing and improving data-driven tools to increase marketing team efficiency
Designing and prototyping automated solutions (including AI-based ones) to accelerate creative production and traffic acquisition
Working on algorithmic approaches to media buying and campaign optimization
Integrating with external data sources and advertising platforms
Conducting data research, identifying growth opportunities, and transforming them into practical tools
Promoting a data-driven culture and expanding access to useful analytics for marketing
Working end-to-end: from problem definition and research to implementation and impact on business metrics
Collaborating with marketing, UA leads, analysts, and engineers, aligning solutions across teams
Quickly diving into problem contexts and taking ownership of results


We hope that you have


Expert-level SQL and experience working with large-scale data (ClickHouse / BigQuery / Redshift / PostgreSQL)
Strong Python skills (pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels, sklearn, etc.)
Deep understanding of marketing metrics and unit economics (LTV, CAC, ROI, retention, payback)
Hands-on experience with advertising platforms (Meta, Google Ads, Axon, etc.) and MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust)
Experience in taking analytical solutions through to implementation and measurable business impact
Ability to work in ambiguity: independently define approaches and drive tasks to completion
Ability to rapidly prototype solutions and validate hypotheses
Proactivity: willingness to suggest improvements in processes, tools, and approaches
Strong communication skills: ability to discuss solutions, align with stakeholders, and collaborate across teams


Nice to have


Experience building production-ready solutions
Experience with PySpark / Databricks
Experience designing ETL pipelines (Airflow, Luigi, or similar)
Experience automating processes (including with AI)
Experience building tools for marketing or UA teams
Experience in mobile products or the gaming industry
Strong systems thinking: ability to structure problems, define logic, and design processes


What We Offer


Healthcare Medical care program (including dental service) or medical care compensation are available for you wherever you wish to work. The basic medical care program is also available for your family members if you choose to work from our official locations – Cyprus, Armenia, and Kazakhstan.
Work, life, and balance We offer a fair amount of paid vacation days and sick leave. You can work at one of our comfortable offices in official locations or from home.
Sports You can choose various sports activities like yoga, football, and volleyball in our official locations.
Relocation support A relocation package is available for you if you decide to join us in one of our official locations.
Skills improvement Let's learn languages: you can visit online English language courses. Greek and Armenian language lessons are available for everyone who works in Cyprus or Armenia. Our company encourages people of Nexters to take part in game jams, hackathons, and relevant conferences and meetups as expert speakers.
Community & ESG We are proud of our local communities and support employees’ social initiatives. Dream big, act big: Nexters contribute to gaming’s positive impact on the world, hold a sustainability strategy, and take part in charity projects all over the world.


Work format

In one of the company's offices in Armenia, Cyprus, Kazakhstan or remotely.
