Title: Supply Demand Execution Analyst - 12 month contract
Description:
Summary
Do you have a passion for invention and self-challenge? Do you thrive on pushing the limits of what’s considered feasible? People here at Apple don’t just create products they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionised entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do! Detailed operational excellence is a cornerstone of our ability to consistently surprise and delight our customers. 

Description
An opportunity exists for an ambitious, highly motivated professional to join the Supply Demand Execution (SDE) team as an SDE Data Analyst. We are looking for forward-thinking individuals who will be tasked with leading the end to end execution process for a number of our product lines, support & lead capital projects along with translating business priorities into a systematic & automated plan.

This role is pivotal to meeting and supporting the demand of our customers within the EMEIA region (Europe, Middle East, India and Africa). This is a meaningful role that provides execution leadership on a cross functional basis across the wider operations organisation. Do you think strategically & anticipate change in direction? Are you persistent with your attention to detail, enjoy solving problems and have a passion for continuous process improvement?

Responsibilities

Lead the execution activities for your designated product lines, ensuring a seamless exceptions-based process.
Identify, communicate and resolve any issues impacting the plan with the critical focus being on the customer. The scope of the execution activities will be managing across the Online, Retail and Reseller routes to market.
Evaluate risks to the execution plan and proactively work with internal teams to implement contingencies & mitigate risk to achieving execution goal.
Drive New Product Introduction (NPI), Quarter End and other peak event execution plans with a keen eye on simplification while at the same time balancing customer requirements and operational efficiency.
Coordinate cross-functionally across the operations organisation to drive alignment on all key execution activities, particularly NPIs.
Scale from operational detail to strategic perspective to ensure the best solutions are identified across all partner teams, influencing and delivering process & system innovation as part of the SDE strategy leveraging SAP, BI tools and AI / Data Science solutions.
This role will provide the opportunity to innovate & drive multiple projects on SAP, Data Science solutions, Business Intelligence tools to support the strategic goals of Apple.  

Minimum Qualifications

Strong data analysis and numerical skills to identify trends & business opportunities.
Comfortable using BI reporting tools & data visualisation tools.
Meticulous attention to detail with a track record of dealing with complex large data sets.
Data management skills with an ability to translate business requirements into a systems plan on Enterprise Solutions.
Technically minded & comfortable in system configuration on SAP, managing tables & translating business requirements into a technical plan.
Experienced in stitching across multiple groups (business & technical teams), influencing & gaining support on process change and system design.
Excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, both written and verbal with the ability to present complex system execution plans to executive teams both regionally and globally.


Preferred Qualifications

A relevant third-level degree e.g. Supply Chain, BIS, Data Science, Engineering or Business related field would be an advantage however, if you have relevant experience or similar field you are encouraged to apply.
Strong business acumen with ability to think strategically and see the bigger picture.
Presentation skills and program / project management experience, a distinct advantage.
Relevant operations experience, preferably in a high-tech or computer related industry.
Ability to manoeuvre and manage through complex situations, examples being New Product Introduction / Supply Chain Management / Manufacturing Operations / Complex Systems issues.


At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Collaborating on the modernization of internal data infrastructure.

Education

Title: Analyst
Description:
About The Department

The Programme Management & Quality Assurance (PMQA) Unit serves as the Authority’s centralised support structure for all change and delivery initiatives. It is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving MFSA’s project management standards, ensuring consistency, transparency, and alignment across all organisational change activities. PMQA is structured around three core pillars: programme management, change management, and quality assurance. Together, these pillars provide a unified framework that supports effective planning, execution, and oversight of initiatives across the Authority.

About The Role

The Analyst will play a vital role in evaluating project data, driving governance standards, and optimizing portfolio performance. The selected candidate will be required to work with colleagues at all levels within Business and Technical departments to provide change process consultancy, training, guidance and support based on expert knowledge.

Main Responsibilities Include


Data Analysis & Reporting: Supporting in the gathering and analysis of complex project data to build executive dashboards and manage information reports;
Governance & Compliance: Supporting the monitoring of active projects for adherence to organizational frameworks, standards, and stage-gate processes;
Risk & Issue Oversight: Tracking and analysing portfolio-level RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs and escalating critical variances through the project managers;
Process Optimization: Identifying operational gaps and supporting continuous improvement initiatives;
Project Management: Supporting the respective project managers and participating in regular status meetings with stakeholders to perform timely follow-up on agreed actions;
Undertake any other duties as assigned by the Head and/or as may be required by the MFSA from time to time based on the exigencies of the Authority.


About You

The role requires an academic qualification in Business, Project Management, IT and/or Change Management or a relevant field at National Qualifications Framework (NQF) Level 6 or higher, duly certified by the Malta Qualifications Recognition Information Centre (MQRIC), or a widely recognised professional certification at an equivalent level.

Along with the aforementioned academic qualification, you should also possess a minimum of three (3) years working in a project management or change management environment, or in an area related to the role.

If you do not have the necessary academic or professional qualifications but you have at least seven (7) years of relevant experience, we would still be interested in speaking with you.

Skills And Competencies


Project Management techniques used to plan, execute, monitor and close projects effectively.
Proficiency in data manipulation (excel, SQL, PowerBI) and core PPM software (MS Project, JIRA, or similar platforms).
Capability to work on own initiative, cross-functional communication, presentation skills and conflict resolution.
Experience of working in a dynamic and high pressure environment with multiple deadlines.
Solid knowledge of the financial services industry will be beneficial.


Other Important Information

The MFSA is an Equal Opportunities Employer as certified by the NCPE (National Commission for the Protection of Equality) and is committed to a policy of equal opportunity in all aspects of employment and will take care to avoid any form of discrimination in its recruitment procedures. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
OBDeleven is all about making car tech easy and accessible for everyone. For over 10 years, we've been building powerful yet simple diagnostic and customization tools for car enthusiasts worldwide.

As we continue to grow the OBDeleven ecosystem, we're looking for a Data Analyst who will help us turn data into insights, support better business decisions and uncover opportunities to improve our products and customer experience.

This is not a role focused only on reporting. You'll work with data across different areas of the business, partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and other teams, and help turn complex questions and data into clear, actionable recommendations.

What You'll Do


Analyse customer, product and business data to support better business and product decisions
Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions
Define, monitor and improve KPIs and maintain clear metric definitions
Analyse funnels, cohorts, retention, segmentation and trends to identify opportunities and investigate anomalies
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Evaluate business initiatives, product features and experiments and help measure their impact
Validate data quality, identify gaps and work with engineers to improve data pipelines and documentation
Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Engineering and other teams to understand their needs and deliver meaningful insights
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and contribute to a culture of data-driven decision-making


We expect


2-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics, BI or a related field
Strong hands-on SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries and window functions
Experience analysing customer, business, operational or product data
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports using a BI or data visualisation tool
Good understanding of analytical methods such as funnel, cohort, retention/churn, segmentation and trend analysis
Ability to turn business questions into structured analyses and clear, actionable recommendations
Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work independently, take ownership and collaborate effectively with different teams
Experience with Python, A/B testing, product analytics or cloud data platforms would be considered an advantage
Fluency in Lithuanian and full professional proficiency in English


Here's what we offer:


Fair pay for bold work: We reward your expertise with competitive pay that grows as you do
Hybrid Work Flexibility: Work 3 days in the office and 2 days from home or wherever suits you best.
Focus on your well-being: Choose your comprehensive health plan, get paid days off to care for yourself and your family, and enjoy flexible working hours, as well as your birthday day off.
More time that truly counts: Enjoy a 4-day workweek for one month a year, depending on how well the company hits its goals. Plus, earn an additional vacation day for every working year with us - up to 4 extra days
Real learning opportunities: Grow your skills with a 2% gross salary learning budget. Take your monthly paid self-learning day and improve stress-free.
Culture that connects: Enjoy Friday lunches on us, team buildings, company parties, and all the usual office perks like snacks, a cozy lounge, sport communities, and more.
Environment for real impact: Got an idea that'll make OBDeleven better? Share it, get feedback, fine-tune, and take action. We trust expertise and value ownership.


Salary range

Gross salary in a range: 2800 - 4500€ / month. The salary range is flexible, and we're open to discussing your expectations based on your experience and competencies.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Back to all jobs

Data Analyst

About Nexters

Nexters is an international game development company that strives to introduce the joy of core gaming experiences to casual players. In 2021 we went public and listed on the NASDAQ (GDEV). Nexters is part of the GDEV holding, which includes not only Nexters, but also Cubic Games, Royal Ark, Game Gears studios.Our people work worldwide from offices in Cyprus, Armenia, and Kazakhstan or remotely. We want brilliant professionals who love building great games in a team with one of the best cultures.

About Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst at the intersection of data and marketing to join the Data Ecosystem team and help transform data into actionable business tools. This role is not about traditional analytics and ad-hoc requests, but about building solutions - from research and prototyping to implementation of tools that are actively used by the marketing team in their daily work.

What You’ll Be Doing


Developing and improving data-driven tools to increase marketing team efficiency
Designing and prototyping automated solutions (including AI-based ones) to accelerate creative production and traffic acquisition
Working on algorithmic approaches to media buying and campaign optimization
Integrating with external data sources and advertising platforms
Conducting data research, identifying growth opportunities, and transforming them into practical tools
Promoting a data-driven culture and expanding access to useful analytics for marketing
Working end-to-end: from problem definition and research to implementation and impact on business metrics
Collaborating with marketing, UA leads, analysts, and engineers, aligning solutions across teams
Quickly diving into problem contexts and taking ownership of results


We hope that you have


Expert-level SQL and experience working with large-scale data (ClickHouse / BigQuery / Redshift / PostgreSQL)
Strong Python skills (pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels, sklearn, etc.)
Deep understanding of marketing metrics and unit economics (LTV, CAC, ROI, retention, payback)
Hands-on experience with advertising platforms (Meta, Google Ads, Axon, etc.) and MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust)
Experience in taking analytical solutions through to implementation and measurable business impact
Ability to work in ambiguity: independently define approaches and drive tasks to completion
Ability to rapidly prototype solutions and validate hypotheses
Proactivity: willingness to suggest improvements in processes, tools, and approaches
Strong communication skills: ability to discuss solutions, align with stakeholders, and collaborate across teams


Nice to have


Experience building production-ready solutions
Experience with PySpark / Databricks
Experience designing ETL pipelines (Airflow, Luigi, or similar)
Experience automating processes (including with AI)
Experience building tools for marketing or UA teams
Experience in mobile products or the gaming industry
Strong systems thinking: ability to structure problems, define logic, and design processes


What We Offer


Healthcare Medical care program (including dental service) or medical care compensation are available for you wherever you wish to work. The basic medical care program is also available for your family members if you choose to work from our official locations – Cyprus, Armenia, and Kazakhstan.
Work, life, and balance We offer a fair amount of paid vacation days and sick leave. You can work at one of our comfortable offices in official locations or from home.
Sports You can choose various sports activities like yoga, football, and volleyball in our official locations.
Relocation support A relocation package is available for you if you decide to join us in one of our official locations.
Skills improvement Let's learn languages: you can visit online English language courses. Greek and Armenian language lessons are available for everyone who works in Cyprus or Armenia. Our company encourages people of Nexters to take part in game jams, hackathons, and relevant conferences and meetups as expert speakers.
Community & ESG We are proud of our local communities and support employees’ social initiatives. Dream big, act big: Nexters contribute to gaming’s positive impact on the world, hold a sustainability strategy, and take part in charity projects all over the world.


Work format

In one of the company's offices in Armenia, Cyprus, Kazakhstan or remotely.

Title: Qlik Developer
Description:
A well-established organisation is looking for an experienced Qlik Developer to join its Business Intelligence team. This is an excellent opportunity for a data-focused professional with strong QlikView and Qlik Sense experience who enjoys turning complex data and business requirements into meaningful reporting solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with business users and stakeholders to understand their needs, develop and maintain Qlik solutions, and help deliver accurate insights that support business performance and decision-making.




Key Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and enhance QlikView and Qlik Sense dashboards, reports, and BI solutions.
Work closely with business users to understand reporting requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Analyse product, market, and business data to identify trends and generate meaningful insights.
Develop reporting solutions that provide accessible and accurate information for business decision-making.
Work with data warehouse information to create reports and support business performance monitoring.
Maintain and continuously improve existing Qlik applications, BI systems, and reporting solutions.
Troubleshoot issues within Qlik applications, reports, and BI models.
Identify opportunities to improve existing BI systems and reporting processes.
Ensure reports and dashboards are accurate, reliable, and aligned with business requirements.
Perform quality assurance checks on reports and BI solutions before delivery.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to continuously improve reporting and business intelligence capabilities.




Requirements

4+ years of experience in Qlik Development, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a similar role.
Strong hands-on experience with QlikView and Qlik Sense is essential.
Proven experience developing Qlik dashboards, reports, and data visualisations.
Good understanding of data warehousing and business intelligence concepts.
Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to troubleshoot BI models and investigate data-related issues.
Proactive approach with the ability to take initiative and identify opportunities for improvement.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
Previous industry experience will be considered an advantage.




What's on Offer

Salary up to €60,000 per annum, depending on experience.
Opportunity to work extensively with QlikView and Qlik Sense.
Exposure to business-critical BI, reporting, and data projects.
Close collaboration with business stakeholders and technical teams.
Opportunity to have a direct impact on business reporting and decision-making.
Professional development and long-term career progression opportunities.




If you're an experienced Qlik Developer looking for your next opportunity and have a strong background in QlikView and Qlik Sense, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At myPOS, we’re all about helping businesses grow and get paid. We make payments simple, smart, and accessible for everyone, but we’re more than just payment solutions - myPOS is a partner in growth. From free multicurrency accounts to powerful e-commerce tools, we’re here to support business owners of all sizes and everyone out there who dreams of starting their own business.

As we are expanding our team, we’re looking for Data Analyst to help us make a real difference in the Fintech industry. Ready to join us and shape the future of payments? Let’s make it happen!

About the role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our Data & AI team. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing data, providing actionable insights to improve operational performance and supporting data-driven decision-making.

What you’ll do:


Data Analytics and Insight Generation: Analyse operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities. Deliver insights that support strategic initiatives and performance improvement across business functions.
Reporting and Dashboard Development: Build and maintain interactive dashboards and automated reports using PowerBI. Ensure reports are scalable, reliable, and aligned with stakeholder needs.
Data Modeling and Database Knowledge: Leverage your understanding of database design, data modeling principles, and SQL to structure data effectively and support analytical tasks.
Process Optimisation and Automation: Identify manual processes and propose data-driven automation solutions to improve speed, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Forecasting and Resource Planning: Analyse historical performance data to support workforce and capacity planning efforts across different departments.
ETL Process Design and Optimisation: Collaborate with data engineers or independently design efficient ETL processes to ensure clean, timely, and reliable data flow across systems.
Ad Hoc Analysis and Decision Support: Perform on-demand analysis to support urgent business questions or evolving needs. Translate raw data into actionable insights that guide tactical and strategic decisions.
Stakeholder Collaboration and Requirement Gathering: Work with diverse business teams to understand analytical needs, translate them into technical requirements, and deliver actionable solutions.
Project Leadership: Lead BI projects from conception to completion. Manage timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations while ensuring technical excellence.
Data Quality and Integration Support: Monitor data integrity across systems. Contribute to the improvement of data pipelines and ensure consistency across internal tools and platforms.
Cross-Functional Communication: Partner with cross-departmental stakeholders to align analytical outputs with business objectives, and ensure adoption of insights in everyday decision-making.
Continuous Learning and Data Innovation: Stay current with trends in data analytics, tooling, and best practices. Contribute to fostering a modern, data-driven culture across the organization.


This role is perfect for you if you have:


Experience: Proven experience (3-5 years) in data analytics, process-oriented or a similar role
Technical Skills: Proficiency in PowerBI (dashboards and extensive DAX experience), SQL, excellent knowledge of MS Excel. Working knowledge of data modeling and ETL processes.
Analytical Mindset: Ability to interpret complex data sets and translate them into clear, actionable insights that support operational performance and business growth
Business Acumen: Solid understanding of business strategies, market trends, and how data can be leveraged to optimise outcomes
Customer centricity: Ability to analyse data to improve customer satisfaction and create seamless customer experience
Familiarity with data lakes, data warehouses and cloud platforms (preferably GCP)
Collaboration & Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively communicate data insights to non-technical audiences and leadership team.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Economics, or a related field


Why you should join myPOS:


Vibrant international team operating in hi-tech environment
Annual salary reviews, promotions and performance bonuses
myPOS Academy for upskilling and training
Unlimited access to courses on LinkedIn Learning
Annual individual training and development budget
Refer a friend bonus as we know that working with friends is fun
Teambuilding, social activities and networks on a multi-national level


What we offer:


Excellent compensation package
25 days annual paid leave (+1 day per year up to 30)
Full “Luxury” package health insurance including dental care and optical glasses
Meal vouchers of 102.26 EUR per month
Fully covered Multisport card
Fully covered public transport pass for Sofia
Free coffee, snacks and drinks at the office


Who we are:

Since 2014 we’ve been all about making payments easier and more accessible for businesses of all shapes and sizes. Whether you’re at the counter, selling online, or on the move, we’ve got businesses covered with smart, accessible and affordable solutions that keep things easy.

Our mission? It’s simple. Help businesses get paid by taking advantage of modern tech and innovative ideas, so payment challenges are a thing of the past.

Pro tip:

Take it easy about meeting every requirement - this job description is just that, a job description! Even if you don’t tick every box, we want you to apply anyway! This is your chance to grow, learn, and build your career with us. We value potential over perfection, and we are all about mutual growth!

Apply by filling in the form below and send your CV in English!

myPOS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified candidates will be considered for employment without discrimination based on age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Your application will be confidentially reviewed in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Personal information will be used solely for the job application and will be stored for a period needed by the application process. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. Good luck!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Starship Technologies is revolutionizing deliveries with autonomous robots. These robots are designed to deliver food, groceries, and packages across neighborhoods in minutes. Starship has now completed millions of autonomous deliveries to date, traveled millions of miles, and is currently doing more than 140k road crossings each day. Our contribution to society includes reducing congestion and pollution, providing zero-emissions deliveries, increasing the quality of life for residents, empowering seniors and disabled people, and enabling affordable delivery for local businesses.

We are growing fast, and we are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the team.

You will be a key strategic partner to our Commercial and Operational leaders, building the logic that proves the value of our technology and secures both our next level of commercial success and our ability to scale operations to match.

What the job is all about:

The boring part is done. Our data is accessible, the BI layer is solid, and most numbers already exist somewhere. You will not spend your first year digging yourself out of a data hole. What we don't have is enough hands to cover it all as deeply as we'd like. Your work splits in two:

Impacting company strategy - finding answers to questions nobody can answer yet. Should we scale? Where should we scale? At what unit economics? Why does one town work while the next one doesn't? These are “why?” and “what if?” questions, and they make up most of this role.

Freeing up time for the complex questions - making sure we don't have to answer the same questions over and over again. The knowledge mostly exists already, scattered across dashboards and people's heads. Your job is to pull it into the open so that people can answer the easy questions themselves and you can get to the more interesting ones.

Your main responsibilities are:

This role covers two domains that meet in the middle. The Commercial team asks where to expand and once we’re there, how to make it successful. Field Operations asks how we can run it well.

On the commercial side:


Find the root causes behind business trends to solve complex commercial problems and maximise volume. For example, why the order conversion rate dropped 20% at a site. High ETAs, payment gateway failures, dynamic pricing, school holidays, or an alien invasion?
Back our expansion decisions with evidence. Which grocery stores or restaurants in which towns should we go to next, weighing cost, drivability, routing efficiency, demographics, and store popularity. Should we prefer big cities or small towns?
Empower Commercial leaders by replacing static reports with dynamic tools, such as always-up-to-date partner dossiers, so the team negotiates with evidence rather than opinions.


On the operational side:


Be the analytical partner to Field Operations. Their days are full of concrete problems: robots idle in one hub while another misses deliveries, broken bots waiting for pickup, spare parts running out, fixes taking too long, spillages, etc. Your job is not to answer each one, but to help them frame the problem, put a number on it, set a target worth hitting, and check whether the fix worked. Most of these come back monthly with a different site attached, so building the logic once beats answering it eleven times.
Zoom out. Operations is, well, operational. Someone needs to step back and say what the biggest opportunities actually are - whether that is partner satisfaction, customer experience, cost per delivery, or revenue per robot - rather than waiting to be asked. That someone is you.


What’s in it for you?


A team worth joining. Small, senior, and self-aware. We ask for feedback, we take it, and we take pride in getting a lot done with limited resources, tackling problems nobody has solved before.
Real access, real influence. You will work with people at every level, from specialists to senior leadership across Commercial, Operations, Engineering and Product, as a partner rather than a service desk. Your analysis drives our decisions: whether we scale a market, where we go next, what we fix first. When the answer goes into a partner negotiation or a board discussion, you are the one who helps make sure it holds.
You are not starting from scratch. The platform is established: dbt, Databricks, semantic layer, Claude wired into our data stack, and pipelines that work. You inherit a foundation and build on top of it rather than rebuilding it.
The questions are unusually good. Because the product is physical and the business is multi-sided, an average question here needs several worlds joined together. Working out whether a town is worth entering means combining robot telemetry, partner order data, walking distances and terrain, human courier ETAs, and demographics. Working out why ETAs are drifting means separating autonomous driving behaviour from operational realities and weather conditions. There is no textbook and no playbook. You will connect datasets that were never designed to meet.
Room to grow. We are a fast-growing company where your contribution is visible, and there is plenty of room to grow - by deepening your expertise, taking on bigger challenges, or moving into new areas.
A flexible hybrid model. The team works mostly from home and gathers at the office 1-2 times a week.


What we hope you’ll bring to the table:


Solid experience in an analytical role, with a track record of business, growth or product analysis rather than reporting: Data, Business, BI, Growth or Product Analyst, Data Scientist, Solutions Engineer or similar.
Strong SQL skills, working with complex datasets.
Experience driving complex topics end-to-end, from a rough idea to a proposed plan, to executing the solution, and presenting it so that it is understandable and useful to everyone.
Pragmatic can-do mindset. You focus on impact rather than the beauty of the method, and decide pragmatically when a spreadsheet is enough and when the answer is a dashboard, a pipeline or an ML model.
The ability to get your point across to anyone, whether it is the Autonomous Driving team, the Commercial team or senior management.
Judgement about what matters. You can tell urgent apart from important apart from impactful, and you know the most urgent thing is usually neither of the other two.
Fluent English, written and spoken.
Beneficial: dbt, Databricks, Python or R, and experience with semantic or metric layers.

Title: Business Analyst, Fan Care Community
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

#WeAreEA and we exist to inspire the world to play. EA values creativity, pioneering, passion, determination, learning, and teamwork. We mean things like acting with curiosity, speaking up with original ideas, and committing to each other as one team.

Come join us! We’re hiring a Business Analyst, Fan Care Community to join EA’s Fan Care Community organization.

EA’s Fan Care organization exists to help our fans get the most fun from their games. From onboarding new players to getting them back in the game, we support fans across their EA experiences. We value people who bring new ideas and perspectives to make Fan Care a great place to be and be from. We strive to make EA known for taking care of its fans. We’re fans taking care of fans and people talking to people

We're looking for a Business Analyst, Fan Care Community to transform community and fan experience data into actionable insights that support Fan Care Community strategies. Sitting at the intersection of strategy and execution, you'll analyze fan behaviors, community health, and business performance to identify opportunities that improve fan experiences and drive better outcomes across EA's games and services.

Success in this role means delivering insights that improve community engagement, fan experiences, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

You will report to the Director of Programs and Planning and work with key stakeholders in the Community and Fan Intelligence organizations.

What You’ll Do


Analyze community health, engagement, growth, and sentiment across owned and social channels.
Identify emerging player trends, concerns, and opportunities through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Develop reporting frameworks that measure community program effectiveness.
Partner with Community leaders to measure and optimize the impact of community initiatives and campaigns.
Analyze fan experience data from multiple tools and sources to understand fan behaviors and needs
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, helping drive data-informed decisions and prioritization.
Evaluate business processes, anticipate requirements, and uncover areas for improvement
Stay up-to-date on the latest processes and IT advancements to automate and modernize systems
Update, implement, and maintain documentation for procedures
Manage competing resources and priorities
Set and manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring clear communication and timely completion of deliverables


What You Bring


3+ years of experience in business analytics, community analytics, customer experience analytics, or a related field.
Experience working with large datasets and identifying actionable trends and insights.
Experience translating fan feedback and behavioral data into actionable recommendations.
Advanced knowledge of community measurements, metrics, and tools
Advanced knowledge of customer support strategies and tools
Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to influence decision-making.
Exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking skills
Excellent documentation skills
Experience creating detailed reports and giving presentations
A track record of meeting commitments
Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$77,700 - $107,900 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Title: DUOMENŲ ANALITIKĖ (-AS)
HTML:
Ar nori tapti „Ignitis Group“ dalimi?

Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) duomenų analitkos komandoje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už analizes, elektros energijos prekybai vykdyti. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie žalios ir saugios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:


  • Kuriant IT ir analitinius įrankius duomenų gavimui, analizei, procesų optimizavimui, procesų stebėsenai ir automatizacijai;
  • Analizuojant kaip tikslinti duomenų prognozes;
  • Inicijuojant, diegiant ir tobulinant naujus analizės modelius;
  • Kuriant įrankius kitiems įmonės specialistams ruošiant ataskaitas savarankiškai;
  • Vykdant didmeninės rinkos modeliavimą;
  • Rengiant įvairias nestandartines analizes;
  • Tobulinant ir administruojant automatinės prekybos sistemas;
  • Reguliariai besidomint naujausiomis duomenų analizės srities tendencijomis.


Šiai pozicijai svarbu:


  • Aukštasis išsilavinimas (ekonometrijos, statistikos, matematikos ar kitų panašių tiksliųjų mokslo srityse);
  • Analitinis mąstymas, duomenų raštingumas, geri problemų sprendimo įgūdžiai;
  • Gebėjimas vizualiai ir aiškiai pateikti apibendrintą informaciją ir analitines įžvalgas.


Privalumas būtų:


  • Ankstesnė prekybos patirtis elektros / kitų žaliavų / akcijų / valiutų biržoje;
  • Geri programavimo įgūdžiai su Python, R, VBA bei SQL programavimo kalbomis;
  • Elektros rinkos veikimo principų išmanymas;
  • Su energetika susijusių duomenų dalinimosi platformų išmanymas.


Mainais už tvaresnės ateities kūrimą, mes pažadame:


  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo „MELP“ programėlėje;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą;
  • Hibridinį darbo modelį (3+2) ir lankstų darbo laiko grafiką;
  • Vidines karjeros galimybes;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Dėmesį fizinei ir emocinei sveikatai: gerovės mentorių iniciatyvas ir psichologinę pagalbą, tinklinio ir krepšinio komandas ir t.t;
  • Galimybę prisidėti prie energetikos transformacijos, siekiant sukurti 100% žalią ir saugią energijos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.


Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

Pareigybių grupės pastovios atlyginimo dalies intervalas: yra nuo 2770 iki 4150 EUR (neatskaičius mokesčių). Konkretus darbo užmokestis siūlomas atsižvelgiant į darbo patirtį ir kompetenciją. Prie darbo užmokesčio gali būti mokama kintamoji atlygio dalis.

Apie mus:

Norėtum prisidėti prie projektų, keičiančių elektros energijos gamybos ir vartojimo ateitį Baltijos šalyse ir už jų ribų? „Ignitis grupė“ yra Baltijos šalyse pirmaujanti integruota energetikos įmonių grupė, apjungianti beveik 4 800 skirtingų sričių ekspertų vienijamų bendro siekio sukurti 100 proc. saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.

Atsakingai investuojame, kad įgalintume elektrifikaciją, užtikrintume tinklų atsparumą ir įgyvendintume strateginį siekį – įdiegti 4–5 GW veikiančių žaliųjų pajėgumų, plėtojant žaliąją gamybą ir lankstumo pajėgumus.

Mažindami ŠESD emisijų intensyvumą energetikos tinkluose, nuosekliai įgyvendiname vertę kuriančią dekarbonizaciją ir kartu užtikriname energetinį saugumą.

„Ignitis grupė“ veikia Baltijos šalyse, Lenkijoje ir Suomijoje. Integruotas verslo modelis grupėje įgalina sinergijas ir naujus verslo modelius, pasitelkiant Baltijos šalyse turimą didžiausią tinklą, energijos kaupimo pajėgumus ir klientų portfelį.

Title: Quantitative Data Analyst in Credit Risk Model Validation | SEB, Vilnius
Description:
SEB is a leading northern European financial services group with a high focus on risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and governance. Banking is transforming at pace, our talented and rapidly expanding quant team is committed to innovation, excellence, and fostering a strong risk culture. Does that sound like a fit for you?

What You Will Be Doing

You will be a part of a professional team within SEB Group CRO organization that ensures quality of models used for measuring credit risk. We conduct in-depth reviews of the models to ensure quality performance by assessing model design and modelling methodologies, performance from the statistical point of view, data quality, implementation, regulatory compliance, and usage.

We work closely with model developers, owners, users, management and other key stakeholders to provide insights and recommendations.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst your primary focus will be on retrieving, preparing, analysing, and interpreting data used throughout the validation process. You will help ensure data quality through structured DQ checks, reconciliations, and standardised datasets, while contributing to consistent data definitions, metadata management, and well‑documented data usage. Alongside analytical work, you will support the development of validation infrastructure by contributing to automation, reusable functions, reporting templates, and coding standards. You’ll be empowered to introduce new validation tools or enhance existing ones, driving innovation and efficiency. Work will be organized in small, project-driven sub-teams within a fast-paced and supportive environment that fosters creativity, autonomy, and professional growth.

The team is located in Vilnius, but you will work in close interaction with the experienced professionals in SEB Group CRO organization across Nordic and Baltic countries.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst, you will be responsible for:


Developing methodologies and advanced tools to improve model review process
Build, maintain and standardize validation datasets ensuring consistent variable definitions and filters across portfolios. Support validation sample preparation under time constraints.
Design and implement automated DQ checks, reconciliations, and data profiling tools, detect data issues early and propose fixes or compensating controls.
Document and maintain data lineage, access methods, and usage guidelines.
Develop or enhance reusable R/SQL/SAS/Python functions, templates.
Automate the generation of charts, tables, and other outputs, and ensure the seamless integration of results into standardized reporting interface.
Maintain code quality via coding standards, version control, documentation, and reproducibility practices.


Who we are looking for:


An academic background in statistics, mathematics, data science, econometrics, physics, engineering or similar
3 and more year's work experience in data analysis or credit risk modelling/validation
Good statistical/programming knowledge (R, SAS, SQL, Python) and data handling skills
Hands‑on experience with large datasets, data warehouses.
Ability to design or maintain DQ frameworks, reconciliation logic, and standardized data structures.
Familiarity with integrating analytical tool outputs into structured reports.
Willingness to take on ownership and to deliver good quality work on time
Analytical and strategic mindset with the ability to transform theory into concrete action while maintaining documentation and coding standards.
Proactive and constructive team player, ready to share experience and ideas.
Good writing and communication skills (English is the main working language).


What we offer:


Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment: international working environment, empowering culture, friendly and welcoming teammates.
Growth culture: opportunity to grow professionally by contributing to large-scale, high-impact initiatives, local and international internal mobility possibilities, put an impact on social or environmental issues.
Modern environment: innovative company in forefront of technology, challenging, cutting-edge work, excellent office environment, agile and modern ways of working.
Additional monetary benefits: paid seniority vacation and volunteering days, allocations to Your pension fund, profit sharing programme, and additional health insurance.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
The Central Bank of Ireland serves the public interest by safeguarding monetary and financial stability and by working to ensure that the financial system operates in the best interests of consumers and the wider economy.




We currently have a vacancy for a Data Engineer on a contract of indefinite duration in the RAD Division. This role is aligned with the Bank Executive grade and the BE salary scale. New entrants will commence on Point 1 of the relevant salary scale; in this case the starting salary will be €39,871. Please click here for further information on our salary scales.




The purpose of the role is to assist the team in providing specialist data analytics expertise in the support of the prudential supervision of firms by supporting the analysis and inspection work required for identification and mitigation of firm-specific/cross sector risks and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.




Responsibilities:

Assist the team in the provision of data analytics in the support of the prudential supervision of firms and mitigation of cross-sector or firm specific risks in order to ensure the stability of the financial services sector.
Aid delivery of data analysis findings to support supervisory actions through the team’s provision of descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and decision analytics.
Takes responsibility for own work and ensure appropriate outcome of supervisory work that has been completed is communicated clearly and effectively both to the team, and other stakeholders.
Support the team in maintaining and developing data analytics sources/tools/processes to ensure
the Directorate can deliver on key projects
significant trends/developments are escalated in a timely fashion
Carry out such other ad-hoc activities as may be determined by the Senior Data Analyst/Manager, in particular, to support them in fulfilling the mandate of the team.
Collaborate with colleagues, developing professional relationships, to ensure effective delivery of projects and supervisory programmes.

Requirements:

A third level honours degree or professional qualification in the area of statistics, business analytics, computer science, maths, finance, economics, risk or any related professional discipline.
A Master’s degree in the area of statistics/econometrics, business analytics, computer science, maths, or equivalent qualification (Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), PRMIA)) is advantageous.
1-5 years relevant experience in data analytics roles within industry, academia, and/ or relevant financial services is desirable. Relevant experience includes: working in data analytics/data science, statistical consulting/applied research roles, business intelligence, or data-focused risk analysis within insurance, banking or financial services sector.
Some understanding/ experience in applying data science/analytics in a business context and practical knowledge of relevant analytics software tools and infrastructure.
Analytical, problem solving and organisational skills.
Experience in at least one of the following areas: data/statistical analysis tools (R,SAS, Matlab), programming languages such as Python/Java/Julia; relational database management (SQL), data warehousing (SQL Server / Services) and business intelligence reporting/visualisation tools.
Ability to acquire proficiency in the above tools/languages where development is required.
Knowledge of, or willingness to acquire an understanding of, the broader regulatory environment.

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

We’re looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, as well as workforce management, quality, training, and knowledge management, to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission!

Here’s How You Will Be Contributing


Analytical Capacity Planning and Forecasting. Focus on building and refining analytical models for strategic capacity planning. Take ownership of forecasting efforts to align with business growth and operational demands.

Job Description

B2B Pricing Analyst, Global Fuels

Circle K is on an ambitious journey to strengthen B2B Fuel Pricing capabilities across the organization through advanced analytics, improved pricing tools, and more effective pricing execution. To support this effort, the team is seeking a B2B Fuel Pricing Analyst who will help implement, roll out, and embed B2B pricing tools across Business Units (BUs), while actively reviewing and challenging BU pricing models and discount deviations to identify improvement opportunities and drive stronger commercial results.

As a B2B Pricing Analyst, you will play a key role supporting our growth strategy “Core + More” in B2B Fuel Pricing through advanced analytics, improved tools, and stronger pricing execution. This role supports Business Units by reviewing and challenging pricing models and discount deviations to improve commercial outcomes. Acting as a trusted partner to primarily Europe‑based BUs, the Analyst provides actionable pricing insights, data‑driven analyses, and hands‑on support through change and adoption. The position combines analytical rigor with strong collaboration, helping build pricing capability, consistency, and confidence across BU teams. This is an exciting and important role in our organization to support our BU teams through change to deliver sustainable business outcome.

The role focuses on enabling BUs through high‑quality data management, analytical support, change management, training, ad‑hoc analysis, and continuous system and tool enhancements. The Analyst will work primarily with Europe‑based BUs, with additional exposure to North America.

The successful candidate will bring a solid understanding of B2B fuel pricing drivers and a collaborative mindset, working closely with BU teams to build pricing capability and confidence in new tools and analysis. The role’s core objective is to improve commercial performance by developing deep expertise in B2B Pricing, incorporating feedback, and guiding BUs through change to deliver sustainable business outcome.

Responsibilities


Provide actionable B2B pricing insights to BU Fuel and Global Fuel teams to support commercial decisions and margin performance.
Support European B2B pricing strategy through analysis of performance, competition, and key drivers.
Ensure data integrity across pricing models, discount frameworks, and tools.
Review and challenge BU pricing models and discount deviations, recommending improvements.
Analyze market trends and segment dynamics to identify risks and opportunities.
Partner with BUs and cross‑functional teams to strengthen pricing capabilities, tools, and execution.
Deliver clear reporting and dashboards to improve transparency, decision‑making, and sustained margin growth


Requirements


>5 years within Fuel, B2B Pricing, commercial analytics, or revenue management
Strong understanding of B2B pricing drivers, discount structures, and margin optimization
Experience in working in large and preferably international organizations
Advanced analytical skills with strong Excel proficiency; BI tools (Power BI/Tableau), and SQL/Python
Experience in Visualization and Infographics, etc.
Knowledge of change management, training delivery, and system or tool scaling is a strong plus
Fluency in English, both written and oral. Additional European languages are a plus
Degree or equivalent in business, engineering, mathematics, or statistics


Competencies And Skills


Communication & relationship building
Conflict management
Collaboration/Team dynamics
Detail orientation
Process orientation
Analytical Mindset
Capable of developing and maintaining strong customer relationships
Excellent presentation and writing skills


Personality profile


Calm and mature,
Ability to combine execution and planning
Good team player
Ability to lead and maintain broad dialogue with stakeholders
Reliable within all aspects of the work
Well-organized
Understands the values of Circle K culture and environment
Personal integrity: Promotes and lives the company standard of ethics, openness and values
Positive and flexible work attitude


Why work with us


We are recognized as TOP employer in GBS industry for 6 consecutive years
Monthly salary starting from 2000 Eur gross
Covered tariff plan for your mobile phone
Health insurance
Employee discounts in our stores
Global and fast-paced work environment
Positive atmosphere and great colleagues around you
Continuous personal and professional development driven by challenging goals
And more!


Interested?

We encourage you to apply by 18th of August, 2026. We are looking forward to your application!

We know great companies are built from within, by great people like you. Come grow with us!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data Science team and turn complex data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. In this role, you’ll work with large and diverse datasets, uncover patterns and opportunities, and use advanced analytics to help solve real business challenges.

If you’re naturally curious, enjoy tackling complex problems, and are passionate about transforming data into actionable insights, this is an opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.




The main responsibilities of the position include:

Apply statistical analysis and data mining techniques to extract meaningful insights from large datasets
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies
Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate insights and monitor key business metrics.
Support the evaluation and assessment of machine learning models through data analysis and performance reporting.
Contribute to the development of the department’s data science strategy and identify opportunities where data science can deliver business value
Ensure high standards in data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, documentation, and code quality
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data engineers, data scientists, software engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders
Present insights, analysis results, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
Ensure adherence to best practices in data quality, version control, and reproducible analytics




Main requirements:

University degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
At least 3 years of experience in data science including hands on experience with Data Analysis
Strong programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, and other data analysis libraries.
Experience with visualization libraries in Python, such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly
Hands-on experience with data visualisation and BI tools, such as Power BI.
Solid understanding of statistics and data mining techniques
Experience working with relational and non-relational databases
Basic knowledge of Machine Learning concepts and techniques, with an interest in applying them to real-world data problems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment




Benefit from:

Attractive remuneration package plus performance related reward
Private health insurance
Corporate pension fund
Intellectually stimulating work environment
Continuous personal development and international training opportunities

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Because this role involves a combination of independent and collaborative work, this position can be conducted 100% remotely.

You don’t see it, but it’s there. Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics – from saving emissions in the City of Lights to powering the Mars Rover to protecting the F35 fighter jet. At Electronic Systems, you’ll be among the brightest minds, working on the aerospace and defense industry’s most difficult problems. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too. Our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our missions: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®” and “We Innovate For Those Who Move The WorldTM.” Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with BAE Systems.

Our Operations employees turn innovative engineering designs into real solutions to meet our customers’ needs. From Supply Chain, to manufacturing and test, Electronic Systems offers opportunities to work with technology rarely accessible in other manufacturing firms. Our training and development programs provide employees with career advancement in a diverse work environment.

The ES Analytics Team is looking for a full stack Tableau/Power BI Developer to join our team in support of Supply Chain. The gifted data visualizer will lead in the development and support interactive/dynamic dashboards on the Tableau and Power BI platform for BAE Systems. The goal of the dashboards is to deliver pertinent data to all levels of management to help teams make smarter, data-driven decisions and deliver better products. The candidate will be required to work closely with multiple stakeholders and leaders to drive solutions that align with the broader ES Analytics vision. Solutions range from ad hoc analysis, automations, generative / predictive AI, and data visualizations. The candidate must have experience developing dashboard interfaces within a SQL environment and have experience working with machine learning and data engineering platforms such as Knime, Dataiku or Alteryx.

Our team is built on dependability and transparency. We all help each other achieve excellence.

Must be a United States person with the ability to obtain a United States Security Clearance.


Develops solutions to problems of unusual complexity which require a high degree of ingenuity, creativity and innovativeness. Challenges are frequently unique, and solutions may serve as precedent for future decisions.
As an AI solutions implementer, you will partner with the Enterprise AI team to design, develop, and deploy artificial intelligence and machine learning models to drive business value and solve complex problems across Operations.
Must be self-sufficient in gathering customer requirements and utilizing business context to create meaningful solutions for ES Operations.
Create well-branded and trusted solutions including Tableau & Power BI dashboards, web applications, automations, etc.
Responsible for KPI(s) ownership.
Serve in a collaborative environment, designing and implementing new features and enhancements based on user and team feedback.
Responsible for optimizing user experience and driving best practices in data visualization and user enablement.
Responsible for providing user and technical support documents, along with training.
Participate in user acceptance and quality assurance testing to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Maintain robust data governance processes to ensure data quality across all solutions.




Required Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Database Development, Software Engineering, or Computer Science with 4+ years’ applicable experience
Proficiency in SQL.
Working experience with Tableau and Power BI.
Experience with AI/machine learning, statistics and other data science tools (Stack AI, Microsoft Azure AI, Google AI Studio)
Minimum 4 years of working experience with ETLs and data pipelines.
Strong Python skills.
Must be a team player, be comfortable in a multi-task environment, and have experience in presenting work output to all levels of management.
Must take initiative to solve problems, implement process improvements, and offer technical support to others on the team.




Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills



Familiarity with Manufacturing or Program Management practices
Alteryx/Dataiku/Knime experience
Working AWS experience
Microsoft Power Automate experience
SSAS and DAX experience



Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $97008 - $164914

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems Electronic Systems


BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Who We AreButcherBox is a certified B Corp headquartered in Boston, and honored to be celebrating our fourth year in a row on Inc.'s list of Best Workplaces. At ButcherBox, we believe in better. That’s why we deliver 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef, free-range organic chicken, pork raised crate-free, and wild-caught seafood directly to our members’ doors. All of our products are humanely raised or wild-caught and never given antibiotics or added hormones ever. We’re working to build a world that’s better for all, and we’re inviting everyone to come along. For us, better means treating our planet with respect. It means improving the lives of animals and the livelihoods of farmers. It means never cutting corners when it comes to doing business. Ultimately, it means better meals, enjoyed together. Our team is made up of people who collaborate and support one another. We’re always looking for outstanding people to join our mission! 

About the Role

Department: Commercial Operations

Reports To: Associate Director of Commercial & Marketing Analytics

Location: Watertown, MA - in office 3 days/week 

Level: Individual Contributor, mid-level

Base Salary: $103,000 - $120,000

 

About the Role

ButcherBox is looking for a Growth Analyst to own new member acquisition analytics. This isn't a build-dashboards-and-hand-off-findings role. You'll identify opportunities, design tests, drive analysis, and follow it through to a decision. The expectation is that you're the connective tissue between data and action; not just telling us what the numbers say, but making sure something happens because of it. 

Our marketing and commercial teams embrace a hybrid model that provides personal flexibility as well as in-person collaboration. The ideal candidate will find value in coming to our Watertown office two to three days per week. You’ll be embedded in the growth team, owning critical metrics alongside them and supporting weekly channel deep dives. 

Responsibilities

Own analysis across paid (social, SEM, affiliate) and non-digital channels (TV, radio, podcast, OOH), plus site funnel and lead/email flow — from surfacing what's happening to advising what to do next 
Design, analyze, and report on A/B and incrementality tests with a bias toward action and iteration 
Build and maintain self-service reporting tools and data resources that enable self-service analytics by the growth team 
Lead the development of our next phase of media attribution, including MTA and media mix  
Build a deep understanding of the new member journey (predictive LTV, LTV:CPA, funnel conversion) and use it to sharpen acquisition strategy 
Translate analytical findings into decisions in partnership with the growth marketing team 
Drive work from question to answer to outcome, including identifying and resolving whatever's in the way 

Qualifications

Excellent SQL skills; proficiency in Power BI or other visualization tools 
Experience in paid media analytics and growth marketing measurement 
Deep knowledge of incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, and other measurement tools 
Strong sense of “so what?”, driving action through analysis 
Comfort working in a fast paced environment where decisions cannot wait to be made 
Ability to translate technical analysis into clear, specific recommendations, communicated clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders 
Track record of driving projects to closure in cross-functional environments, including navigating ambiguity and multiple priorities, with a bias towards speed

ButcherBox is driven by relentless improvement, accountability, humility, and customer obsession. We want our workplace to be one of growth and learning where everyone can be safe/comfortable to show up as their authentic self to work. Anyone who loves our products and goals is welcome here! Title: Retail Business Analyst
Description:
Our Brand

At J.Jill, we’re redefining what it means to dress and live with ease. As a women-led, Boston-based lifestyle brand with 200+ stores nationwide, we design thoughtful, inspired apparel and accessories that celebrate the totality of all women. We’re entering an exciting chapter of growth — expanding our footprint, reaching new customers, and deepening long-standing relationships. We're seeking bold thinkers and doers to join us. With competitive pay and benefits, a supportive culture, and the chance to make a real impact, this is more than a job, it’s an opportunity to bring our ethos keep it simple, make it matter to life in new and inspiring ways.

Overview

The Business Analyst partners with cross-functional teams across J.Jill, including Real Estate, Marketing, Retail Operations, and Merchandising, to provide data-driven insights that support strategic business decisions. This role performs end-to-end business analysis by translating business questions into actionable recommendations through SQL queries, Excel spreadsheets, and data visualization. The Business Analyst evaluates business performance, analyzes A/B testing results, develops automated reporting solutions using BI tools such as Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI, and presents findings through clear, impactful presentations and reports. Additionally, the role supports real estate strategy by developing sales forecasts for new store locations, closures, and transfers to help drive profitable growth.

Responsibilities


Builds partnerships and operates cross functionally to provide analytical decision support to leaders to increase revenue and profit of various initiatives.
Takes an active role in conception, design, execution, and analysis of corporate-wide testing activities.
Understands key performance indicators that drive company results and determines how these metrics track against overall business strategies, goals and objectives.
Takes initiative acting as a subject matter expert on analytics, quantification, and process automation and provides advanced analytics to support longer-range plans and initiatives.
Provides recommendations for improvements to tools, scorecards, KPIs & benchmarks.
Performs end-to-end business analytics: 1) Understands business question 2) Structures Excel spreadsheet 3) Builds accurate SQL queries (validating results) 4) Summarizes analytical insights and business recommendations into a PowerPoint deck and/or email.
Performs data analysis tasks, evalution of A/B Tests, etc. to develop recommendations that will improve decision making across the organization.
Develops automated self-service business reporting through BI tools including Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI.
Calculates sales estimates for potential new store locations as well as store closure and store transfer estimates for existing stores.


Benefits, Tailored for You.
